izzyondroid:de.binarynoise.betterVerbose.name: Better Verbose Wi-Fi Logging
izzyondroid:de.binarynoise.betterVerbose.summary: Make the verbose Wi-Fi information more readable
izzyondroid:de.binarynoise.betterVerbose.description:
This Xposed module makes the verbose Wi-Fi information (enabled in the developer settings) more readable, adds some and hides some useless information.
 Without the module, it is all one long line that gets wrapped at your screen to make it fit.
 With the module, it is split into multiple lines: one for the general status info, one for each network. In parentheses, you find the channel number because that is usually more interesting than the frequency itself. Everything that has units now displays those units. What you don't see is that elements that belong together have no break spaces between them so that they are always displayed in one line next to each other.

fdroid:com.akslabs.cloudgallery.name: Chitralaya CloudGallery App
fdroid:com.akslabs.cloudgallery.summary: Transform Telegram into your personal, unlimited photo cloud storage.
fdroid:com.akslabs.cloudgallery.description:
Never Lose a Precious Memory Again! 📸✨
Chitralaya CloudGallery (चित्रालय - "House of Images" in Sanskrit) is your personal photo fortress that transforms Telegram into unlimited, truly private cloud storage! Say goodbye to the anxiety of losing precious memories and hello to unlimited backup freedom.
🌟 What is CloudGallery?
Chitralaya CloudGallery is a simple open-source Android app
that turns your Telegram account into a private photo cloud storage — no signup, no servers, no tracking.
Your photos go straight from your phone to your own Telegram chat,
giving you free, practically unlimited backup space with full control over your data.
It’s not a company or a service — just a open-source tool made by a privacy-minded developer who believes your memories should stay yours.
👋 Hey there!
I’m Aditya, the guy behind AKS-Labs.
Before you scroll, let me make one thing clear —
I’m just another user like you, tired of the usual “cloud storage deal” — free at first,
then you pay with your money... or even worse, with your privacy.
So I built something different — Chitralaya CloudGallery.
It’s not a company, not a service.
Just a simple, open-source tool —
a bridge between your Android phone 📱 and your Telegram account 📡.
🤔 Why even build this?
I was using Google Photos like everyone else. Free storage, nice features, AI magic… but then I realized:
Google scans my photos to “offer me memories” → which also means they read them.
Google uses user data to personalize services, show relevant ads, improve products,services.
We users don’t even know or read what other privacy-concerning terms we’ve agreed to at the time of sign-up.
And will they only use data collected from Google Photos to improve Google Photos — or does it include all Google products?
Sharing a link doesn’t mean it’s private — anyone with that link can see your photos.
Needs to compress images when free storage is full.
One day, “free storage is full” and they said: “Pay up for more storage.”
Google, builds entire business models around data.
That’s when it hit me: my photos aren’t mine.
I wanted something unlimited, private, and mine. And then I looked at Telegram.
But wait… Why Telegram📡? Can’t Telegram see my photos?
This is the elephant in the room 🐘.
“Aditya, you’re asking me to upload my private photos to Telegram. Should I trust them?”
Here’s my honest take:
Telegram encrypts your data in transit, but not end-to-end (like Signal).
So if they really wanted to, they could peek.
But let’s be honest — so can Google, iCloud, OneDrive, or any cloud you don’t run yourself.
The only way to have absolute control? Run your own server.
But not everyone can afford or maintain that.
But here’s the thing:
Telegram gives insane free cloud storage.
No limits (beyond what you can practically upload).
No compression if you upload as files.
And their infra is stable enough to trust for years.
So it boils down to: who do you want to trust more?
For me, Telegram felt like the lesser evil.
But again — it’s your choice. I’m not telling you to trust Telegram.
I’m just saying: here’s another option, do with it what you like.
And if you want to dive deeper, check out the FAQ section where I go through all these questions in detail.
So my thought was simple:
👉 If I’m anyway trusting a company, I’d rather trust Telegram (with unlimited space, no ads, no AI snooping)
than Google(Google, which builds entire business models around data.).
Still, it’s your call. I’m not here to sell you Telegram. I’m just here to hand you the option.
🛡️ Transparency First
I don’t want you to blindly trust me either. Here’s how CloudGallery works:
Your bot token & chat ID are stored securely in Android keystore (AES encryption).
Your photos go directly to your Telegram account — no middle servers.
I don’t track you, I don’t log you, I don’t even know who uses this app.
The app is open source. You can read the code yourself.

ScreenOffTimer is a sleep timer for Android. No ads, just a simple, modern tool to help you wind down and protect your device's battery life.

fdroid:com.odiousapps.weewxweather.name: WeeWX Weather App
fdroid:com.odiousapps.weewxweather.summary: Live weather, forecasts and alerts from your own WeeWX weather station
fdroid:com.odiousapps.weewxweather.description:
Your weather, from your own weather station.
Most weather apps show data from third-party services or an official observation site that may be many miles away. WeeWX Weather App shows the readings from your own personal weather station, or any station you have access to, running WeeWX, the free and open-source weather station software.
FEATURES
• Current conditions from your station, including temperature, humidity, wind, rainfall and pressure
• Optional indoor readings
• Statistics for today, yesterday, this month, last month, this year, last year and all time
• Forecasts from many providers, including BoM, NOAA (weather.gov), Met Office, DWD, AEMET, MET Norway, Met Éireann, MetService, Environment Canada and OpenWeatherMap
• Weather radar and webcam images with pinch-to-zoom
• Near real-time updates over MQTT while the app is open
• Notifications when the temperature, daily rainfall or rain rate reaches limits you set
• Home screen widget with light, dark or custom colors
• Upcoming moon events
• Metric or imperial units, plus light and dark themes
• Flexible update intervals, with an option to update only over Wi-Fi
• Works with stations on your home network or on the internet
REQUIREMENTS
This app is a companion to WeeWX and needs a WeeWX server to connect to. These WeeWX extensions must be installed on that server:
• InigoPlugin
• AggregateValues
• MQTTPublishV2 (optional, needed for live updates)
The extensions export your weather data in a format the app can read. Setup instructions are on the wiki:
https://github.com/evilbunny2008/WeeWXWeatherApp/wiki
OPEN SOURCE
WeeWX Weather App is open-source software, licensed under the GPLv3 and maintained by the community. Bug reports and contributions are welcome on GitHub:
https://github.com/evilbunny2008/WeeWXWeatherApp

fdroid:com.schwegelbin.openbible.name: OpenBible
fdroid:com.schwegelbin.openbible.summary: OpenBible provides the Bible with as little distractions as possible
fdroid:com.schwegelbin.openbible.description:
OpenBible aims to be an open, simple and lightweight Android application for reading the Bible without any additional inputs. This means that the app contains only the Bible without items like section headings, comments, reading plans or tips.
OpenBible allows you to download the Bible in many different languages and translations. It strives to keep these translations up to date to address formatting or similar issues.
You can select the translation, book and chapter or find verses by searching their content.
The app lets you customize your reading experience through color themes, color schemes, text alignment, split screen mode, font size and verse number visibility.
These settings default to your system preferences to reduce the need for manual adjustments.
While reading, you can pinch or double click the screen to temporarily change the font size. Additionally, you can select text to copy or share it.
Your settings, selections and translations are saved and can be backed up for convenience.

fdroid:com.swordfish.lemuroid.name: Lemuroid
fdroid:com.swordfish.lemuroid.summary: All in one emulator on Android
fdroid:com.swordfish.lemuroid.description:
Lemuroid is an open-source emulator based on Libretro. It's designed to work on a wide range of devices, from phones to TVs, and to provide the best user experience on Android. It's completely free and without ads.
Supported Systems:
- Atari 2600 (A26)
- Atari 7800 (A78)
- Atari Lynx (Lynx)
- Nintendo (NES)
- Super Nintendo (SNES)
- Game Boy (GB)
- Game Boy Color (GBC)
- Game Boy Advance (GBA)
- Sega Genesis (aka Megadrive)
- Sega CD (aka Mega CD)
- Sega Master System (SMS)
- Sega Game Gear (GG)
- Nintendo 64 (N64)
- PlayStation (PSX)
- PlayStation Portable (PSP)
- FinalBurn Neo (Arcade)
- Nintendo DS (NDS)
- NEC PC Engine (PCE)
- Neo Geo Pocket (NGP)
- Neo Geo Pocket Color (NGC)
- WonderSwan (WS)
- WonderSwan Color (WSC)
- Nintendo 3DS (3DS)
Features:
- Automatically save and restore game states
- ROMs scanning and indexing
- Optimized touch controls
- Quick save/load with slots
- Support for zipped ROMs
- Display simulation (LCD/CRT)
- Fast-forward support
- Gamepad support
- Tilt to stick support
- Touch control customization (size and position)
- Cloud save sync
- No ads
- Local multiplayer (connect multiple gamepads to the same device)

This application does not contain any games. You need to provide your own legally owned ROM files.

fdroid:com.xmission.trevin.android.notes.name: NotePad
fdroid:com.xmission.trevin.android.notes.description:
A simple and intuitive notepad based on the app bundled with Palm Pilot.
 Entirely offline, requiring few permissions to run.
 Permission to use external storage is only needed to back up or
restore your notes on Marshmallow (Android 6) and older.
 The following permissions are added by WorkManager, a Google
library used to run the export, import, and password re-encryption
operations in the background when initiated by the user. The core
app does not use these on its own.
 Permission to run a foreground service, added on Pie (Android 9)
and later.
 Permission to view network connections, used by WorkManager to
determine the best time to schedule background tasks.
 Permission to prevent the phone from sleeping, used by WorkManager
to keep the processor awake while a background task is running.
 Permission to run at startup, used by WorkManager to reschedule
any pending background task after the phone is rebooted.
 Create any number of categories for different notes.
 Mark notes as private and optionally encrypt them with a password.
 Export notes to a local XML file.
 Import notes from an XML file.
 Backwards compatible with Android 5.0 (Lollipop) and up.

fdroid:dev.nemeyes.ncarousel.name: NCarousel
fdroid:dev.nemeyes.ncarousel.description:
NCarousel downloads images from a folder on your Nextcloud server (via WebDAV) and sets them as your Android wallpaper.
Features:
- Sign in to your own Nextcloud (check server URL, then Nextcloud app SSO, browser Login Flow, or username / app password); multiple accounts. SSO-only can list and set wallpaper without browser login; Library auto-thumbnails stay off until you complete browser Login Flow (app password)
- Browse Nextcloud folders in Settings (default Photos if empty); after a refresh with no images, the app can offer the folder browser
- Automatic wallpaper rotation (minimum interval 1 minute; WorkManager may delay in Doze)
- Order modes: sequential, random, shuffle once, smart random, no-repeat
- Manual “next” from the app and an optional Quick Settings tile
- Apply to home, lock screen, or both
- Image fit: fill (crop), fit with soft blurred edges, or center
- Optional Wi‑Fi-only mode for scheduled downloads (manual apply still works on any network)
- Library: search, sort (name, date, folders, carousel index; tap again to invert), folder filter, grid or list, pin current wallpaper; remote thumbnails on by default for app-password accounts (visible cells only, paced; optional opt-out); SSO-only accounts keep auto-thumbnails off; fullscreen preview loads on demand
- Fullscreen preview (full image by default, pinch-to-zoom; optional Adjust frame for Cover/Center with a device-display crop guide matching wallpaper apply, offset remembered per image); apply only or apply and advance; share image via Android share sheet; exclude images from the automatic carousel
- Manage exclusions (Library filters: in carousel / excluded; export/import; optional save/load under .ncarousel on Nextcloud)
- Optional on-device image cache; EXIF / place info for the last wallpaper applied by the app
- Follows the system language when a translation is available
Privacy:
- No trackers
- Credentials are stored encrypted on-device (AndroidX Security)
- Network connections only go to the Nextcloud server you configure

fdroid:org.duckassist.app.name: duckAssist
fdroid:org.duckassist.app.summary: Lightweight, privacy-focused WebView wrapper for Duck.ai
fdroid:org.duckassist.app.description:
duckAssist is a lightweight, privacy-focused Android WebView wrapper designed specifically for Duck.ai (DuckDuckGo's private AI chat service). It bridges the gap between web and native by providing advanced integration features while maintaining the core privacy principles of DuckDuckGo.
Key Features:
- Focused Interface: A clean, distraction-free environment tailored for AI chat, complete with a native progress bar.
- Digital Assistant Integration: Set duckAssist as your device's default digital assistant app for instant access.
- Auto-Voice Activation: Launching via the assistant shortcut automatically triggers a new voice chat.
- "Ask duck.ai" Integration: Select text in any application and choose "Ask duck.ai" from the context menu to paste your query directly.
- Smart Link Handling: External links open automatically in your system's default browser.
- Enhanced Privacy: Session persistence is preserved, and the application cache is automatically purged when leaving/closing the app.
- Native File Support: Seamlessly upload documents and download attachments.
- Bottom Drawer Interface: Slide up a convenient bottom sheet drawer when using assistant shortcuts or sharing content to interact with the AI without losing your background app context.
- Customizable Prompts & UI Settings: Configure bottom drawer panel behavior, assistant voice options, and default prompt suffixes for text and document sharing via a custom-styled HTML settings page.

winget-run-community:Cryptomator.Cryptom.summary:
Cryptomator provides transparent, client-side encryption for your cloud. Protect your documents from unauthorized
access. Cryptomator is free and open source software, so you can rest assured there are no backdoors.
Cryptomator encrypts file contents and names using AES. Your passphrase is protected against bruteforcing attempts

hundreds of other developers. As you don't need an account, you will never stand in front of locked doors.
Cryptomator is provided free of charge as an open-source project despite the high development effort and is therefore dependent on donations.

flathub:app.cantara.Cantara.name: Cantara
flathub:app.cantara.Cantara.description:
Cantara Song is a song presentation software which can be used for presenting songs in churches, small groups or karaoke parties. It supports various input formats and can create beautiful presentation slides or export the presentation to various output formats (pictures, pptx, WhatsApp messages and a lot more) so that it can be used for a variety of purposes.
 Cantara has the following advantages:
 Super-fast and lightweight: Cantara is less then 10 MB of size and uses the components available on the local operation system as far as possible. It contains no bloatware. It can be run on an old computer, a raspberry-pi and many more.
 Very easy to use: Accepts the most common input format (CCLI songselect lyrics file) and creats the presentation slides for an event in only a few seconds. The usage is very intuitive and user-friendly.
 Good integration with other presentation software: Cantara can export presentations to the PPTX format and therefore integrates easily with other presentation software like LibreOffice Impress or MS Powerpoint. It can be included in a complex workflow like a church service or even an online streaming event via OBS. In addition, you can export the lyrics to text formats and share them in messenger groups, as a HTML page etc.
 Multi-Screen-Support: Multi Screen is supported out of the box.
 Customizable Design and good outlook: The colors and fonts can be configured in the settings. In addition, you can set up a background picture and adjust it’s brightness/transparency. The presentations look beautiful and are easy to read.
 Multi language support: Cantara can present and export song presentations in two different languges at the same time.
 Free and Open Source: No license fees, no dependence on certain companies–Cantara is licensed under the GPL-3 and can be used everywhere and as you want.
 Used all over the world and continuously developed: Although Cantara is still a quite young project, people from many countries are using it. It has been translated to several langauges. In the future, more functions are going to be implemented.

 worlds, and addons for Minecraft and other supported games, and keep them up to date — all from
 one app.
 Features:
 Browse and one-click install mods and modpacks
 Create, manage, and launch modded game profiles
 Automatic updates for your installed content
 Import and export modpacks to share with others
 CurseForge is free to use, and every feature listed above works without paying. The app shows
 ads. An optional paid subscription removes them and unlocks cosmetic extras; it is not required
 for any of the functionality above.

 install, update, and customise their FTB Modpacks. We have built-in support for CurseForge
 modpacks and mods as well as instance management, pack customisation, and a whole lot more.

flathub:io.github.endless_sky.endless_sk.description:
Explore other star systems. Earn money by trading, carrying passengers, or completing missions. Use your earnings to buy a better ship or to upgrade the weapons and engines on your current one. Blow up pirates. Take sides in a civil war. Or leave human space behind and hope to find some friendly aliens whose culture is more civilized than your own...

The game includes a major plot line and many minor missions, but you can choose whether you want to play through the plot or strike out on your own as a merchant or bounty hunter or explorer.

flathub:me.spaceinbox.actioneer.name: Actioneer
flathub:me.spaceinbox.actioneer.description:
Actioneer lets you browse GitHub repositories, inspect workflow runs, check job logs, and refresh
 status without leaving your desktop.
 Key features
 Browse your GitHub repositories and view Actions workflows and recent runs quickly.
 Inspect run status (success, failure, queued, in progress) with clear badges and counts.
 Filter runs and focus on what matters most.
 View job logs: download and preview run logs for quick troubleshooting.
 Dispatch workflows, cancel running workflows, and re-run failed runs directly from the app.
 Favorites and quick search let you focus on the repositories and workflows that matter most.
 Desktop notifications for run completions and failures so you never miss important results.
 Keep recent workflow data available offline.
 Fast refreshes that keep the interface responsive.
 This package contains the desktop application, icons and AppStream metadata required for distribution
 via Flatpak/Flathub. See the project repository for source code, contribution guidelines, and additional
 documentation.

flathub:org.getzola.zola.name: Zola
flathub:org.getzola.zola.summary: A fast static site generator in a single binary with everything built-in
flathub:org.getzola.zola.description:
Zola comes as a single executable with Sass compilation, syntax highlighting, table of contents and many other features 
 that traditionally require setting up a dev environment adding some JavaScript libraries to your site.
 The average site will be generated in less than a second, including Sass compilation and syntax highlighting.
 Zola renders your whole site as static files, making it trivial to handle any kind of traffic you will throw at it at no 
 cost without having to worry about managing a server or a database.
 From the CLI to the template engine, everything is designed to be intuitive. Don't take my word for it though, look at the
 documentation and see for yourself.
 Zola gets out of your way so you can focus on your content, be it a blog, a knowledge base, a landing page or a combination 
 of them.
 Zola comes with shortcodes and internal links to make it easier to write your content.

fedora-packages:catharsis-cormorant-font.summary: Cormorant Upright, an un-slanted cursive variant
fedora-packages:catharsis-cormorant-font.description: Cormorant is an original design for an extravagant display serif font family inspired by the Garamond heritage, hand-drawn and produced by Catharsis Fonts. While traditional Garamond cuts make for exquisite reading at book sizes, they appear clumpy and inelegant at larger sizes. The design goal of Cormorant was to distill the aesthetic essence of Garamond, unfetter it from the limitations of metal printing, and allow it to bloom into its natural refined form at high definition. Cormorant is characterized by scandalously small counters, razor-sharp serifs, dangerously smooth curves, and flamboyantly tall accents. While many implementations of Garamond at small optical sizes already exist (including the open-sourced EB Garamond by Georg Duffner), Cormorant aims for the sparsely populated niche of display-size counterparts that exploit the high resolution of contemporary screens and print media to the fullest. Cormorant is made for large sizes; the larger, the better. However, it works well as a text face in high-resolution environments. Cormorant is a native 21st-century typeface making ample use of OpenType technology. Some OpenType features are applied automatically while you type, subtly improving the flow of the text. This includes kerning, standard ligatures, and contextual alternates. Other features are intended to be activated manually by the user, such as discretionary ligatures, stylistic alternates, small capitals, and alternate figure sets. Cormorant Upright is an un-slanted cursive of the main Cormorant font family.

fedora-packages:ghc-serialise/ghc-serial.name: ghc-serialise
fedora-packages:ghc-serialise/ghc-serial.summary: A binary serialisation library for Haskell values
fedora-packages:ghc-serialise/ghc-serial.description: This package (formerly 'binary-serialise-cbor') provides pure, efficient serialization of Haskell values directly into 'ByteString's for storage or transmission purposes. By providing a set of type class instances, you can also serialise any custom data type you have as well. The underlying binary format used is the 'Concise Binary Object Representation', or CBOR, specified in RFC 7049. As a result, serialised Haskell values have implicit structure outside of the Haskell program itself, meaning they can be inspected or analyzed without custom tools. An implementation of the standard bijection between CBOR and JSON is provided by the [cborg-json](/package/cborg-json) package. Also see [cbor-tool](/package/cbor-tool) for a convenient command-line utility for working with CBOR data.

fedora-packages:ghc-wizards/ghc-wizards.name: ghc-wizards
fedora-packages:ghc-wizards/ghc-wizards.summary: High level, generic library for interrogative user interfaces
fedora-packages:ghc-wizards/ghc-wizards.description: 'wizards' is a package designed for the quick and painless development of /interrogative/ programs, which revolve around a "dialogue" with the user, who is asked a series of questions in a sequence much like an installation wizard. Everything from interactive system scripts, to installation wizards, to full-blown shells can be implemented with the support of 'wizards'. It is developed transparently on top of a free monad, which separates out the semantics of the program from any particular interface. A variety of backends exist, including console-based "System.Console.Wizard.Haskeline" and "System.Console.Wizard.BasicIO", and the pure "System.Console.Wizard.Pure". It is also possible to write your own backends, or extend existing back-ends with new features. While both built-in IO backends operate on a console, there is no reason why 'wizards' cannot also be used for making GUI wizard interfaces. See the github page for examples on usage: <http://www.github.com/liamoc/wizards> For creating backends, the module "System.Console.Wizard.Internal" has a brief tutorial.

ReconLens is a powerful, lightweight browser extension designed for security researchers, bug hunters, and developers. It automatically analyzes web pages in real-time to discover hidden assets and sensitive information.
 Key Features: 
- Endpoint Discovery: Extracts URLs, subdomains, and IP addresses (including IP:Port combinations).
- Sensitive Data Extraction: Identifies JWT tokens, API keys, and other sensitive patterns using optimized regex engines.
- Path Mapping: Discovers complete and incomplete file paths, static assets, and sensitive directories.
- Quick Lookups: One-click integration with Shodan , VirusTotal , and SecurityTrails for instant intelligence.
- Data Export: Structured export options (JSON, Markdown, XML) for AI-assisted analysis and reporting.
- Privacy First: All analysis is performed locally in your browser. No data is collected or transmitted to third-party servers by default.

uBO Lite (uBOL) is an MV3-based content blocker.
The default ruleset corresponds to uBlock Origin's default filterset:
 uBlock Origin's built-in filter lists
 EasyList
 EasyPrivacy
 Peter Lowe’s Ad and tracking server list
You can enable more rulesets by visiting the options page -- click the Cogs icon in the popup panel.
uBOL is entirely declarative, meaning there is no need for a permanent uBOL process for the filtering to occur, and CSS/JS injection-based content filtering is performed reliably by the browser itself rather than by the extension. This means that uBOL itself does not consume CPU/memory resources while content blocking is ongoing -- uBOL's service worker process is required only when you interact with the popup panel or the option pages.

 KEY FEATURES:

 Window Tiling Mode (Recommended): Arranges tabs into separate, tiled browser windows. This mode preserves 100% of browser functionality, including ad blockers, password managers, and other extensions.
 Fully Configurable Views: Add & Remove Panels: Easily add new tabs to an existing split view or remove panels you no longer need with a single click.

firefox-addons:2895002.name: The Tab Suspender
firefox-addons:2895002.summary: Suspends inactive tabs after a set time by replacing them with a custom suspended page.
firefox-addons:2895002.description:
Please rate and share this addon if you find it useful. If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to leave a review or mail me.
This is a powerful and lightweight extension designed to automatically suspend inactive tabs, freeing up valuable system memory (RAM) (as it's getting expensive) and CPU resources. By putting unused tabs to sleep, it ensures your browser remains fast and responsive, extending battery life on laptops and improving overall system performance.
 SOME BACKGROUND: 
I built this extension for my personal use, but as more people started to use it and I received a lot of feedback, I began to add features that people wanted that I wouldn't necessarily need.
 KEY DIFFERENCE VS OTHER EXTENSIONS: 
Suspended tabs don't automatically reload, you have to click to load them. The extension also uses Firefox's built-in native discarding so the browser behaves as if the tab doesn't exist (same as Auto Tab Discard).
 CORE FEATURES: 
 Automatic Suspension: 
- Automatically detects and suspends tabs that have been inactive for a specified period (default is 40 minutes).
 Significant Memory Savings: 
- Instantly releases memory used by inactive tabs, allowing your active tabs and other applications to run smoother.
 Native Tab Discarding (New in v1.7): 
- Now utilizes the Firefox Native Discard API for maximum efficiency and stability while maintaining the signature "Click to Restore" interface.
 Configurable Tab Emojis: 
- User can choose from preset emojis (or none) to mark tabs that are suspended.
 Pause Tab Suspension: 
- Tab suspension can be paused and resumed automatically after a period of time when needed.
 Prevent Accidental Reloads: 
- Suspended tabs do not auto-reload on focus. You decide when to load the content.
 Alternative Tab Discard options: 
- Suspended tabs can reload immediately on click by disabling suspended page in options.
 Visual Feedback: 
- Suspended tabs are clearly marked with a "zzz" icon in the title and a dimmed favicon.
 Dark Mode Support: 
- The suspended page automatically adapts to your browser's theme (Light/Dark mode).
 Smart Whitelisting & Protection: 
- Whitelist specific domains or individual URLs so they never suspend.
- Option to prevent suspension of tabs playing Audio/Video.
- Option to prevent suspension of tabs with unsaved form inputs.
- Option to prevent suspension of pinned tabs.
 CROSS-DEVICE-SYNC: 
- Your settings and whitelist rules sync across all your Firefox instances (if enabled).
 KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS: 
- Quickly suspend, unsuspend, or whitelist the current tab using customizable hotkeys.
**CONTEXT MENU INTEGRATION: **
- Right-click any page to suspend it immediately or add it to the whitelist.
NEW IN VERSION 1.7
- Chrome version has been released. Find it at Chrome Web Store .
- Integration with Native Discard API for improved memory handling.
- Improved persistence: Suspended tabs now survive browser updates and restarts more reliably with new migration logic.
- Optimized performance with reduced background activity.
 HOW IT WORKS 
- You set a timeout duration (e.g., 30 minutes).
- If you don't interact with a tab for that duration, the extension unloads the heavy website and replaces it with a temporary, lightweight placeholder.
- When you return to the tab, you see the placeholder. Click anywhere on the page to reload the original website instantly.
- When you move away from the tab without reloading the original website, the extension discards the tab again after 30 seconds.
Perfect for users who keep dozens of tabs open for research, work, or reading lists but want to keep their computer running at top speed.

bluejetty:00174894:ios.name: Artemis Director's Viewfinder
bluejetty:00174894:ios.summary:
Artemis offers a comprehensive database of professional motion picture cameras and lenses, with the facility to add any custom camera format. 
Hear from our users:
Roger Deakins ASC, BSC: Cinematographer (Two Academy Awards wins, 16 nomin
bluejetty:00174894:ios.description:
Artemis offers a comprehensive database of professional motion picture cameras and lenses, with the facility to add any custom camera format. 
Hear from our users:
Roger Deakins ASC, BSC: Cinematographer (Two Academy Awards wins, 16 nominations)
Blade Runner 2049, Sicario, James Bond: Skyfall, The Shawshank Redemption
- “It’s great having Artemis on my iPhone. Since I always have my phone with me, I always have a viewfinder at hand. Not only convenient but extremely accurate.”
Claudio Miranda ASC: Cinematographer
Top Gun: Maverick, F1, Life of Pi, Benjamin Button, Oblivion
- “I've been using Artemis from the very beginning. I love that it's a shared tool. First between the director and myself. Then once we approve shots, the images from Artemis get shared with the crew.”
Kate Dennis DGA: Director
The Handmaid’s Tale, Glow, The Serpent Queen
- "Artemis has streamlined my communication with cinematographers, VFX supervisors and other Heads of Department. Now we all know that we are talking about the exact same frame!"
Linus Sandgren FSF: Cinematographer
Saltburn, La La Land, Babylon, Joy, American Hustle
- "Artemis is an amazing Swiss army knife style lens kit that has helped me frame up countless shots in any format in an instant.”
Matthew Libatique ASC: Cinematographer
Maestro, A Star is Born, Black Swan, Requiem for a Dream, The Fountain
- "Not only do I frame every shot with Artemis , I use it to record blocking rehearsals and as part of my process when debating lens and format choices as I work with a director and production designer while location scouting.”
Nicolas Winding Refn: Director
Too Old to Die Young, The Neon Demon, Only God Forgives, Pusher
- "Artemis Pro has tapped into the way of the future by taking full advantage of the digital revolution. The app quickly became an essential tool to capturing my vision.”
Mandy Walker ASC, ACS: Cinematographer
Elvis, Mulan,, Hidden Figures, Truth, Australia
- "Both Artemis & Artemis Prime are essential tool when scouting locations, allowing accurate information to pass from the director and DP to the crew"
Barry Ackroyd BSC: Cinematographer
Jason Bourne, The Big Short, Captain Phillips, Hurt Locker
- "Artemis makes me feel smarter than I was without it. It’s the sharpest tool on my iPhone.”
Toby Oliver ACS Cinematographer
Get Out, M3GAN 2.0, Happy Death Day, Insidious IV, Wolf Creek 2
- "Artemis Pro is so well thought out. You can precisely choose the camera package and lenses you have to hand to obtain exact ideas of shot angles and sizes on the location survey.”
Darius Khondji ASC, AFC, ACS: Cinematographer
Bardo, Okja, The Lost City of Z, Delicatessen, Se7en
- "Artemis is the best cinematic tool of modern times. I started using Artemis in 2010 and have loved it ever since. It is so accurate with up to date lenses, cameras and formats. It is always with us on scouts and during shoots. Artemis allows the director and I to share how we see things with each other and with the rest of the crew.”
Robert McLachlan ASC, CSC: Director / Cinematographer
Landman, Yellowstone, Game of Thrones, Westworld
- “On Game of Thrones we scouted locations months in advance. Artemis allowed me to communicate our needs to the VFX and art departments. It was critical in planning the Dance of Dragons sequence.”
Artemis also offers:
- Virtual Stand-Ins, to assist in blocking actors
- Custom Frame-lines
- Share camera & lens setups with other Artemis users
- Record Images & Videos
- Gallery for sorting and planning
- Export of Shot-lists & Storyboards
- Export of detailed Shot-Plans with sun position data (if paired with the Helios app)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00036609:ios.description:
Install mods for Minecraft Pocket Edition! The application will provide you with a large collection of mods, addons, maps, skins, textures, seeds, and shaders for Minecraft PE.
Expand the capabilities of your favorite Minecraft PE with a huge collection of addons. It has furniture mods, adding interior items, cars mods, allowing you to race on a race track with your favorite transport, and much more. Get new items such as furniture, guns, cars, transport, lucky blocks, and TNT that will allow you to create unique gameplay and turn your game into a field for creativity. You can even add a backpack.
Explore a multitude of exciting maps. From escaping prison to huge cities, our maps will allow you to immerse yourself in modern buildings and homes or engage in PvP with friends. Each journey will be interesting and captivating. Search for treasures, explore mysterious dungeons, or build your own city!
Discover a vast selection of colorful skins to change the appearance of your character in Minecraft. You will find girls skins, boys skins. Become a superhero, a fantastical creature, a monster, a YouTuber, or simply express your individuality. Popular skins will allow you to stand out among other players and create your own style. Choose from skins of various categories, including animals, robots, camouflage, anime, and much more.
Immerse yourself in the world of Minecraft with new textures for blocks, items, and the environment. Our collection of texture packs will allow you to change the atmosphere by adding realistic details, vibrant colors, or a unique style. Feel new within this pixelated world. Choose from various texture packs, from classic and retro to high-quality HD textures. Enhance graphics, create an atmosphere, and dive into incredible visual immersion!
Use seeds to start your adventure in Minecraft with unique worlds. Discover new biomes, villages, dungeons, and other amazing places. Each seed offers its own secrets for you to explore. You will find a wide variety of seeds, from adventurous and mystical to survival on an island and creative. Use seeds to create unusual game worlds and share them with friends!
Enhance your Minecraft with even more diversity using addons and shaders. Addons introduce mobs, items, and features to the game, expanding its possibilities. Discover new types of animals, create your own companions, or add mechanisms. Shaders, on the other hand, enhance graphics and lighting, making the game more realistic and colorful. Use our add-ons and shaders to turn your Minecraft into a true masterpiece!
This application is a source of endless creativity and enjoyment for all Minecraft fans. Use our addons, maps, skins, textures, seeds and shaders to bring your boldest ideas to life in Minecraft.
DISCLAIMER:
This is an unofficial application for Minecraft PE. This application is not affiliated with Mojang AB in any way. The name, trademark, and assets of Minecraft are owned by Mojang AB or their rightful owners. All rights are reserved in accordance with https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/terms#terms-brand_guidelines.

bluejetty:00075982:ios.description:
“Coloring Garden - Whiteboard Pad” is the toddlers coloring book and flower terrarium where child’s doodles bloom! Paint this garden: draw and plant flowers, all your drawings will sprout like true plants and mushrooms, but in rainbow colors!
Do you love flowers, gardens, colors, and… sparkles? Then you will love “Coloring Garden - Whiteboard Pad”! In this terrarium coloring book, children can picture their own endless garden, filled with flower doodles, and choose from over 60 different plants, mushrooms, and pinwheels to draw, paint, plant and transform with magic potions.
With the app’s easy drawing tools, such as its glitter markers and rainbow crayons, kids and toddlers can easily decorate their sketches. And with the mushroom and plant identification feature, they can learn how to draw and identify flowers by either their scientific or common names such as daisy, rose, tulip, lily, violet, sunflower, clover, edelweiss, forget me not, and much more.
THIS TERRARIUM COLORING PAD IS FILLED WITH MAGICAL FEATURES:
• Glitter coloring book, like a paper sketchbook, drawing whiteboard, and sketchpad with wonderfully illustrated flower pictures to learn how to draw, sketch with pencil, and color.
• Plants guide for plant, flower and mushroom identification (daisy, rose, tulip, lily, violet, sunflower, clover, edelweiss, forget me not, and much more). Children and toddlers can learn to identify plants and mushrooms. 
• 100+ rainbow colors, glitter markers, crayons, and felt pens to decorate with brushstrokes.
• Terrarium of 60+ plants to paint, plant, and play
• Adorable characters such as Lola Slug and friends to play with
• Apple Pencil supported: in this coloring book kids can draw either by hand, by just coloring with a finger on the screen, or enjoying Apple Pencil. 
+ Plus, this garden coloring book for kids discloses a magic SECRET: 
Kids' drawings will spring to life, and they will bloom forever like true flowers, in rainbow, glitter colors!
Paint and grow your Coloring Garden now!
KID-SAFE DESIGN
• Designed for kids ages 3 and up. Simple, no reading skills needed. The flower pictures in this coloring book are outlines of garden flowers, designed to be easy even for toddlers and little children to color in.
• Works offline, no WI-FI needed, so that toddlers can play in peace even on the go. 
• Tested by experts in kids’ education so that it is safe and easy to use, even for toddlers, babies, and little kids. 
• No annoying advertising. 
• No purchase or subscription needed. Immediately after the download you get 5 free plants to color again and again whenever you want. If you want, you can add premium flowers and colors to make your garden even bigger. 
• Child safe, with integrated parental control. 
• For both boys and girls. Everyone is free to play different roles and experiment a wide range of abilities, styles, habits, and activities, such as building and destroying, painting, glitter decorating, crafting, tinkering, and vegan or omnivorous eating, so that “Coloring Garden - Rainbow Glitter” will be different at every time, depending on your kids’ creativity and mood! 
Download “Coloring Garden - Whiteboard Pad” and seed your dream garden now! 
***** About LOLA SLUG STUDIO *****
Lola Slug creates enchanting games for your children.
We work in close connection with university educational experts to provide modern kids with the same pure fun of our childhood. Our contents are designed to meet the cognitive needs of young children and to encourage their development through imaginative play. Most of our apps have a free demo; families can support our mission by purchasing additional content. With your support, we can continue to bring the joy of learning to kids all over the world.
CONTACTS:
support@lolaslug.com
www.lolaslug.com

bluejetty:00161252:ios.summary:
ARE YOU RELATED?
FaceIT combines Face Matching technology with access to DNA testing services in one app. Compare facial features, explore visible similarities, and when you want a more definitive answer, access paternity and other relation
bluejetty:00161252:ios.description:
ARE YOU RELATED?
FaceIT combines Face Matching technology with access to DNA testing services in one app. Compare facial features, explore visible similarities, and when you want a more definitive answer, access paternity and other relationship DNA testing options.
FACE & EYE MATCHING
Upload two photos and compare visible characteristics such as face shape, eyes, nose, chin, and other recognizable traits.
FaceIT evaluates visible similarities between two images and creates an easy-to-review Face Match report. Same-day Face Match results may be available when photos are uploaded before 4:00 PM Central Time.
COMPATIBILITY TOOLS
• Pro Package blood-type compatibility comparison
• Free eye-color compatibility chart
UNDERSTAND THE FEATURES
Learn about traits such as cleft chins, widow's peaks, dimples, and other facial characteristics. Visual examples help make the features in your report easier to understand.
DNA TESTING SERVICES
FaceIT also provides access to DNA testing when you need answers about biological relationships.
• Paternity testing
• Legal DNA testing
• Home DNA testing
• Prenatal DNA testing
• Sibling testing
• Grandparent testing
• Aunt and uncle testing
• Other relationship testing
HOME DNA TESTING
Order a home DNA kit and collect samples privately on your own schedule. Eligible home DNA results may be available in as little as 1 day after the laboratory receives the required samples.
OFFICE & LEGAL DNA TESTING
Visit a convenient testing location for professional sample collection. Depending on the service selected, results may be available in as little as 3 days.
Legal DNA testing is available for court proceedings, child support, custody, immigration, birth certificate changes, and other matters requiring proper identification and chain-of-custody procedures.
PRENATAL DNA TESTING
Explore prenatal DNA testing options designed to provide answers before birth. Use the app to learn about available testing and schedule an appointment.
SPECIALTY DNA TESTING
Testing may also be available for deceased individuals, Social Security benefit claims, immigration, adoption, surrogate-parent situations, and other biological relationship questions.
NATIONWIDE TESTING ACCESS
Access DNA testing services through thousands of collection locations across the United States. Mobile collection may also be available at a home, office, hospital, or other convenient location.
WITH THE FaceIT APP YOU CAN:
• Compare two faces
• Explore facial similarities
• Review face and eye characteristics
• Select from multiple Face Match packages
• Access same-day Face Match reports when eligible
• Use blood-type and eye-color compatibility tools
• Schedule DNA testing
• Order a home DNA kit
• Find DNA testing locations
• Access DNA test results
• Explore legal and non-legal testing options
• Learn about prenatal DNA testing
EASY ACCESS TO RESULTS
Access available Face Match and DNA testing information through the app. DNA test results may also be delivered by email, depending on the service selected.
FACE MATCHING VS. DNA TESTING
Face Matching is designed for personal and informational use. It compares visible facial characteristics and similarities between two people.
Face Matching does not confirm or deny a biological relationship. DNA testing is the appropriate method when you need to determine biological relationships.
WHY FaceIT?
FaceIT gives you two ways to explore the question many people are asking: Are You Related?
Start with a visual Face Match, explore facial and eye similarities, use available compatibility tools, and access DNA testing when you are ready for a biological relationship test.
Whether you are curious about resemblance, looking for paternity testing, exploring another family relationship, or want to better understand shared facial traits, FaceIT helps you take the next step.

bluejetty:00016189:ios.description:
If you love exotic village to city building games, then you'll love the City Island 3 - Building Sim! Join over 25 million players and start playing this popular city builder game today! Start on an exotic island with some cash and gold and from there begin building a city. Just start with constructing one house, expand that to a village, then create a city and try to expand it to metropolis.
If you liked our previous sim games: City Island 1 & 2, you will definitely love our third citybuilder game! This time you will have your own archipelago to build your cities! 
You can unlock a building and build it on an exotic tourist island paradise, on a vulcano island, a swamp, a desert and more! Really cool city building allows you to construct cities, villages, compounds or a metropolis. Build it as you like, but keep a close eye on balancing the amount of people, jobs, happiness points. Keep your citizens happy with beautiful decorations, earn pirate chests, and create jobs so you can earn money and gold from your happy citizens. 
People in your own city will provide quests and feedback on how well you are doing! Furthermore, you can decorate your village city by placing walking paths, rivers, railroads with trains, transport, parks and hundreds more fun and beautifully designed items. 
If you like playing free-to-play citygames, building a city in City Island 3: Building Sim is your best choice!
** FEATURES **
- Easy to play building sim
- Build and decorate beautiful islands of your own archipelago with more than 300 unique items, be creative!
- Fun FREE to play tycoon game
- Tablet support
- HIGH QUALITY graphics
- Intuitive gameplay with challenging tasks, rewards and achievements
- Enjoy fun quests to help you create your own virtual paradise in this free-to-play citygame!
- Currencies: gold and cash, pirate chests
- Attract citizens with parks, trees, a railway with trains, boats, decorations and community buildings
- Collect profit from your commercial buildings
- Upgrade your city buildings
- Help your citizens by building a city on this exotic island story
- Unlock transport to new islands
- Collect XP and level up to unlock a new building for construction
- Collect dozens of REWARDS while playing
- Expand your city to create more room for constructing more buildings, transport and progress your village to a metropolis with tall buildings
- Speed up construction / upgrade time
- Lots of adventure, pirate chests and quests to unlock
- Expand your city over land and sea
- Many hours of free fun
- No internet required! Play offline any time anywhere

bluejetty:00029391:ios.description:
Mona is a highly customizable Mastodon app with VoiceOver optimization and native design.
Post Actions
• Drag actions into the order you prefer
• Configure actions as swipe options: swipe a post horizontally to perform an action
• Optionally hide some or all action buttons from post cards, while keeping them accessible via context menu, swipe options, keyboard shortcuts, and VoiceOver rotor
iCloud Sync
• Sync your mute list, user notes, reading positions, drafts, search history, accent colors, and custom app themes across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac, privately and securely
• Optionally disable some features from automatic syncing
User Notes
• Privately set aliases, notes and username colors for other Mastodon users
• User Notes list: browse, organize and edit all your notes in one place
Game Controller (require iOS 14, iPadOS 14, macOS 11 or a newer system)
• Control the app and browse posts with a compatible game controller, such as a Playstation DualSense/DualShock, Nintendo Switch, Xbox or MFi controller
• Customize button functions via in-app settings
• Set extra functions for Adaptive Triggers on the Playstation DualSense controller
Privacy
• Mona does not collect any personal information
• Your account tokens are protected by on-device Keychain
• Your network connections to Mastodon servers are protected by HTTPS
Other Mona features:
• Full Screen mode on iPhone let your timeline content fill the entire screen once you start scrolling
• Column View takes full advantage of the big screen on iPad and Mac, shows multiple views at once and allows you to navigate between views fluently and efficiently
• Check recent posts on your home screen or notification center with widgets
• Search posts on the Timeline
• Adjustable text spacing
• Adjustable and adaptive text sizes
• Option to display post source on timeline (e.g. Mona for Mac)
• Share a post as picture
• Open multiple windows on iPad and Mac
• Customizable text translation experience
• Automatic video and GIF playback on timelines
• Supports changing app icon on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Turn on/off content scaling on Mac for extra screen estate or sharper text
• Autocomplete for post composer
• Push notifications
• Lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID
• Mona Pro and Mona Pro Max available as one-time in-app purchases, with 14-day free trial
Tab Bar (Mona Pro feature)
• Pin your frequently visit pages to the tab bar
• Drag tabs into the order you prefer
• Rename your tabs
• Change your tab icons (more than a thousand of icons for you to choose)
• Show/hide tab names and button shapes
Accent Color (Mona Pro feature)
• Configure different Accent Colors for Light and Dark mode
• More than 10 built-in colors for you to choose
• Design and set custom colors
Theme Editor (Mona Pro feature)
• Customize the app’s color scheme
• Design and set custom themes
• Advanced color settings allow you to fine-tune colors for different level of views
• Export and share your custom themes
• Import custom themes shared by other people
Font Customization (Mona Pro feature)
• Configure different fonts for body text and headings
• Select from a variety of build-in fonts
• Supports custom fonts installed by third-party apps
Other Mona Pro features:
• Full-featured post composer: write longer posts, attach pictures and videos, create polls, schedule post, and automatic thread conversion
• More post actions: including favorite, repost, quote post, add bookmark, and translate
• Add multiple accounts: you can also opt to favorite, repost, quote post, or follow using a non-current account
• Filter and mute: filter timelines based on post category and content; hide posts with certain words; hide posts from certain people
• Customize push notifications based on notification category
• Export and import settings: easily transfer your custom settings between multiple devices
Customer support:
• Mastodon: @MonaApp@mastodon.social
• Email: theSpringApp@gmail.com

bluejetty:00013805:ios.name: An Post: Track & Manage
bluejetty:00013805:ios.summary: Manage all your post and parcel needs in one place with the An Post app. Track deliveries, buy Digital Stamps, calculate postage, return packages, and locate nearby post offices with ease. Simplify sending, receiving, and managing your post
bluejetty:00013805:ios.description:
Manage all your post and parcel needs in one place with the An Post app. Track deliveries, buy Digital Stamps, calculate postage, return packages, and locate nearby post offices with ease. Simplify sending, receiving, and managing your post - all at your fingertips. Download now.
Track & Trace:
Track & Trace allows you to track parcel delivery simple and reliable. You can track your parcel online from arrival to A Post right through until the item is delivered. Save your tracking numbers to track packages from all your online shopping and sending!
Digital stamp:
Buy your digital stamp through the app and send your post at a time that suits you. You can now deliver anywhere in the world with our International Digital Stamps. We'll even notify you once your post has been delivered. 
Postbox drop off:
Postbox drop off is a convenient way to send prepaid tracked items using the An Post app. Simply find a participating postbox near you, confirm your location, scan your item's barcode and drop it off. You can then track your item's journey in the app.
Click & Post:
Our Click & Post service offers a fast and convenient way to purchase postage labels or book a shopping return online all at the touch of a button. Use our postage calculator to check the cost based on your item and destination by entering what you want to send and where it’s going. Once the postage label has been purchased, you print the postage label, attach it to your item and drop it off at your nearest post office. If you don’t have a printer, we will print it for you in the post office.
Returns:
Take the hassle out of returning items with Click & Post. Simply book your return online and decide whether to have your item collected at a time that suits you or drop it off at your nearest post office or other drop off locations. If you are having your returns item collected, there is no need to print any returns label. With our returns label free service, the postal operative will have done this for you before they collect the item.
In App Account Registration:
An Post My Account allows you to manage all your activity with An Post from one convenient place. Track and manage deliveries, buy postage, review transactions and more with your one stop shop for An Post products and services. Set up a business or personal account today.
Online shop:
Our online shop gives users the full post office experience online. Customers can purchase from our full suite of stamps, buy postage labels, pre-paid packaging as well as our top selling mobile phones.
Paying Customs Charges:
If an item is coming from outside the EU, Irish Revenue will apply a customs charge. This customs charge must be paid to An Post within 22 calendar days for your item to be released for delivery. Customers can pay this charge easily online using their tracking ID and customs reference number. There is information provided to assist customers paying the charge, along with Frequently Asked Questions.
Store locator:
You can use our store locator to search for a Post office, Post point or Parcel locker by entering the county either using our map view or list view.
Contact us:
You can contact us using our online form or by contacting us on the following numbers:
Post and Parcels enquiries: 353 (1) 705 7600

bluejetty:00042237:ios.description:
Build habits that stick. Track routines. Crush your to-dos. All in one app.
Habit Hub is the all-in-one habit tracker, routine timer, and to-do list trusted by thousands of users with a 4.7-star rating. Whether you're building a morning routine, tracking water intake, or managing ADHD — Habit Hub keeps you focused, motivated, and on track.
SMART COLOR-CODED TIMELINE
Your habits line up by time of day — red when needs attention, yellow when upcoming, green when done. One glance tells you exactly what to do next. No overthinking. Just action.
BUILD ANY ROUTINE — TIMERS, BREATHING & TASKS
Create multi-step routines that mix and match timers, guided breathing exercises, and simple checkbox tasks in any order. Your morning routine could be: make bed (task) → 5-minute meditation (timer) → box breathing (breathing) → take vitamins (task) → 10-minute workout (timer). Hit play and flow through each step. No other app lets you combine all three.
STREAKS & TRACK RECORD
Never break your streak. See your performance by week or month with a color-coded calendar. Tap any past day to update your history. Share your progress with friends.
ONE-TIME TO-DOS
Not everything repeats. Add quick to-dos alongside your habits — reschedule, skip, or knock them out today. One app for everything.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULING
Daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, specific days — set any frequency. Multiple times a day (like "drink water 8x"). Goal-based tracking (like "sleep 8 hours"). Your schedule, your rules.
HOME & LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
See your habits at a glance without opening the app. Multiple widget sizes for your home screen and lock screen.
AUTOMATIC ICLOUD SYNC
Your data syncs seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Never lose your progress.
WHY HABIT HUB?
• Replaces your habit tracker, routine timer, and to-do app
• ADHD-friendly — color-coded visual cues, automatic reminders, one thing at a time
• Smart repeating reminders that nudge you like a personal assistant
• Complete habits from notifications, widgets, or Siri Shortcuts
• Free to start — unlock unlimited habits with a one-time purchase

- Adjusts around injuries and limitations
- Helps you stay on track when equipment changes

bluejetty:00119373:ios.summary: There has never been a better time to get into XMPP, a free public chat network no one controls or owns. Monal is a fast and user friendly way to use XMPP. Just download the app, login or register and you are ready to chat in minutes. It l
bluejetty:00119373:ios.description:
There has never been a better time to get into XMPP, a free public chat network no one controls or owns. Monal is a fast and user friendly way to use XMPP. Just download the app, login or register and you are ready to chat in minutes. It looks and works the way other apps do, so there is no need to “learn XMPP” or even care what it is.
Notable features:
- Open Source
- No Ads! Strong focus on privacy. Does not phone home and does not have software "metrics" 
- Does not read any personal information
- With a direct connection to your server, your password and all other info are never sent to a third-party
- OMEMO encrypted chat
- Will work with corporate XMPP servers that require VPN
- Multi user chat (MUC) support for group chats
- Audio/Video calls
Implements certain XMPP extensions intended to improve mobile communication:
- XEP-0357: Push Notifications
- XEP-0280: Message Carbons keep messages in synch between clients
- XEP-0198: Stream Management to quickly reconnect
- XEP-0199: XMPP Ping to maintain connections
- XEP-0313: Message Archive Management to download chat history
- XEP-0352: Client State Indication for dramatic reduction on power use
- XEP-0363: HTTP File Upload to send images in conversations

By starting with small, achievable habits, you can gradually build long-term, sustainable routines. The app integrates the Pomodoro Technique to combine time management and focus training, helping you stay efficient and self-disciplined in study, work, and daily life.
===Why Choose Tiny Habits===
1、Backed by Science: Built on proven theories from Mini Habits and Atomic Habits for effective habit formation.
2、Precision Time Management: Combines the Pomodoro Technique with a time-tracking system to help manage schedules, enhance focus, and develop deep work habits.
3、Visual Progress Feedback: Detailed tracking and data analysis help you monitor progress and optimize habit-building strategies.
4、Comprehensive Self-Discipline Training: Supports study tracking, health goals, and lifestyle improvements to eliminate procrastination and build positive habits.
===What Can You Track with Tiny Habits===
1、Study Tracking: Track study hours for exams, reading, and certifications.
2、Health & Fitness: Manage weight loss, exercise, running, yoga, and sleep habits.
3、Focus & Deep Work: Use the Pomodoro Timer to improve concentration and eliminate distractions.
4、Self-Improvement: Set reminders for hydration, budgeting, and daily planning.
5、Journaling & Reflection: Record daily habit progress to reinforce long-term growth.
===Key Features===
1、Smart Habit Management – Customize habit plans with flexible tracking options.
2、Time Management & Reminders – Use Pomodoro Timers, countdowns, and alerts to stay on track.
3、Progress Tracking & Reflection – Daily, weekly, and monthly reports with journaling features.
4、Goal Tracking & Countdown – Keep important milestones visible to maintain motivation.
5、Focus Mode (App Locking) – Minimize distractions and improve productivity.
6、Widgets & Study Room – Quick access to habit tracking and personal study space.
7、Ad-Free & Minimalist Design – Clean, distraction-free experience focused on productivity.
Description of Automatic Renewal Service for Tiny Habits Members
【Subscription cycle】
Continuous annual subscription (1 year)
【Subscription price】
The automatic renewal fee for continuous annual membership is 38 yuan/year
【Payment】
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
【Automatic Renewal】
The renewal fee will be charged from your iTunes account 24 hours before the expiration of the current subscription period, and one subscription period will be extended after the deduction is successful.
[Cancel Automatic Renewal]
If you need to cancel the subscription, please manually open the iOS "Settings" --> click "Apple ID", select to view "Apple ID", enter the account settings page, click "Subscribe", and cancel the subscription. This subscription will automatically renew if it is not closed at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period.

bluejetty:00160923:ios.description:
The easiest way to meet Bitcoiners, discover events, find merchants, and use bitcoin.
Club Orange is the members-only Bitcoin network connecting more than 20,000 Bitcoiners across 80 countries.
Find local Bitcoiners who share your values. Discover Bitcoin meetups and conferences around the world. Find nearby merchants that accept bitcoin. Buy bitcoin through supported partners and receive the sats directly in your self-custodial wallet.
Download Club Orange and find your Bitcoin people.
CLUB ORANGE FEATURES
MEET BITCOINERS NEAR YOU
• Discover Bitcoiners in your city or anywhere in the world
• Find people who share your interests, values, and conviction
• Connect with founders, builders, developers, investors, creators, organizers, and merchants
• Build real friendships with people who understand why Bitcoin matters
DISCOVER BITCOIN EVENTS
• Explore more than 700 Bitcoin-only meetups, conferences, workshops, and gatherings
• Find events happening near you or around the world
• RSVP and see who else is attending
• Access live conference agendas with stages, speakers, and sessions
• Join event chats before, during, and after each event
BUILD YOUR BITCOIN NETWORK
• Send direct messages to Bitcoiners around the world
• Create private or public group chats
• Share photos, videos, voice messages, and video messages
• Discover who is active or recently arrived in your city
• Stay connected with your local Bitcoin community
FIND MERCHANTS THAT ACCEPT BITCOIN
• Discover nearby businesses that accept bitcoin
• Explore merchants on the map
• Find places where you can spend sats
• Support the growing Bitcoin circular economy
BUY BITCOIN THROUGH SUPPORTED PARTNERS
• Access supported Bitcoin purchase providers through Club Orange
• Choose an amount and complete your purchase with the selected provider
• Receive your sats directly in your self-custodial Club Orange wallet
• No exchange withdrawal or address copying required
Bitcoin purchases are completed by independent third-party providers, not Club Orange. Provider availability, eligibility, limits, and fees vary by country.
SELF-CUSTODIAL BITCOIN WALLET
• Send and receive bitcoin over Lightning
• Send and receive bitcoin on-chain
• Keep control of your wallet and recovery phrase
• Lock your wallet using your device biometrics
• Search and manage your transaction history
SEND SATS SOCIALLY
• Zap nearby Bitcoiners with ProximityZap
• Send sats to members in a city or country with GeoZap
• Find and zap people who share your interests with BioZap
• Send sats directly through profiles and chats
Club Orange is for people who believe Bitcoin is better with friends.
STACK FRIENDS WHO STACK SATS
Formerly known as Orange Pill App.
Club Orange is members-only. Memberships start at $3.99 per month and are charged to your Apple account.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged within 24 hours before renewal. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store settings.
All photos are of models and are used for illustrative purposes only.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.cluborange.org/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00015722:ios.name: Matching games: toddlers, kids
bluejetty:00015722:ios.developer: Kids Academy Co apps: Preschool & Kindergarten Learning Kids Games, Educational Books, Free Songs
bluejetty:00015722:ios.summary:
*** Fun EDUCATIONAL game for toddlers of AGE 2 and up
*** SORT AND CLASSIFY by shape, color, seasons, vehicles, and much more
*** Developed with certified child psychologists
*** 12 beautiful mini-game boards
About the game:
--------------
bluejetty:00015722:ios.description:
*** Fun EDUCATIONAL game for toddlers of AGE 2 and up
*** SORT AND CLASSIFY by shape, color, seasons, vehicles, and much more
*** Developed with certified child psychologists
*** 12 beautiful mini-game boards
About the game:
-----------------
This is the first and most simple game in the TinyHands Sorting series.
The game consists of 12 beautiful environments each focused on a set of basic concepts from the child's world such as shapes, colors, seasons, and animals.
The game is designed to enhance the following skills:
- Sorting and classifying
- Hand-eye coordination
- Concentration
- Visual perception
- Vocabulary
Game Boards:
The game consists of 12 boards ordered in an ascending level of difficulty.
The boards were carefully chosen in order to represent basic concepts from the child's world.
The field: Sort butterflies by COLOR.
Dogs screen: Classify dogs by SIZE.
Star, heart, and circle screen: Classify geometric SHAPES.
The laundry: Classify by COLOR.
Triangle, star, circle and square screen: Classify objects by their SHAPES.
Koalas: Sort clothes by their SIZE.
Circle, triangle, orange and green screen: Classify by SHAPES AND COLOR.
Squirrels screen: Classify squirrels by SIZE.
My food screen: Classify by ANIMALS TYPICAL FOOD
Day and night screen: Contextually sort objects by TIME OF DAY 
My house screen: Classify animals by their HABITAT
Summer and winter screen: Contextually sort by SEASON 
TinyHands Games:
TinyHands Sorting Series
A set of sorting games designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as shape, color, size seasons and animals. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level starting from basic sorting followed by more complex context based sorting and classification environments.
TinyHands Towers Series
A set of stacking games. The game is designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as: big VS. small, before VS. after, and bottom VS. top. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level.
TinyHands What's My Pair Series
A series of three pair matching games. The game challenges the child to match pairs, initially based on visual aspects alone and in more advanced screens based on logic and understanding of card content.
TinyHands First Words Series
A set of vocabulary games for children of age 1.5 and up.
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles.
TinyHands Raccoon TreeHouse
This game is intended for toddlers aged 3+. The game presents 12 boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Town Center
Educational game recommended for age 3+. This game includes 10 beautiful boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Connect The Dots
The game consists of 12 mini game boards each presents a beautiful and magical scene. Each board contains several parts. The parts can be completed by connecting the numbered dots in a specific order. Upon completion, each part is dragged to gradually build an object. When all parts are drawn the scene is magically created and revealed. Designed for children aged 3+.
Note for parents:
Like all our games, this game is designed to provide quality playtime for parents and children together. Playing along with your children is highly recommended and will surely make them benefit the most from this app and help them expand their vocabulary.
We are sure that your children will enjoy this exciting educational game that will encourage their thinking and contribute to the development of their basic skills.

bluejetty:00028809:ios.description:
Pass your SIE with flying colors! Boost your confidence in passing the first time with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.
The Securities Industry Essentials® (SIE®) Exam is a FINRA exam for prospective securities industry professionals. This introductory-level exam assesses a candidate’s knowledge of basic securities industry information including concepts fundamental to working in the industry, such as types of products and their risks; the structure of the securities industry markets, regulatory agencies and their functions; and prohibited practices.
Follow a specially designed personal study plan and train yourself to pass the first time!

- Choose from different topics required to pass a certification
- Practice with 700+ questions
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
- - - -
Purchases, subscriptions and terms
You need to buy a lifetime access or subscribe to get access to all features, courses and questions. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed at the rate and period selected depending on the subscription plan. Users’ accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00154107:ios.description:
Three Gifts Before You Go – When love is wrapped in every little thing.
There are things we can’t hold onto forever.
But love — love can stay, if we’re gentle enough to place it in the smallest of gifts.
Three Gifts Before You Go is an emotional point-and-click puzzle game that follows the quiet journey of a mother. In silence, she explores the home, gathers memories, solves gentle puzzles, and crafts three meaningful gifts — a final way to hold on, just a little longer, to someone who is preparing to leave.
 Key Features of Before You Go:
- Simple and heartfelt point-and-click gameplay: Explore intimate spaces and uncover hidden moments.
- Gentle puzzles with emotional depth: Designed to engage the mind while quietly touching the heart.
- A subtle, symbolic story: Told not through words, but through objects, memories, and quiet discovery.
- Handcrafted visuals with a warm, nostalgic tone: Soft colors and minimal design that evoke comfort and familiarity.
- Soothing, emotional sound design: Music and ambient sounds that carry the story without saying a word.
Before You Go is made for those who seek:
- Emotional puzzle experiences
- Quiet, story-rich point-and-click adventures
- Symbolic storytelling with heart
- Reflective, healing gameplay moments
Download Three Gifts Before You Go now – and let this quiet story unfold in your hands, just as a mother prepares her last gifts for the one she cannot walk with any further.

bluejetty:00120860:ios.description:
Command the Stars in AQ: First Contact – The Ultimate Space Strategy MMO!
Take your place as Commander in this thrilling real-time strategy (RTS) space game. Start with a single Corvette and build your war fleet into an unstoppable armada of Titan-class starships. Customize your ships with powerful weapons, advanced upgrades, and unique abilities to conquer the galaxy in this online multiplayer game.
FEATURES
- Epic Space Fleet Battles: Create and upgrade your fleet with Corvettes, Destroyers, Battleships, and massive Titans, each fully customizable with sci-fi weaponry and tech.
- Real-Time PvP & Co-op: Join intense 3v3 multiplayer battles or team up with friends in guilds and alliances to dominate the galaxy.
- Cross-Platform MMO: Play with players worldwide on mobile or PC. Sync your progress and never miss a moment in this sci-fi strategy MMO.
- PvE & Exploration: Take on space pirates, raiders, and xeno invaders in campaign missions, then explore vast open-world space zones for resources, rare loot, and new tech.
- Resource Management and Base Building: Mine, salvage, and manage resources. Upgrade your space station, build mines, fighter hangars, and shield generators to defend your territory.
- Alliance Warfare: Join or create corporations, declare war, forge alliances, and capture strategic outposts and sectors to expand your influence.
- Events & Rewards: Compete in daily and weekly live events for legendary rewards.
- In-Depth Crafting: Upgrade equipment, forge legendary weapons, and customize your arsenal for your personal playstyle.
- Global Chat & Social Play: Plan strategies in global chat or create private channels for your alliance and friends.
Experience the next generation of sci-fi warfare, base building, and interstellar conquest. Download now and command your fleet to victory in the ultimate space MMO RTS!

Privacy Policy: https://www.aqfirstcontact.com/privacy

bluejetty:00078724:ios.description:
One membership. Many ways to get stronger.
The VASA Fitness app puts your VASA experience in one place, making it easy to plan your workouts, explore classes and locations, reserve your spot, and get more from your membership. Because you're Built to Be Strong.
FIND YOUR NEXT WORKOUT
Explore class schedules and discover different ways to get stronger. Find Group Fitness classes or book coach-led Studio experiences like Red HIIT, Flow infrared yoga, and LFT strength training, all from the app.
GET PERSONALIZED SUPPORT
Ready for more one-on-one support? Book a Personal Training Consultation in the app to talk about your goals and find the right path forward.
MORE LOCATIONS. MORE WAYS TO MOVE.
Find VASA clubs near you and explore what each location has to offer, including strength and cardio equipment, recovery amenities, basketball, and more. View class schedules for each club and discover new ways to make progress.
MAKE TIME FOR YOU
Book KidCare appointments in advance so you can make your workout part of the day. You can also manage your KidCare information and upcoming reservations from the app.
PLAN AHEAD
View your schedule and manage upcoming class and KidCare reservations in one place, so you know what’s next before you arrive.
CHECK IN AND GET TO WORK
Access your member barcode for a quick club check-in, view your membership details, and manage your account when you need to.
However you like to move, VASA gives you more ways to make progress and discover what you’re capable of. Use the app to find what works for you and keep building from there.

• File-sharing and P2P support
• Secure Core servers protect against network-based attacks with multi-hop VPN
• Tor over VPN provides automatic integration with the Tor anonymity network

• Easy-to-use VPN app for iPhone, iPad, visionOS, tvOS, Mac, and any other major devices
• Highest strength encryption for your connection makes it better than an internet proxy
• One tap Connect to secure your internet connection, especially on public Wifi hotspots

• Proton VPN's Secure Core architecture allows our secure VPN service to defend against network-based attacks
• We only use VPN protocols that are proven to be secure: WireGuard
• Independently audited by third-party security experts and we publish all results on our website
• Trusted open-source code that can be reviewed for security by anyone
• Data protection using AES-256 and 4096 RSA encryption
Join the privacy revolution
