bluejetty:00069878:ios.description:
Tabata interval training is the single most effective type of high intensity interval training, it's also the most intense by far, and surprisingly it's the shortest in duration: only lasts for four minutes... but those four minutes produce remarkable effects. According to the Japanese founder, Professor Izumi Tabata, one of his four-minute sessions is equal to an hour of jogging, an hour of moderate cycling, two hours of walking, an hour of Zumba or two hours of yoga. What’s not to like?
Quite a lot, actually. The idea is to increase your heart rate to its maximum by “going completely mental” for 240 seconds. This is supposed to give you both aerobic and anaerobic benefits (both cardio and muscle workout). But we’re talking about four minutes of pain.
The full Tabata program is four minutes long. It will probably be the longest four minutes of your life.
If you are going to try it, we would recommend going light with the weights until you find your range, there’s a good chance you will underestimate this workout and be begging people around you to help you off the floor.
Tabata intervals follow this structure:
 Push hard for 20 seconds
 Rest for 10 seconds.
 Repeat this eight times.
The secret of this effective is in your sprint interval. You have to go all out, so do as many reps as you can in 20 seconds, put it down for 10, then pick it up again and go hell for another 20 seconds....
Our customers around the world:

Now, let's focus on your exercises and we handle the rest
Run in foreground, background and screen locked, Tabata Timer allows you to specify an overall time as well as program Cycles, Warm Up time, Train/Rest interval and Cool down time. 
+ Flexible and Advanced Timer
+ Clean, simple and easy to use (There is no learning curve here)
+ Customize your own timer with some taps
+ Fully customized timers with a complex of cycles and sets,
+ Run in the background, foreground, screen locked
+ Color, Voice and Sound Navigations (Customizable)
+ Built in Music Player (in sync with iOS Music Player)
+ Multiple themes to select
+ Manage your timers and data of training (you can edit and even delete unwanted time data)
+ Create your own alarms right in the app
+ Work on iPhone, iPad and iPod (Universal)
+ And a lot more features will be added in over time.

bluejetty:00015120:ios.summary: Kids like to draw and they also like dogs. Dogs are the most devoted friends. You can teach your cute puppy different commands. You can play ball, travel, and just take care of it. Dogs also have a great nose and are the best detectives! In
bluejetty:00015120:ios.description:
Kids like to draw and they also like dogs. Dogs are the most devoted friends. You can teach your cute puppy different commands. You can play ball, travel, and just take care of it. Dogs also have a great nose and are the best detectives! In exchange for their service, each dog dreams about a tasty bone! In this coloring book, you will find exciting scenes from the life of dogs of various breeds.
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

bluejetty:00127576:ios.name: Music Info — Song Metadata
bluejetty:00127576:ios.summary:
Music Info allows you to view information about songs in your library, including play count, skip count, release date, date added, album artist, composer, genre, year, comments, lyrics, and more.*
"Apple's Music app on macOS surfaces all k
bluejetty:00127576:ios.description:
Music Info allows you to view information about songs in your library, including play count, skip count, release date, date added, album artist, composer, genre, year, comments, lyrics, and more.*
"Apple's Music app on macOS surfaces all kinds of information about the songs you're listening to … But for reasons unknown, that isn't the case with the iOS version of Music. But as Apple likes to say, there's an app for that."
—iMore
Convenient ways to view info
-- Open the app to see the song that’s currently playing in the Music app, and it will automatically update when the song changes
-- Select a song from your library
-- Look up a song using Music Recognition powered by Shazam
-- Drag and drop a song from Music into the app
-- Get info directly in the Music app from the share sheet — yes, this app adds the missing Get Info button!
-- Add the widget to view info about the song currently playing in the Music app, and edit it to customize which song properties are visible — available for your Home Screen, iPad lock screen, CarPlay, and StandBy
More features
-- Reorder or hide information
-- Tap and hold to copy information or artwork
-- Select words in lyrics to look up, translate, copy, or share
-- Play the selected song in the app
-- Light and dark mode
-- App Shortcuts
-- Home Screen quick actions
-- Menu bar, keyboard shortcuts, and multiple windows on iPad
-- No ads, no tracking, no subscriptions
How it works
-- The Music app, like iTunes before it, saves metadata for each song you have in your library. Music Info reveals this information that otherwise isn’t accessible on iPhone and iPad.
-- All songs in your library can be accessed in the Music Info app, no matter if they were added via Apple Music, purchased, matched, uploaded, or otherwise synced to your device. Songs in Apple Music that haven’t been added to your library have limited information available.
-- The share sheet action is available when sharing a song in the Music app. Note that only songs that are available on Apple Music can be shared. Music Info will try to look up that song in your library which may require an internet connection. It’s possible it may not be able to find the right song, for example, if you’ve renamed it. If that is the case, you can still use the app to access its information even without an internet connection.
Things to note
-- Song metadata cannot be edited on iOS and iPadOS
-- You do not need to be an Apple Music subscriber to use the app
-- Music Info does not work with any third-party music services
-- Lyrics must be added to your songs via Music or iTunes on your Mac or PC
Music Info Unlimited
-- View information of 15 songs for free
-- Purchase the full version for unlimited access on all your devices
-- One-time in-app purchase, no recurring payments
*All available metadata:
-- Artwork
-- Title
-- Artist
-- Album
-- Album Artist
-- Composer
-- Grouping
-- Genre
-- Year
-- Track
-- Disc
-- Compilation
-- Rating
-- Explicit
-- Beats per Minute
-- Duration
-- Start
-- Stop
-- Release Date
-- Date Added
-- Plays
-- Last Played
-- Skips
-- Last Skipped
-- Comments
-- Lyrics

-- All songs in your library can be accessed in the Music Info app, no matter if they were added via Apple Music, purchased, matched, uploaded, or otherwise synced to your device. Songs in Apple Music that haven’t been added to your library have limited information available.
-- The share sheet action is available when sharing a song in the Music app. Note that only songs that are available on Apple Music can be shared. Music Info will try to look up that song in your library which may require an internet connection. It’s possible it may not be able to find the right song, for example, if you’ve renamed it. If that is the case, you can still use the app to access its information even without an internet connection.

Things to note
-- Song metadata cannot be edited on iOS and iPadOS
-- You do not need to be an Apple Music subscriber to use the app
-- Music Info does not work with any third-party music services
-- Lyrics must be added to your songs via Music or iTunes on your Mac or PC

Music Info Unlimited
-- View information of 15 songs for free
-- Purchase the full version for unlimited access on all your devices
-- One-time in-app purchase, no recurring payments

bluejetty:00122144:ios.summary: Dive into the relaxing and refreshing atmosphere of Swim Out, a strategic, turn-based puzzle game, that will transport you into a sunny day by the swimming pool, the river or the sea. Plan each of your strokes wisely and be sure to never cr
bluejetty:00122144:ios.description:
Dive into the relaxing and refreshing atmosphere of Swim Out, a strategic, turn-based puzzle game, that will transport you into a sunny day by the swimming pool, the river or the sea. Plan each of your strokes wisely and be sure to never cross any other swimmer's path if you want to peacefully enjoy the sea view on a cosy chaise-longue.
• "If you're a fan of puzzle games Swim Out is very likely for you. It's attractive, intuitive, and fun." - Touch Arcade
• "Swim Out looks like the perfect tactical escape into a lush digital paradise" - Touch Arcade
• "Swim Out is a perfect summertime game" - MacStories
• "I am delighted by how unfamiliar a swimming experience this is to me" - Rock, Paper, Shotgun
• "There are precious few things I appreciate more than a straightforward puzzle game with a strong commitment to its aesthetic, and Swim Out is exactly that" - Waypoint
• Over 100 levels nestled in carefully crafted landscapes, soothed by the sound of seagulls, frogs or water splashes.
• 7 chapters combining :
 - 12 different types of swimmers : each with their own way of moving around, ranging from the simple breaststroke swimmers to the more complex divers or cheeky water-bombing kids
 - 12 different objects to interact with : buoys, fins, water guns, you can even ride a kayak!
 - 6 disruptive environmental elements like waves, crabs or jellyfish that will give your brain a work out until you swim out!
• iCloud sync
• 15 GameCenter achievements
• 28 iMessage Stickers
• Support for all iPhones and iPads
• Play with your Xbox One, PS4 or MFi controller
Awards and recognition:
• "GDC Summer 2020" Artwork selected at GDC Artists gallery
• "TIGA Games Industry Awards 2018" Finalist, Creativity Award, Strategy Game
• "Indie Prize 2018" Finalist
• "Ping Awards 2017" Finalist, Mobile Game
• "TIGA Games Industry Awards 2017" Finalist, Puzzle Game

bluejetty:00035879:ios.description:
Immerse Yourself in the Fantasy World of Dog Tea Master: Mukbang ASMR, an Addictive Pet Mukbang Simulation Game! Step into a soothing and delightful space where you become an adorable dog enjoying a delicious boba milk tea feast. Experience the fun of mukbang role-play as you step into the paws of our perfect star, crafting and sipping boba tea alongside savoring mouth-watering hamburgers. Whether you are a fan of pet mukbang or simply enjoy mukbang culture, this game delivers a unique experience.
PLAY AS A DOG 
Step into the paws of the show’s perfect star. In Dog Tea Master: Mukbang ASMR, you take on the role of a dog and live the life of a master mukbang performer. Every bite and sip becomes an exciting event as you dive into the thrilling world of ASMR mukbang. Enjoy the flavors in this pet mukbang adventure while the world watches your live pet mukbang broadcast . The combination of mukbang and dog simulation brings a fresh take to the genre.
CREATE & ENJOY MUKBANG TEA 
In this unique dog simulation game, unleash your creativity in a fun DIY boba tea simulator. Brew, shake, and mix your bubble tea, then dive into the delicious sips that are a true feast for your ears. Immerse yourself in the soothing Pet ASMR sounds, bringing pure relaxation and calmness. This game offers a perfect blend of mukbang with Pet ASMR, allowing players to unwind in an engaging environment.
DRESS TO IMPRESS 
Make your live streams even more engaging by customizing your dog companion with adorable outfits. Style up and impress your audience with fashionable themes in this dog mukbang adventure. Whether you’re into mukbang, Pet ASMR, or dog simulation, this game brings together a variety of fun activities. Plus, you can switch between different dog breeds for even more fun!
PREPARE FOR CUTENESS OVERLOAD 
Enjoy ultra-cute, healing visuals, filled with adorableness at every corner. Paired with unique dog ASMR features, this relaxing simulation game offers maximum stress relief and enjoyment for fans of Pet ASMR and Pet Mukbang alike.
Experience endless joy and tranquility with Dog Tea Master: Mukbang ASMR. Unleash your inner dog in this pet mukbang simulation game, create your perfect drink, and enjoy the adorable fun. Download now and become the ultimate master mukbang and master ASMR performer!

bluejetty:00032182:ios.description:
The Uniswap Wallet app is self-custody crypto wallet with zero app fees on swaps. The Uniswap Wallet app is built for swapping and puts you in control of your crypto assets, while you buy crypto, browse NFT collections, explore Web3 apps, and swap tokens.
Swap & Manage Crypto Assets Safely
- Swap tokens across Ethereum, Unichain, Base, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, and other EVM-compatible blockchains
- View all of your crypto & NFT assets in one place without switching chains
- Safely send and receive crypto tokens with other wallets
- MEV protection for your Ethereum swaps
- Easily create a new Ethereum wallet and claim a username, or import your existing crypto wallet
- Use your credit card or bank account to buy crypto, including Ethereum (ETH), Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC), and USD Coin (USDC)
Real-Time Insights & Notifications
- Discover top crypto tokens on Uniswap by market cap, price or volume
- Monitor token prices & charts with real-time data across Ethereum and other chains
- Review token stats, descriptions and warning labels before trading
- Receive push notifications for completed transactions, even if made on another app or device
Explore Crypto Apps & Games
- Seamlessly connect to various onchain apps with Uniswap Wallet through WalletConnect
- Search & view any wallet, token, or NFT collection on Ethereum
- Favorite tokens and crypto wallet addresses for easy access
- Track NFT collection floor prices and volume
- Curate and showcase your NFTs with Uniswap Wallet’s NFT gallery view
Secure Your Crypto Assets
- Store your crypto recovery phrase in the iPhone secure enclave so it never leaves your device without permission
- Backup your recovery phrase to iCloud in an encrypted file so you can easily, but securely access it
- Require Face ID to access your crypto wallet and make transactions
- Source code audited by security firm Trail of Bits
--
Uniswap Wallet App Supported Chains:
Ethereum (ETH), Unichain (UNI), Avalanche (AVAX), Polygon (POL), Arbitrum (ARB), Optimism (OP), Base, BNB Chain (BNB), Blast (BLAST), Zoracles (ZORA), Celo (CGLD), Monad (MON), Soneium, zkSync (ZK) and World Chain (WLD)
--
For additional questions, email support@uniswap.org. For product updates, follow @uniswap on X/Twitter.

bluejetty:00039075:ios.description:
Welcome to Our Global Short Film Streaming Service
SAMANSA offers unlimited access to award-winning short films under 20 minutes long created by talented filmmakers from all over the world!
【What is SAMANSA?】
SAMANSA allows you to enjoy short films that have won awards and nominations at renowned film festivals around the world, through its app and website.
・Our service contracts directly with filmmakers and distributors for each individual film.
・Supports English, Japanese, Korean, Thai, and Indonesian language subtitles.
【The Appeal of SAMANSA】
・All films are about 5 to 20 minutes long! Enjoy high-quality movies at any time and place, whether it's during your commute or in your spare time.
・New films are added every week!
・Packed with a wide range of genres including drama, horror, sci-fi, documentaries, and comedy! You can choose films based on your favorite genre, medium, mood, or free time from the search screen.
・Plenty of films have won awards or been nominated at numerous film festivals, including the Academy Awards and Cannes Film Festival! You can also easily enjoy high-quality movies from various countries around the world such as Asia, America, Europe, the Middle East, and Scandinavia.
・Add your favorite films to "Playlist." You can watch whatever you want, whenever and wherever you want.
・The film viewing page also includes features for sharing and commenting. You can share and discuss opinions with other users or share recommended films.
・Start with a 7-day free trial! Enjoy colorful days with SAMANSA!
【Recommended for those who:】
・Want to enjoy authentic movies, but don't have much time.
・Want to make effective use of their spare time.
・Are interested in watching short films from around the world that are rarely seen in your country.
・Want to discover unseen works, directors, and actors.
・Are interested in experiencing foreign cultures and languages.

bluejetty:00184121:ios.description:
Welcome to ETPCU Mobile Banking. You are one step closer to having access to ETPCU whenever, wherever you are. It’s fast, secure and a free way to get 24/7 access to your ETPCU accounts from your mobile phone or tablet.
With ETPCU Mobile Banking you can:
-View account balances and transaction history
-Transfer funds between accounts
-View and pay bills
-Find an ETPCU branch or ATM close to your iPhone’s location
ETPCU has developed this app with your security in mind. You can rest assured that your accounts are safe with the following security measures:
-If your device is lost or stolen, you can disable the app quickly
-Only transfers between existing and related accounts can be made
-Only bill payments to existing payees can be initiated
This app is for use by members of ETPCU only. Members of similarly named credit union in other states will not be able to use this app. Standard messaging and data rates may apply.
Visit www.etpcu.org for additional details.

bluejetty:00162900:ios.description:

받는 배송은 더 쉽게 확인하고,
보내는 배송은 상황에 맞게 편리하게 이용해보세요.
■ 주요 기능
1. 택배조회 · 배송추적
   국내 주요 택배사 배송정보를 한 곳에서 확인할 수 있습니다.
   등록한 운송장의 현재 배송상태와 진행단계를 빠르게 확인해보세요.
2. 자동 송장 등록
   연동 가능한 택배사는 별도 입력 없이 배송정보를 자동으로 확인할 수 있습니다.
3. 직관적인 배송 단계
   복잡한 배송 과정을 단계별로 정리해
   현재 배송상태를 누구나 쉽게 확인할 수 있습니다.
4. 방문택배 (곧 리뉴얼 오픈)
   집이나 원하는 장소에서 간편하게 택배를 접수하고 보낼 수 있습니다.
5. 다양한 배송서비스 (곧 리뉴얼 오픈)
   일반 택배뿐 아니라 오늘도착, 퀵서비스, 화물 등
   상황에 맞는 배송서비스를 홈픽에서 이용할 수 있습니다.
6. 주문 · 결제 · 배송내역 관리
   배송 신청부터 결제, 이용내역 확인까지
   하나의 앱에서 편리하게 관리할 수 있습니다.
■ 기존 배송지키미 기능 안내
기존 배송지키미의 배송조회 및 배송알림 기능은
홈픽에서도 계속 이용할 수 있습니다.
택배 조회부터 택배 보내기까지,
배송의 모든 과정을 홈픽에서 한 번에 경험해보세요.
■ 고객센터
이메일 : ptkhelp@goodsflow.com

bluejetty:00149017:ios.description:
Welcome to Blossom Sorting: A Captivating Flower Puzzle Game Awaits! Discover the enchanting world of Blossom Sorting, where soothing floral beauty meets the joy of strategic sorting. This game is tailor-made for casual enthusiasts and dedicated puzzle fans alike, offering a fresh spin on traditional color sorting challenges as you arrange vibrant flowers into tubes.
In Blossom Sorting, your mission is to create breathtaking floral designs by organizing flowers by their colors. With its peaceful visuals and calming gameplay, this delightful flower-themed game provides the perfect escape from a hectic day and delivers a much-needed moment of tranquility.
Why You’ll Love Blossom Sorting:
Endless Levels of Fun: Navigate through a variety of puzzles, ranging from simple to intricate, each crafted to provide a fresh challenge.
Stunning Floral Collection: Unlock dazzling new flower species as you advance, each more magnificent than the last.
Innovative Gameplay: Watch as flower vases magically transform into potted plants, adding a unique twist to classic sorting games.
A Relaxing Ambiance: Immerse yourself in the gentle bloom-inspired aesthetics and a serene, zen-like atmosphere.
Whether you adore floral-themed games or enjoy match-and-sort puzzles, Blossom Sorting delivers a refreshing and immersive experience. With intuitive controls and mesmerizing visuals, it stands out among flower-centric games, while its unhurried pace ensures a delightful experience for players seeking relaxation as well as fun.
Blossom Sorting isn’t just another puzzle game—it’s a heartfelt celebration of nature’s artistry. Don’t wait—download now and start your blooming adventure today!
For assistance: support@cleverside.com 
Privacy policy: https://www.cleverside.com/privacy

bluejetty:00087553:ios.description:
HEROES WANTED! YOU ARE WANTED!
Be the first to experience a whole new 3D Idle RPG fantasy game world and download the fun free to play Idle RPG game 2020!
Travel to the magic land of mighty gods, wicked evils, mysterious creatures, and ancient races. Start your own journey and immerse yourself in this Norse Myths adventure to bring back balance amidst the chaos and fight alongside your guild for glory and the Aírkns Stone.
GAME FEATURES
#Try Your Luck In The Gacha Gameplay & Summon Hundreds Of Unique Heroes At Your Service!
More than 100 customisable heroes from 6 different factions are ready to join your team! Recruit epic heroes in the Summon Hall! EXTRAORDINARY ANIMATION & VOICEOVERS will bring you immersive face-to-face experience with your favorite characters! Level them up, upgrade their power and reveal their special skills! The sky is the limit!
#STRESS-FREE Idle Battle Gameplay – Gaining Has Never Been This Easy, IT’S ALL AUTO, EVEN AFK!
Play at your own pace without the restriction of space and time! Simply assemble your strongest team, sit back and relax. Without a single tap or click, your elite idle champions will fight for you from day till dawn, bringing you Gold, Materials, Gears and ALL THE RESOURCES IN THE WORLD to help you advance! You will be making progress ALL THE TIME! Even if you’re offline!
#Infinite Strategy Variations To Explore!
Adjust your hero lineup and develop better formation strategies to counter your opponent in the battle, Make the most out of hero faction bonuses and make sure that heroes in your squad can make great combos with their ultimates! Your Heroes will be stronger than ever with you as their commander!
#More Dynamics Than Just Idle!
Over 1000 stages for you to overcome! Battle through the Sunset Forest, Silent Graveyard, Ancient Ruins, and more fantasy biomes alongside legendary heroes! Rally towards the Crusade packed with Board Game & Roguelike elements! Climb up the Dark Tower shrouded by shadow and checkout what strategies other players are using through their battle replay; Craft and Forge legendary gears in the smithy and arm your Warriors with the sharpest blade; Clear the Raids & slay evil dragons in dungeons as much for extra gains! More attractive content coming every week for you to discover!
#Fight For Your Allies!
Recruit active players around the world into your guild and manage to bring the guild to its glory! Be each other’s backbone and embrace whatever may come! Numerous heroic guild bosses await you and your ally's challenge. Don’t forget to strengthen your team’s offense and defense by proceeding on multiple Mastery trees with the guild medals! 
#Show Your Power On The Global Leaderboard!
Turn in your Arena Tickets and duel with the greatest idle gamers in the world! Earn huge rewards by the end of each season for ranking on top of the ladder! Be the fastest on progressing forward in the campaign hall and dark tower to show other players your secret magic code on defeating mobs! No matter you’re a master of PVP or PVE, there is always a spot for you to spread your fame and win others’ respect.
#Rewarding Trophy System Fueling Your Motivation!
A great number of achievements for you to complete while hinting you the shortcut to succeed! Earn diamonds, artifacts and more as a bonus when you hit these milestones!
PLEASE NOTE
Network connection is required.
Idle War: Legendary Heroes is free to download and play. Some in-app items can also be purchased for real money. In-app purchases can be disabled through your device’s settings. By downloading this app, you agree to our privacy policy and terms of use. 
Please don't hesitate to contact us at support@idlegame.top for any questions.

bluejetty:00160187:ios.description:
Gleem turns your selfies and your pet photos into breathtaking AI avatars across stunning styles and eras.
With new styles every week, Gleem makes it fun and easy to turn your words into magical images. Whether you're daydreaming, creating for joy, or just exploring something new, you'll love how simple (and satisfying) it is to bring your ideas to life. Perfect for relaxing, expressing yourself, or exploring your creativity. No design skills needed. Just inspiration.
Generate AI avatars that will stun & delight with our simple and easy-to-use AI Avatar Generator. Gleem is a revolutionary Portrait AI app that lets you create realistic AI renditions of yourself, your pets, or anyone easily. Simply upload a selfie or photo and our app will work its magic to generate an endless variety of avatars in an ever-growing list of different styles and fantasies. 
TURN YOURSELF INTO A MEDIEVAL KNIGHT OR CYBERPUNK HACKER
Want to become a Greek goddess or grim reaper? Our Portrait AI app make it easy to transform your selfies into gorgeous AI generated avatars from a variety of looks. Explore hairstyles, outfits, backgrounds from various periods of history & pop culture. Endow your avatars with accessories like armor, tattoos, makeup and props to take them to the next level. The possibilities are endless!
PICTURE YOUR PET IN THE STONE AGE OR FUTURISTIC UTOPIA
Ever wanted to see your cat as an astronaut or visualize your dog as a regal Victorian gentleman? Gleem's pet AI avatar generator lets you depict your furry friends in fun fantasy scenarios through various dog filters & filters for cats. Give your pet a wild makeover by changing their species, adding hats & costumes, & dropping them into crazy environments. Bring your imagination to life!
SIMPLE AND INTUITIVE DESIGN
Creating avatars on our AI headshot App has no need for a learning curve. Simply upload photos, browse options for style and setting, make desired tweaks, & download your imaginative avatar to share with the world. It's that easy!!
HUGE AI AVATAR VARIETY WITH UNMATCHED QUALITY AND DETAIL
Our AI avatar generator has expansive categories & advanced image generation technology, the possibilities are truly without bounds. Apply a variety of styles to your avatar, and become anything you want, down to the smallest details, in various styles & looks!
LIGHTNING FAST PROCESSING
Thanks to our optimized neural architecture & scalable cloud infrastructure, creations happen in minutes, not hours. No more waiting around!
PRIVACY FOCUSED
Gleem Portrait AI App prioritizes user privacy & security. Your Photos & Data are yours alone. Nothing is shared with third parties. Your photos will not be used to train other AI models & would not be visible to others until you share them online yourself. You remain fully in control of your personal information at all times. You can rest easy that all your information is private, safe & secure.
NO CREATIVE SKILLS REQUIRED
You don't need to be an artist to make avatars. Our AI avatar generator handles everything, you just provide the creative direction. Anyone can become an avatar creator!
For those intrigued by the magic behind Gleem, it's not just about the impressive visuals or the seamless user experience. At its core, Gleem is driven by a powerhouse of advanced machine learning technologies. While the specifics might sound like something out of a sci-fi novel, the essence lies in our dedication to harnessing the latest in neural network advancements. Our platform's ability to transform ordinary photos into extraordinary avatars stems from our innovative approach to AI developments.
We've built a system that's both smart & sensitive to your needs, ensuring that the avatars you create aren't just unique and accurate but are also deeply personalized. This is possible because of our relentless pursuit of excellence in AI research and development.

bluejetty:00065302:ios.description:
Security Federal Bank App is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Security Federal Bank App:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Security Federal Bank App app, you must be enrolled as a Security Federal Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00143463:ios.name: Eline's Table: Healthy Recipes
bluejetty:00143463:ios.summary: Chef Eline Bonnin has been sharing new plant-based recipes every week since 2015 on her blog, Eline's Table. On this intuitive app, you'll find around 1,300 plant-based recipes for every season: cozy autumn comfort food, festive Christmas f
bluejetty:00143463:ios.description:
Chef Eline Bonnin has been sharing new plant-based recipes every week since 2015 on her blog, Eline's Table. On this intuitive app, you'll find around 1,300 plant-based recipes for every season: cozy autumn comfort food, festive Christmas feasts, refreshing summer salads, vibrant spring dishes, quick meals, and high-protein ideas. As always, the ingredients are affordable and likely already in your pantry.
PERSONALIZED MEAL PLANS
Stop asking "What's for dinner?" A quick 5-question quiz matches you with one of 150+ chef-crafted menus, then lets you swap recipes, adjust portions, and choose a duration from 1 to 7 days (or themed plans up to 21 days). Your grocery list is generated instantly and grouped by aisle, and a daily timeline keeps you on track.
STEP-BY-STEP GUIDED COOKING
Perfect your plant-based cooking with detailed step-by-step instructions featuring ingredient-by-step clarity, integrated timers, and video tutorials. Every recipe guides you clearly through each stage for reliable, delicious results.
ON IPHONE DUO
Set your iPhone Duo half open on the counter. It stands on its own. The current step stays on top, facing you. On the lower half, you start the timer and move between steps with a tap. Closed, fully open, or folded like a book, the app adapts to every position.
ON YOUR APPLE WATCH
Keep your recipes on your wrist. Access your meal plans, favorites, and latest recipes right on your Apple Watch. Start guided cooking on its own from the Watch, or take over a session already running on your iPhone. Your timers stay in sync across your devices, so you can follow every step and keep the pace, hands free.
LEARN WITH VIDEO TUTORIALS
Learn plant-based cooking with integrated recipe videos. Discover meals for every occasion: cakes, egg-free and dairy-free desserts, delicious breakfasts, and veggie burgers. Hundreds of recipes come with a video.
DETAILED NUTRITION FACTS
Curious what's really on your plate? Every recipe reveals its complete nutritional breakdown: calories, macros, vitamins and minerals, calculated per serving. Pin the values that matter most to you, and log a meal to Apple Health in a single tap.
SIRI AI, WIDGETS, AND EVERY SCREEN
• Siri AI: ask for a recipe idea or add an item to your shopping list
• Widgets: today's meals and the latest recipe, right on your Home Screen
• Live Activities: your timer and current step stay visible on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• iPad and Apple Vision Pro: an app designed for each screen, in a window sized the way you like
ALSO IN THE APP
• Favorites and Collections to save your favorite recipes and organize them by occasion
• Smart search by filter or ingredient: easily find gluten-free, no-bake, seasonal, and one-pot recipes
• Shopping list feature: import ingredients from any recipe into a single, organized list
• Enable notifications to discover new seasonal recipes every week!
PREMIUM+ SUBSCRIPTION
• Exclusive plant-based recipes, including recipes from Eline's cookbooks
• Unlimited access to Personalized Meal Plans and all future plan themes
• A new exclusive plant-based recipe every week
• The full step-by-step cooking mode, on every step
• Full access to the smart shopping list and meal-plan grocery lists
• Unlimited custom Collections to group your favorite recipes by occasion, season, or mood
• Unlimited access to detailed nutrition facts on every recipe
Terms of Use
https://elinestable.com/legal-notices
Privacy Policy
https://elinestable.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00026364:ios.description:
Melon Sandbox: Ultimate Sandbox of Chaos!
Welcome to Melon Sandbox, a thrilling sandbox game where you unleash your creativity through brutal experiments with realistic ragdoll physics! No limits, no rules—just pure destructive fun!
Melon Sandbox x Poppy Playtime: Halloween Collaboration! 
This Halloween, Melon Sandbox collaborates with Poppy Playtime for a special Halloween event! Enter a spooky world featuring iconic Poppy Playtime characters, including Huggy Wuggy, Kissy Missy, The Prototype, Boxy Boo, and more.
Take on Halloween-themed board game challenges, unlock exclusive characters and mods, and bring the world of Poppy Playtime into your favorite physics sandbox!
What can you do?
Experiment with physics – Throw, smash, and test unique interactions between objects!
Massive arsenal – Use firearms, melee weapons, explosives, and vehicles to tear through ragdolls!
Create chaos – Stab, crush, burn, or vaporize with custom devices!
Open-world sandbox – Explore diverse maps and build your own playground of destruction!
Get ready for endless mayhem in the ultimate ragdoll simulation! Get on board now and start experimenting!

bluejetty:00100609:ios.description:
PixSweep Cleaner helps you free up storage and organize your device by identifying unnecessary photos, videos, contacts, and calendar entries. With smart detection tools and full user control, you can keep your device clean, organized, and running smoothly.
Photo Cleaning
Quickly review and manage:
Similar photos
Duplicate photos
Screenshots
Portrait photos
Live Photos
Video Cleaning
Identify videos that take up the most space:
Similar videos
Largest videos (from 1 GB)
Downloaded videos
All media is grouped automatically so you can review items before removing them.
Contacts Management
Organize your address book by finding:
Duplicate contacts
Incomplete or unused contacts
Contacts are processed locally on your device and are never uploaded or shared.
Calendar Management
Keep your schedule clean by identifying:
Outdated events
Duplicate calendar entries
Subscription Information
PixSweep Cleaner provides premium features through auto-renewable subscriptions:
Weekly: $9.99 with a 3-day free trial
Monthly: $19.99
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy
Your privacy is important. Photos, videos, contacts, and calendar data are processed securely on your device. PixSweep Cleaner does not store or upload personal information.
Link: https://pixsweep-cleaner.com/privacy
Terms of Use
By using PixSweep Cleaner, you agree to the Terms of Use.
Link: https://pixsweep-cleaner.com/terms

bluejetty:00142556:android.description:
Welcome to Count & Earn 🔢🎁
Count & Earn is a simple and engaging app where users can collect reward points by completing easy counting-based activities and participating in available tasks.
The app is designed for casual use and entertainment, allowing users to earn promotional rewards through eligible actions in a clear and transparent way.
🔹 How it works
• Complete simple counting and number-based activities
• Participate in available tasks and promotions
• Collect reward points for eligible completions
• Redeem points for supported rewards, subject to availability
Reward points may be redeemed for options such as gift cards or digital payouts, depending on eligibility, verification, and applicable limits.
🔹 Why use Count & Earn?
✔ Simple and beginner-friendly activities
✔ Clear reward point system with defined limits
✔ Daily tasks and bonus opportunities
✔ Secure and easy-to-use interface
⚠️ Important Disclaimer
Count & Earn is not a job or income source. Rewards are promotional, limited, and non-guaranteed, and depend on user activity, eligibility, verification, and offer availability. Redemption options may vary and can change without prior notice.
Download Count & Earn and enjoy a simple way to collect rewards through fun counting activities!

bluejetty:00172285:android.description:
"A true adventurer must be a coward."
Someone said so.
These words are the only truth that will survive in this world.
Only those who survive can pass it on to future generations.
Heroes who die along the way cannot make history.
In order to make history, we must survive at all costs.
But we must not forget.
The dead adventurers had their own history, their own stories...
This game is about sending adventurers out to explore, and using the rewards they earn to develop their villages.
In the process, many adventurers will die in the course of their adventures.
Mourn their deaths, but do not let them go to waste.
What they left behind will be left behind in the gorgeous old city and will be passed on to the next generation.
Caution.
It is almost impossible to grow attached to an adventurer.
It is an adventure so demanding that you cannot hope to see him or her live out his or her life.
In order to play this game, you need to give proper orders to your adventurers without being sentimental.
Even if you know that those adventurers will die...

bluejetty:00177745:ios.name: Everdell
bluejetty:00177745:ios.summary:
From Everfrost to Bellsong, many a peaceful year has passed in Everdell — but the time has come for new territories to be settled and new cities to be established...
Adapted from the award-winning board game from Tabletop Tycoon, Everdell
bluejetty:00177745:ios.description:
From Everfrost to Bellsong, many a peaceful year has passed in Everdell — but the time has come for new territories to be settled and new cities to be established...
Adapted from the award-winning board game from Tabletop Tycoon, Everdell is a fantastical city building game combining worker placement and strategic card play to create a new civilization. Gather resources to build fanciful Constructions and recruit colorful Critters to make your city thrive. Each card in your city scores points, and after four seasons have passed the highest-scoring city wins!
Face off against other founders in cross-platform multiplayer games, or test your civic wits with AI play and Solo Challenges!
On each turn, you'll take one of three actions:
1.) Place a Worker. Send one of your helpful workers out into the valley to gather resources! Berries, Twigs, Resin, Pebbles...and of course Cards! You'll need them all to help your new civilization grow.
2.) Play a Card. Your city can hold up to 15 Construction and Critter cards. Cards generate resources, open up new abilities, and score points to win the game! Discover combos and synergies to race past your opponents.
3.) Prepare for the Next Season. When the seasons change, your workers come home and get ready for the next round. But plan your city carefully! After four seasons, the Winter Moon returns and the game will end.
There are buildings to construct, lively characters to meet, events to host— you will have a busy year ahead of you!
Will the sun shine brightest on your city before the winter moon rises? Welcome to Everdell!

Make friends with your banking and upgrade your finances with George.
George is simple, intelligent and personal, offering you the most mobile money experience in one powerful app:
• From quick financial overviews to instant transfers with Scan & Pay: George simplifies your everyday money matters. There’s (almost) nothing George can’t do.

bluejetty:00147533:ios.description:
Planet Wild is a community of people who care deeply about nature and want to help our planet bounce back - one mission at a time. All through a single affordable subscription.
EVERY MONTH, we work with wildlife pioneers worldwide to
bring back endangered species
clean up our oceans
revive forests
EVERY MEMBER can choose how we spend their contribution, connect with us on Discord and collect unique badges for each mission they supported.
EVERY MISSION is documented in videos. 100% transparency.
EVERYONE can join. The bigger the community grows, the bigger the missions will get.
Download Planet Wild for free. Watch stunning videos of the work our community enables. Then decide if you want to become a member.
--------------------------------------------------
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Planet Wild is free to download. After creating your account, you can support us by funding on-the-ground rewilding projects with a monthly membership plan. If you decide for a membership, payment for the total monthly fee will be charged through the payment method you selected (e.g. Paypal, or Credit Card) at the time you confirm your purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Membership plans renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the monthly period. There is no increase in price when renewing. You can manage your plan and disable the automatic renewal at any time via the app settings. For more information see our Terms of Service (https://planetwild.com/legal/terms-of-service) and Privacy Policy (https://planetwild.com/legal/privacy-policy).

bluejetty:00026478:ios.description:
Literie is a doorway to endless literary worlds. With an extensive selection of genres, from feel-good romances to dramatic fantasies, Literie offers something for every reader. Whether you’re diving into a new book by a rising author or revisiting a favorite from a seasoned writer, Literie delivers the stories you love, all in one app.
Browse through captivating books and immerse yourself in the fiction that speaks to you. Whether it's teen lit, chick lit, or anything in between, Literie brings all your favorite genres to your fingertips.
Powered by Letterlux, a creative hub for emerging and established authors, Literie offers exclusive content that’s crafted to inspire and entertain. If you're passionate about writing, you can even apply to become a Letterlux signed author through the link: https://letterlux.tech/ and share your book with the Literie community.
Whatever your literary desires, Literie is here to satisfy them—one story at a time.
Subscription Agreement
1.Period：monthly(auto-renewable subscriptions)
2.Price：US$19.99/month, US$49.99/month
3. Payment: The purchase will be charged to your iTunes account.
4. Renewal: The Apple iTunes account will automatically deduct fees within 24 hours before the subscription expires. After successful deduction, the subscription will be postponed for one cycle.
5. Cancel：You can cancel your subscription at any time 24 hours before the subscription expires.
6. Manage subscriptions: You can view and manage your renewals.
7. Award：After subscribing, the coins and vouchers received each month are limited. If you need more coins, please make an additional recharge.
8. Privacy:https://api.literiess.com/privacy_policy
9. Term of Service:https://api.literiess.com/user_agreement

bluejetty:00030428:ios.description:
Life is like a play. Who is an actor? Who is the audience? Who is writing behind the scenes?
 If this is a comedy, why is my laughter full of tears?
If this is a tragedy, why is there no end?
"Paper Bride 5 Two Lifetimes" is the 5th work in the "Paper Bride' series. Our cast from Zangling Village return to the stage to welcome players back to the world of paper bride...
We have once again integrated more Chinese folk lore as the story continues to unfold and new characters take stage. Experience the joys and woes of our cast in this world steeped in folk tradition shrouded in dreams and illusions.
New Features:
*Rich Folk Lore: We have consulted experts to bring you more in-depth and historically accurate folk lore!
*New Puzzles: We always strive to create new challenges for players with each installment, such a new mechanic for solving puzzles with your phone!
*Improved Graphics: This chapter is our most detailed work yet! A gorgeous cast, rich environments, and more animations await!
*The Plot Thickens: Lines blur between dreams and reality. What is real? What is staged? Only you can find out.
————————————————

 Facebook: @gamefpscom

bluejetty:00064316:ios.description:
Undercover is a word game for groups. Everyone gets the same secret word — except for a few players!
Your goal is to find out who is who, and to stay in the game.
You must describe your word, but you can never say it.
_______________
• Are you at a party, looking for a game that can engage everyone?
• Or thinking of a good way to interact with your friends during dinner, an outing, or even at work?
You are in the right place! Undercover, like icebreaker games Werewolf, Codenames and Spyfall, was created to ensure active participation from everyone who can read and speak. Laughter and surprises are guaranteed!
_______________
KEY FEATURES:
1. Offline mode: Everyone plays on the same phone. Players must be physically together.
2. Online mode: Play with your friends or with players around the world. Requires an account and is available to players aged 18+.
3. Our hand-picked word database ensures maximum engagement from everyone, whatever their interests.
4. Real-time ranking is displayed at the end of each round. Compare your Undercover skills with your friends’!
_______________
BASIC RULES:
• Roles: You can be either a Civilian or an Infiltrator (Undercover or Mr. White)
• Get your secret word: Pass the phone around to let each player choose their name and get a secret word! Civilians all receive the same word, the Undercover gets a slightly different word, and Mr. White receives no word at all.
• Describe your word: One by one, each player must give a short description of their word. Mr. White must improvise.
• Time to vote: After discussion, vote to eliminate the person that seems to have a different word from yours. The app will then reveal the eliminated player’s role!
Tip: Mr. White wins if he guesses the Civilians' word correctly!
_______________
Creative thinking & strategy, combined with hilarious reversals of situation, are sure to make Undercover one of the best party games you’ll play this year!

• Get your secret word: Pass the phone around to let each player choose their name and get a secret word! Civilians all receive the same word, the Undercover gets a slightly different word, and Mr. White receives no word at all.

• Describe your word: One by one, each player must give a short description of their word. Mr. White must improvise.

• Time to vote: After discussion, vote to eliminate the person that seems to have a different word from yours. The app will then reveal the eliminated player’s role!

Tip: Mr. White wins if he guesses the Civilians' word correctly!
_______________

Creative thinking & strategy, combined with hilarious reversals of situation, are sure to make Undercover one of the best party games you’ll play this year!

The Farkle
bluejetty:00073081:ios.description:
Farkle is a dice game that is the same or similar to Zilch, Zonk, Hot Dice, Greed, and 10000 Dice Game. Sometimes it is also spelled as Farkel.
The aim of the Farkle (Zonk) game is to roll the dice and accumulate 10000 points.
The Farkle gameplay is as follows:
1. At the beginning of each turn the dice are rolled.
2. After each roll, one of the scoring dice must be locked.
3. The player can then either end their turn or bank the accumulated score so far or they can continue rolling the remaining dice.
4. If the player gets a score on all six dice, it is called a "hot dice" after which the player continues with a new roll on six dice which is added to the accumulated score. And there is no limit to "hot dice".
5. If however, none of the rolled dice has a dice score the player gets a Farkle and loses all the points in that turn. Getting too greedy might be dangerous sometimes.
You can play our Farkle in three modes - Single Player, Versus Computer, or Versus Another Player. The game also includes a guide to help you with the rules of Farkle.
The game is very similar to the classic 10000 dice game (in which the game ends at 10000 points. We hope you like the game and share it with your friends too. Download now and enjoy a classic game of Farkle.

bluejetty:00086983:ios.description:
The app that helps you take care of yourself
__________
Simple, pleasant and efficient.
With the Regina Maria app, doctor visits become cooler than ever.
Keep all information about your health in a digital medical file that never gets lost.
Prevention, care and medical solutions you can trust, right on your phone →
__________
3 simple steps to use the app:
 1. Download the Regina Maria app;
 2. Create your "My Account";
 3. Enjoy, from day one, a complete medical experience.
__________
How does the Regina Maria app help you?
● Book appointments online: simple and fast
 ○ Book quickly with the specialty or doctor you prefer, without waiting for confirmation from the Contact Center.
 ○ Can't make it? Cancel your appointment in time, in just a few seconds, directly from your account.
● Check in directly at the location
 ○ With the online check-in feature, you know immediately where you're going for your consultation, without having to stop at reception.
 ○ To quickly find the floor and cabinet, go to the "Appointments" section in your account and press "check-in".
● Or visit the Virtual Clinic quickly
 ○ Now you can get the expert opinion of a specialist doctor, right from the comfort of your home.
 ○ Enjoy online consultations, with the same benefits as in-person appointments.
● Your medical file is always at hand:
 ○ You have simplified access to your complete medical history, including test results, consultations and hospitalization records, directly from your phone.
 ○ Keep everything safe, in one place, your medical tests, appointments and recommended treatments.
● Referrals to other specialties
 ○ You receive referrals directly in your account to reach the doctor specialized in your condition.
 ○ Save time: the list of necessary tests is already prepared by a specialist so you can book quickly.
 ○ #peabonament you get personalized rates when you go to consultations with a referral.
● Save while you take care of yourself:
 ○ Keep track of expenses: now you always know what services are included in your subscription and how much you save compared to standard prices. 
 ○ In the "Your Subscriptions" section you have permanent access to included services, costs and savings. 
● It's easier to take care of your loved ones:
 ○ If you're a parent, you can easily link your child's account for quick access to their medical file and upcoming appointments.
 ○ You can pay invoices or consultations directly from the app.
__________
Enjoy the benefits
3 simple steps to activate your account at Regina Maria.
 1. Quick registration
 Create your account using your Apple, Google, Facebook or email details. If you need help, you can reach us at 021 9268.
 2. Simple verification 
 Verify your email and phone via a link and SMS code.
 From now on you have partial access to the app: you can book appointments, but you cannot view your "Medical File".
 For full access, go to step 3.
 3. Full access
 Log in to the app, access your Medical File and choose the option "I want to validate now".
 In just a few hours, you have full access to your medical history.
 Validation may take up to 24 hours or you can request it anytime, at any Regina Maria location.
__________
It's so easy to go to the doctor.
Download the Regina Maria app and discover a new experience of prevention and care.
Download now →

> Dress up different skin colors and tons of clothes!
> Many different hairstyles available for your princess!

* Do you like cute games?Such as barbie games or vlinder doll games?

* You can dress up in different fashion, beautiful clothes, hairstyles, keep different pets, also you can have different styles of rooms, dress up with delicate makeup, create the most beautiful princess! gocha life!
* Of course, glass shoes and beautiful accessories can also be chosen at will! These can make a person cuter!
* In the casual cute game, many beautiful outfits are waiting for you in our Vlinder outfit games!Hurry up and create various princess characters.

【Share and get more thumb up and followers】
Use Vlinder Princess games in Avatar Maker to create more wonderful photos and videos, share them on Snapchat, Instagram, TikTok and other social media. Help you win more likes for your posts and stories and attract more followers.So come and play the little girl anime dress up game!

bluejetty:00170509:ios.description:
Are you looking for an emoji game? This game is all that you want now! 
• With Emoji Merge Kitchen - DIY Mix, you'll experience the excitement of creating entirely new, unique, and fun emojis by combining your two favorite emojis. With over 500 different emojis, you have the freedom to be creative and combine them to create unique emojis.
• It's time to create your imprint! You can funny emojis and send your stories to the most popular social networks, chats, and messengers. 
Key Feature
Emoji Kitchen Merge 
• Unique mix emojis ready for your use. Various emoji categories including smileys, animals, food... and more.
• Select two emojis and merge them with over 500+ unique emojis to create cute emojis, DIY animals emojis, mix fun emojis with Emoji Kitchen Merge.
• OMG...It's easy for all ages and has unlimited playtime.
• Regular updates with new emojis.
Welcome to Emoji Game 
• Emoji evolution: In a specific period, find the correct emoji from a given set to advance to the next stage. There will be multiple levels with three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard. For each difficulty level, you will receive corresponding badges: bronze, silver, and gold.
• Word Pictograms: Similarly, you must correctly guess the emoji from a given word to proceed to the next stage. The difficulty will increase gradually.
Emoji Kitchen Collection
• 10,000+ Combined Results: Unique emoji creator and integrated with an easy-to-use keyboard.
• Share the Fun Emoji kitchen: Send these quirky and adorable emojis to your friends and express your emotions in a fun way.

We value your contributions and will do our best to meet all requirements and improve product quality.

bluejetty:00142607:ios.name: Chess Online - Duel Friends!
bluejetty:00142607:ios.summary:
Chess Online — real opponents at your level
Find a match in seconds, challenge a friend to any time control, or play the computer with no internet at all. One chess app for the five-minute queue and the game you think about for three days.
bluejetty:00142607:ios.description:
Chess Online — real opponents at your level
Find a match in seconds, challenge a friend to any time control, or play the computer with no internet at all. One chess app for the five-minute queue and the game you think about for three days.
PLAY ONLINE
• Real opponents matched to your rating, in seconds
• Tempo at 20 seconds a move, Blitz, longer classic games, or Chill with up to 72 hours per move
• Premove so you keep up when the clock is short
• Chat, or send a quick voice line without typing
• Fair play you can see: the server runs the clock and the rules, not your phone
PLAY YOUR FRIENDS
• Private matches in any mode you want
• Add anyone you know and keep several games running at once
• Chill games wait for you — play a move at breakfast and another at night
PLAY OFFLINE
• Beat the computer at the difficulty you choose
• No internet, no waiting, no account needed
• The whole game works on a plane or underground
GET BETTER
• 50,000 puzzles, plus a new one every day
• Every game reviewed move by move: brilliant, best, mistake, blunder
• Accuracy for both sides, so you can see exactly where it turned
• Missions and a daily streak to keep you coming back
CLIMB
• 12 ranks from Bronze to Immortal, worn on your avatar in every game you play
• World and country leaderboards
• Watch live games in progress and learn from stronger players
• Highlights: share your best moves, and see what everyone else has been landing
EASY TO START
• Legal moves are highlighted, which helps if you are still learning
• Clean, realistic board with themes to choose from
• Play as a guest, or create an account to keep your rating, friends and history
Start with one game. See where you end up.

bluejetty:00069821:ios.name: Neffs Bank Mobile
bluejetty:00069821:ios.summary: Neffs Bank Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier
bluejetty:00069821:ios.description:
Neffs Bank Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Neffs Bank Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Neffs Bank Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a The Neffs National Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00184870:ios.summary:
RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic is a new RCT experience, combining the best features from two of the most successful and beloved RCT games in the series’ history – RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2. 
Create and run amazing par
bluejetty:00184870:ios.description:
RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic is a new RCT experience, combining the best features from two of the most successful and beloved RCT games in the series’ history – RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2. 
Create and run amazing parks complete with the most outrageous rides imaginable. RCT Classic includes a mixture of authentic playability, depth of gameplay and unique graphical style of Chris Sawyer’s original best-selling RollerCoaster Tycoon® PC Games, now enhanced for handheld devices.
Packed with content, players can enjoy designing and building roller coasters and rides, landscaping parks and managing the staff and finances to keep their guests happy and the money flowing in.
Can you become the next RollerCoaster Tycoon? 
PLEASE NOTE: Additional content for RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic is available via In-App Purchase, specifically the three expansion packs: Wacky Worlds, Time Twister and Toolkit. The expansion packs are the ONLY content that require an In-App Purchase and In-App Purchases are not used anywhere else in the game.
Key Features:
•The Original RollerCoaster Sim: Experience all the fun from the original RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2 games, with a new app that combines the best elements of both classic titles.
•Coaster Construction: Create incredible roller coasters – Quickly build a pre-made design or use the intuitive piece-by-piece building tools to design and theme your own unique rides.
•Park Designer: Keep your guests happy by building gentle or wild rides, food and drink stalls, water rides, and even transport rides to take them around the park; Customize your park by building scenery, fine-tuning the landscape, and routing the footpaths.
•Park Management: Run your park’s marketing and finances to make a profit while attracting more guests; Organize your staff to keep the park running well and looking its best.
•Exciting Environments: Build the ultimate theme park in a variety of challenging environments, from the tranquility of Forest Frontiers to the bustling commerce of Megaworld Park.
•Park Scenarios: Progress through 95 classic park scenarios from RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2.
• Authentic Gameplay: Classic-style characterful isometric graphics and original amusement park music and sound effects.
• Packed with Content: Includes hundreds of types of roller coasters and rides, and dozens of different shops, stalls, and facilities.
Additional Content Available with In-App Purchases: 
1)Wacky Worlds Expansion Pack: 
Find your passport and pack your bags! Wacky Worlds takes players on the ultimate trip around the globe in 17 new park scenarios! Includes exotic rides, profitable concessions and the most famous landmarks known to man including the Eiffel Tower, Big Ben, Statue of Liberty, Great Wall of China and more! Each location is packed with opportunities for success, fun and unique challenges.
2)Time Twister Expansion Pack:
Travel through time with 14 new park scenarios based on historical and fantasy time-themes and build a park that is truly a blast from the past (or future if you like). Play in a Prehistoric amusement park decorated with huge animated T-Rex’s and coasters such as the Raptor Ride, or choose from Mythological times, the Dark Ages, the Rock & Roll crazed ‘50s, the Future or the Roaring Twenties.
3)Toolkit:
Park Scenario Editor: Design and build your own amazing parks – Make them as easy or as challenging as you want, using your choice of scenery and rides! Includes a number of Six Flags parks to get you started.
Ride Designer: Build, test, fine-tune and theme your own awesome roller coaster designs in the Ride Designer before saving them for use while playing!
Import and Export: Share your saved parks, park scenarios and ride designs with friends, and try out their creations too! (Includes the ability to import most saved parks and scenarios created with the original RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 PC game).

bluejetty:00071555:ios.description:
Download to apply, the HSBC Expat app makes managing your banking simple, secure, and convenient wherever you are.
Our Expat Premier Bank Account is designed to support your international lifestyle, giving you seamless access to global banking. Moving abroad can be complex, but your finances don’t have to be. With an Expat Account, you’ll unlock a range of features, products, and services to help you manage your money with ease.
It takes just a few minutes to get started with HSBC Expat Mobile Banking. Download it today and you can: 
• Apply for your first HSBC Expat account*, register and set up digital banking.
• Log on quickly and securely with your Face ID or Touch ID.
• Make payments and view your local and globally linked balances.
• 24/7 chat assistance to answer common banking queries.
• Hold up to 19 currencies in 1 place with our Global Money Account and spend in up to 18 currencies with the Global Money debit card.
• Make fee-free international payments.
How to use the HSBC Expat Mobile Banking app: 
• Existing customer: If you’re registered for HSBC Expat digital banking, you can use your existing details to log on. If you’re not yet registered, download the app to get started today.
• New customer (sole account): If you’re not yet a customer, simply download the app, then select ‘open an account’ to apply.
• New customer (joint account): If you're not yet a customer and would like to have a joint account, you can apply by visiting the HSBC Expat website.
To find out more about HSBC Expat, our services or check your eligibility before applying, you can visit our website at: 
https://www.expat.hsbc.com/international-banking/products/bank-account/
* Before you apply, please make sure you're 18 or older, opening this account for yourself and you don't already bank with HSBC Expat.

bluejetty:00024020:ios.description:
Xinhua Dictionary – Your Trusted Source for Learning Chinese
Unlock the full potential of Chinese language learning with the Xinhua Dictionary, powered by The Commercial Press Cloud Platform. Compiled by experts from the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, this authoritative app integrates 27 essential dictionaries, including the Modern Chinese Dictionary and the Dictionary of Frequently Used Ancient Chinese Characters, offering a comprehensive language resource.
***Key Features***
•Xinhua Dictionary (12th Edition): The most trusted reference for Chinese learners, fully integrated and regularly updated.
•The Commercial Press Cloud Platform: Access a wide range of authoritative dictionaries, including:
o Modern Chinese Dictionary – The standard reference for Chinese vocabulary and pronunciation.
o Dictionary of Frequently Used Ancient Chinese Characters – Essential for understanding ancient Chinese.
o Ancient Chinese Dictionary – Key for studying classical texts.
o Plus additional resources such as the Xinhua Idioms, Colloquialisms, and Proverbs Dictionaries.
• Standard Pronunciation: Hear accurate pronunciations from Li Ruiying, the renowned former Xinwen Lianbo anchor, and practice with immediate feedback.
• Stroke Order Guidance: Learn the correct stroke order for thousands of Chinese characters with dynamic and static visual guides.
• Chinese Character Insights: Gain a deeper understanding of tricky characters, their multiple pronunciations, and their historical context.
• Cultural Columns: Explore sections on Idioms, Poetry, and more, offering cultural insights and historical background.
• Interactive Learning: Engage in fun challenges and games that reinforce your knowledge of characters, words, and idioms, perfect for exam preparation or general learning.
【Why Choose Us?】
• The Xinhua Dictionary has earned numerous prestigious awards, including Guinness World Records for "Most Popular Dictionary" and "Best-Selling Book (Regularly Updated)".
• This is the official Xinhua Dictionary app, providing a reliable and authoritative resource for learners at all levels.
Download the Xinhua Dictionary today and experience the strength of "The Commercial Press Cloud Platform" in your Chinese learning journey！
Contact us by email: service@vdict.com.cn

bluejetty:00065213:ios.description:
PhonePe is a payments app that allows you to use BHIM UPI, your credit card and debit card or wallet to recharge your mobile phone, pay all your utility bills and to make instant payments at your favourite offline and online stores. You can also invest in mutual funds and buy insurance plans on PhonePe. Get Car & Bike Insurance on our app.
Link your bank account on PhonePe and transfer money with BHIM UPI instantly! The PhonePe app is safe and secure, meets all your payment, investment, mutual funds, insurance and banking needs, and is much better than Internet banking.
Things you can do on PhonePe (Phonepay) App:
Money Transfer, UPI Payment, Bank Transfer
- Money Transfer with BHIM UPI
- Manage Multiple Bank Accounts – Check Account Balance, Save Beneficiaries across multiple bank accounts like SBI, HDFC, ICICI & 140+ banks.
Make Online Payments
- Make online payment on various shopping sites like Flipkart, Amazon, Myntra etc.
- Pay for online food orders from Zomato, Swiggy etc.
- Pay for online grocery orders from Bigbasket, Grofers etc.
- Pay online for travel booking from Makemytrip, Goibibo etc.
Make Offline Payments
- Scan and Pay via QR Code at local stores like kirana, food, medicines etc.
Buy or Renew Insurance Policies with PhonePe Insurance App
Health & Term Life Insurance
- Compare and buy Health & Term life Insurance with monthly premiums
- Coverage for individuals, senior citizens and families
Car & Two Wheeler Insurance
- Browse and get India’s most popular bike and car insurance
- Buy/renew your car and bike Insurance in less than 10 minutes
Other Insurance
- Personal Accident Insurance: Insure yourself against accidents & disablement
- Travel Insurance: Get international travel insurance for business and leisure trips
- Shop Insurance: Insure your shop against fire, theft, natural calamities, and burglaries.
Mutual Funds App and Investments App
- Liquid Funds: Get higher returns than savings bank 
- Tax-Saving Funds: save up to Rs. 46,800 in tax & grow your investment
- Super Funds: Achieve financial goals with expert help on our app 
- Equity Funds: High growth products curated as per risk appetite
- Debt Funds: Get stable returns for investments without any lock-in period
- Hybrid Funds: Get a balance of growth and stability 
- Buy or Sell 24K Pure Gold: Assured 24K purity, build gold savings on our app

- Recharge for Airtel, Jio, Vi, BSNL and MTNL prepaid mobile numbers
- Recharge DTH set-top boxes for TataPlay, Airtel Digital TV, Sun Direct, Dish TV and D2H providers.
Bill Payment
- Pay Credit Card Bills
- Pay Landline Bills
- Pay Electricity Bills
- Pay Water Bills
- Pay Gas Bills
- Pay Broadband Bills
Buy PhonePe Gift Cards
- Buy a PhonePe Gift Card for easy payments across 1 lakh+ leading offline and online outlets and across the PhonePe app.
Manage your refunds

SMS: to verify Phone number for registration
Location: a requirement by NPCI for UPI transactions
Contacts: for phone numbers to send money to and numbers to recharge
Camera: to scan QR code
Storage: to store scanned QR code
Accounts: to pre-populate email ID while signing up
Call: to detect single vs dual sim and let user choose
Microphone: to carry out KYC video verification

 - There is no gender selected for the main character, so anyone can play.
■ Story
Become the master who brings the handsome demon brothers down to their knees and enjoy life at the Academy in the Devildom!
You have been selected to become an exchange student at RAD, a school for demons. Awaiting you are 7 demon brothers and a mountain of tasks...?!
There is only 1 rule you have to remember to survive...
One Master to RULE them all!
■Your Own Personal Harem of Demon Ikemen
Choose how you wish to enjoy your life: Will you whip the demon brothers into shape, or pursue a new romance?
...Maybe even a kiss from an ikemen demon awaits?
■ Entertaining Card Battles
Evil demons in the Devildom are after your soul! With the help from the 7 brothers, you can defeat them in an exciting card battle. Choose your own team and see the different chibi characters appear on-screen as you listen to the music that varies each stage. Collect cards, level them up, and win the battles!

- VIP login bonus!
- Your maximum AP will increase by 20.

bluejetty:00021523:ios.description:
Meditation is your key to a happier life. It can be practiced by anyone.
On a physical level, meditation heals and energizes. On a mental level, it eliminates stress and fear, and helps you develop mindfulness and personal effectiveness. And on a spiritual level, it paves the way towards enlightenment...
Here is what you will find on Slowdive:
GUIDED MEDITATIONS
These are special audio programs. The combination of music and the narrator’s voice will put you in the correct state for meditation and instruct you on what to do.
SMART NEWSFEED
Slowdive has learnt to predict your wants and make recommendations of exactly what you need, based on your preferences and habits.
MULTI-FUNCTIONAL TIMER
A timer is a vital tool for meditation. Set the metronome, the background sounds and music, and do so much more.
GROUP MEDITATION
Join an online meditation practice on Slowdive, with a new session every hour. We’re stronger together, aren’t we?
BREATHING EXERCISES
Meditation is inextricably linked to breathing. To practice it, you can use our special breathing exercises with a variety of difficulty levels.
ANALYTICS AND MOTIVATION
Slowdive will not only help you to get into the beneficial habit of meditation, but will also energize you with motivation and illustrative statistics.
MUSIC AND MANTRAS
There are over 35 different sounds, types of music and mantras for you to use as a background for your perfect meditation session.
FORMING A HABIT
Meditating just a couple of times is not enough—you will only get real results after practicing on a regular basis. The app has a special scale on which you can select your minimum desired amount of meditation time per day. As you meditate, the scale will be filled.
GUIDED MEDITATIONS
Over 100 guided meditations for lots of different scenarios, such as:
You can also set notifications to remind you to meditate or to do breathing exercises at a given time. We will support you in developing a beneficial habit.
Mindfulness is a mental state achieved by focusing one's awareness on the present moment. During meditation, Slowdive adds information about your periods of mindfulness to the HealthKit application.
We hope you enjoy our service, and we would be happy to hear your ideas and suggestions!
We wish you good luck and every success in your endeavors!
__________________________________________

$13.99 per 1 week (US-based pricing)

The subscription automatically renews with the same price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Subscriptions can be deactivated at the following link: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

bluejetty:00170734:ios.description:
With SpatialCamera, you can begin capturing Spatial Photo and Spatial Video on iPhone as far back as the iPhone Xs*, save life’s precious moments in 3D, convert spatial video/photo into other 3D video/photo formats and relive those memories on XR headsets.
**Spatial Capture** 
- Supports capturing spatial photos 
- Supports capturing spatial videos up to 4K and HDR format (on select devices) 
- Supports time-lapse mode 
- Supports launching Spatial Camera from the lock screen (iOS 18).
- Supports camera control button (iPhone 16 series).
**Image and Video Transcoding** 
- Supports conversion between traditional SBS, HOU formats and spatial photo/video formats 
- Supports batch transcoding 
- Supports 2D photo conversion to spatial photo (powered by on-device AI model) 
* Devices with better support for Spatial Capture
iPhone 16 Series
iPhone 15 Pro
iPhone 15 Pro Max
iPhone 12
iPhone 12 mini
iPhone 11
iPad Pro 12.9-inch (6th generation)
iPad Pro 12.9-inch (5th generation)
iPad Pro 12.9-inch (4th generation)
iPad Pro 11-inch (4th generation)
iPad Pro 11-inch (3rd generation)
iPad Pro 11-inch (2nd generation)
*For other devices with different camera layouts, they will operate under the following compatibility modes:
Compatibility Mode 1: Utilizes the telescope and wide-angle lenses for spatial capture, primarily focusing on the perspective of the telephoto lens. 
Drawback: Requires maintaining a longer distance from the subject.
Compatibility Mode 2: Rotates the device to keep the wide-angle and ultra-wide-angle lenses on the same horizontal line. 
Drawback: The captured image will be cropped a lot.
*AD: If you have an Apple Vision Pro, we invite you to try our newly launched, all-in-one local video player **SpatialVideos**, designed exclusively for visionOS. 
https://apps.apple.com/app/spatialvideos/id6450283181

Start with 8 free Latter-day Saint eBooks and unlock access to hundreds more—all at no cost. Your Library keeps all your Deseret Book purchases in one convenient place. Subscribe to Deseret Bookshelf+ for unlimited access to a wide-ranging collection of gospel, fiction, and nonfiction titles—including romance, suspense, inspirational voices, Church history, and more. That’s over 4,000 eBooks and the full audiobook catalog in one app.

Wholesome Content

- Listen to audiobooks and talks from trusted Latter-day Saint voices.

- Browse thousands of inspiring eBooks and audiobooks by genre or theme.

- Follow beloved authors and access their most popular works.

- Tap scripture references to view linked verses instantly in context.
- Sync your markups and progress across all your devices.

Podcasts

Inspiration & Sharing

- The full Deseret Book audiobook collection
- Thousands of premium and exclusive eBooks
- The subscriber-only “Sunday on Monday” podcast
- New titles added regularly

Download now and experience the joy of wholesome reading and listening.
