Search, study, read, and listen to uplifting, family-friendly content—all in one powerful app. The new Deseret Bookshelf is the most comprehensive source for wholesome eBooks, audiobooks, and podcasts for individuals and families alike.

Start with 8 free Latter-day Saint eBooks and unlock access to hundreds more—all at no cost. Your Library keeps all your Deseret Book purchases in one convenient place. Subscribe to Deseret Bookshelf+ for unlimited access to a wide-ranging collection of gospel, fiction, and nonfiction titles—including romance, suspense, inspirational voices, Church history, and more. That’s over 4,000 eBooks and the full audiobook catalog in one app.

Key Features

Wholesome Content

- Discover uplifting content that inspires faith, joy, and purpose.
- Curated for all ages—perfect for personal study and family time.
- Listen to audiobooks and talks from trusted Latter-day Saint voices.
- Enjoy clean stories with meaningful, family-centered themes.

Discover & Search

- Browse thousands of inspiring eBooks and audiobooks by genre or theme.
- Explore rich categories like gospel study, romance, fantasy, and suspense.
- Stream gospel-focused podcasts with insights from Church members and leaders.
- Find content quickly with smart filters and universal search.
- Follow beloved authors and access their most popular works.

eBook Reader & Study Tools

- Customize fonts, spacing, and light/dark modes to suit your reading style.
- Choose between scroll or page-flip mode.
- Highlight passages, bookmark favorites, and add personal notes.
- Tap scripture references to view linked verses instantly in context.
- Sync your markups and progress across all your devices.

Audiobook Player

- Listen to over 2,500 professionally narrated audiobooks and talks.
- Use chapter skip, 30-second rewind/forward, playback speed control, and sleep timer.
- Enjoy full background listening and cross-device syncing.
- New mini player keeps audio controls accessible while you browse.

Podcasts

- Subscribe to uplifting Latter-day Saint podcasts.
- Manage episodes with auto-playback and library organization.
- Download for offline listening or stream anywhere.
- Control playback speed to listen at your preferred pace.

Inspiration & Sharing

- Start your day with a new, uplifting quote.
- Share highlights or passages with friends via text, email, or social media.
- Let others know what books and authors are inspiring your journey.

Free Starter Library

Create an account and instantly receive 8 classic Latter-day Saint titles:

1. All These Things Shall Give Thee Experience – Neal A. Maxwell
2. The Power of Everyday Missionaries – Clayton M. Christensen
3. The Beginning of Better Days – Sheri Dew & Virginia Pearce
4. Be Your Best Self – Thomas S. Monson
5. Jesus the Christ – James E. Talmage
6. Lectures on Faith – Joseph Smith
7. The Joseph Smith Papers – Joseph Smith
8. Gospel Doctrine – Joseph F. Smith

You’ll also get access to the Standard Works, Church manuals, General Conference talks, and official Church publications—all included at no cost.

Deseret Bookshelf+ Subscription

Unlock unlimited access to:

- The full Deseret Book audiobook collection
- Thousands of premium and exclusive eBooks
- The subscriber-only “Sunday on Monday” podcast
- New titles added regularly

Whether you’re commuting, studying, or winding down at night, Deseret Bookshelf helps you stay spiritually nourished with uplifting content—anytime, anywhere.

Download now and experience the joy of wholesome reading and listening.

bluejetty:00036547:ios.summary: Delta Legacy is a special version of Delta that uses "legacy" emulator cores. Specifically, this version includes melonDS 0.9.1, the original version of melonDS bundled with Delta until version 1.6. With Delta Legacy you can import your old
bluejetty:00036547:ios.description:
Delta Legacy is a special version of Delta that uses "legacy" emulator cores. Specifically, this version includes melonDS 0.9.1, the original version of melonDS bundled with Delta until version 1.6. With Delta Legacy you can import your old melonDS save states from Delta and continue playing where you left off.
FEATURES
Supported Game Systems
• Nintendo DS (melonDS 0.9.1)
Controller Support
• Nintendo Switch Pro controllers, Joy-Cons
• Nintendo Switch Online controllers (NES, SNES, N64)
• PS4, PS5
• Xbox One S, Xbox Series X
• MFi game controllers
• Bluetooth & wired keyboards
Save States
• Save and load save states for any game from the pause menu.
• Lock save states to prevent them from being accidentally overwritten.
• Automatically makes backup save states to ensure you never lose your progress.
• Support for “Quick Saves,” save states that can be quickly saved/loaded with a single button press (requires external controller).
Cheats
• Supports various types of cheat codes for each supported system:
• DS: Action Replay
Custom Controller Skins
• Beautiful built-in controller skins for all systems.
• Import controller skins made by others, or even make your own to share with the world!
Hold Button
• Choose buttons for Delta to hold down on your behalf, freeing up your thumbs to press other buttons instead.
• Perfect for games that typically require one button be held down constantly (e.g. run button in Mario games, or the A button in Mario Kart).
Fast Forward
• Speed through slower parts of games by running the game much faster than normal.
• Easily enable or disable from the pause menu, or optionally with a mapped button on an external controller.
3D/Haptic Touch
• Use 3D or Haptic Touch to “peek” at games, save states, and cheat codes.
• App icon shortcuts allow quick access to your most recently played games, or optionally customize the shortcuts to always include certain games.
Game Artwork
• Automatically displays appropriate box art for imported games.
• Change a game’s artwork to anything you want, or select from the built-in game artwork database.
**Delta Legacy is in no way affiliated with Nintendo. The name "Nintendo" and all associated game console names are registered trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd.**

bluejetty:00036556:ios.description:
VIRTUAL CARE. ANYTIME. ANYWHERE.
AllyHealth is a simple and trusted way to access U.S. board-certified doctors and pediatricians, 24/7/365, by phone or secure video chat, from home or on the go, within minutes. AllyHealth also provides virtual access to therapists, specialists, healthcare advocates, health coaches, and cost transparency & savings tools, right from your phone or tablet.
**AllyHealth is the only platform that seamlessly integrates telehealth services together with your other benefits to deliver a comprehensive, all-in-one solution for all of your healthcare needs, becoming your new front door to your healthcare benefits.**
Depending on your membership level, you may have access to:
TELEMEDICINE / ONLINE MEDICAL VISITS
Doctors can diagnose, treat, and prescribe (if medically necessary), for a wide range of common medical issues, including, but not limited to: bronchitis, sinus & respiratory infections, sore throat, diarrhea, cold/flu, allergies, strep throat, urinary tract infections, pink eye, rashes, migraines, ear infections, and more.
MENTAL HEALTH SERVICES
We also offer online talk therapy and psychiatry visits for treatment and support for a wide variety of behavioral health issues, including but not limited to: depression, anxiety, grief & loss, trauma & PTSD, relationship issues, stress, postpartum depression, bipolar disorder, and more.
HEALTH & WELLNESS COACHING
Our health and wellness coaches are trained to help with a wide range of health, wellness, and chronic conditions. We offer support for things such as weight loss, diabetes, high blood pressure, nutrition coaching, and more, helping you to live a healthier life.
HEALTHCARE ADVOCACY & CONCIERGE
Your “Personal Health Ally” can help you navigate through the complexities of the messy U.S. healthcare system and your insurance plan. Get help with common everyday needs like selecting the right providers, scheduling appointments, reviewing and negotiating medical bills, understanding and managing insurance claims, and more.
COST TRANSPARENCY & SAVINGS TOOLS
Save on your prescriptions with our pharmacy discount program. Have our team of experts review and negotiate your medical bills. Access to lower-cost healthcare services. And more right in the app.
Features & Benefits include:
Medical care within minutes; mental health sessions within as little as 24 hours
Digital benefits wallet to store and view all of your insurance ID cards
Savings & transparency tools
Private and secure
Family coverage
Skip the germ-filled waiting room
NOTE: You must have a company-sponsored membership to use AllyHealth. Some of the above services may not be available, depending on the plan level offered by your company. Check with your employer to see if you are eligible. Member verification and login required.
Copyright © 2020 AllyHealth LLC. All Rights Reserved.
We treat many patients each day with many different conditions, but you should not use AllyHealth if you are experiencing a medical emergency. AllyHealth may not be available in certain states and is subject to state regulations. AllyHealth is NOT an insurance product or company, and may not be able to substitute for traditional in-person care in every case for every condition. AllyHealth does not guarantee patients will receive a prescription, does not prescribe DEA-controlled substances, and may not prescribe non-therapeutic drugs and certain other drugs that may be harmful because of their potential for abuse.

bluejetty:00026533:ios.name: Spades - Classic Card Game
bluejetty:00026533:ios.summary: Join us and let's play Spades! Become the Kings and Queens of Spades in this captivating, free, and classic card game. Whether you're on your mobile phone or tablet, Spades is always there to help you relax. Install Spades now and start imm
bluejetty:00026533:ios.description:
Join us and let's play Spades! Become the Kings and Queens of Spades in this captivating, free, and classic card game. Whether you're on your mobile phone or tablet, Spades is always there to help you relax. Install Spades now and start immersing yourself in the thrilling world of trick-taking card games within seconds. Can't decide between playing Spades online or offline? Well, the choice is yours, as we offer both modes for you to enjoy your favorite card game.
NewPub's Spades is the ultimate online alternative to the classic game we all adore. Here's why it stands out:
- 100% Free gameplay, accessible both online and offline.
- An easy-to-learn trick-taking spades game suitable for all skill levels.
- Challenge yourself against skilled AI opponents to refine your spades playing skills.
- Immerse yourself in beautiful game themes and card styles that elevate your spades experience.
- Enjoy a simple, clean, and user-friendly interface that faithfully recreates the tabletop experience, both online and offline.
- Experience smooth gameplay without unnecessary add-ons or annoying ads—just authentic Spades.
- Prepare for an addictive, fun, and challenging online card game that you'll want to revisit whenever stress strikes.
Spades is renowned for its addictive nature, requiring players to predict and declare the number of tricks they expect to win in each game. It can be played in pairs or individually, making it an ideal free card game for at least two players.
Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned Spades pro, we've got some helpful tips and tricks to enhance your gameplay:
- The game uses a standard 52-card pack, where spades are always the trump suit.
- If you're new to the game, observe your opponents' bidding strategies for insights.
- Familiarize yourself with the Rules in our Spades app settings before making your bids and playing.
- Adjust the card animation to "slow" in the app settings for better visibility of your opponents' moves.
- Assess the card suits you've been dealt and aim to win at least the number of tricks you bid.
The winner of each trick leads the next round, but spades cannot be played unless a player has only spades in hand.
Remember, practice makes perfect! Return to this classic Spades app frequently, play regularly, and hone your skills like a pro!
Miss playing Spades offline with friends? You're in luck! The Spades app by NewPub was designed with you in mind, offering skilled opponents for a realistic mind game challenge. bluejetty:00175685:ios.description:
BatteryPro++ is a well-designed battery benchmarking app for iOS devices. It's also the perfect test for your iOS battery, no matter if it’s brand new or gently used.
Did you ever wonder why your device's battery is always running low?
With BatteryPro++ and its technique to identify battery runtimes, you will always know what's wrong with your battery.
►WHAT IT DOES
The application will display your device's runtimes adjusted accordingly or even show you further data on your battery (depending on the iOS version).
►KEY FEATURES
• Monitor your device's runtimes
• Estimated, and calculated raw data
• Easily to check your battery's health
►SUPPORT
The main objective of BatteryTesting is to give users an overview of their device's runtimes. If you are unsure about a battery replacement, feel free to send us an e-mail or tweet us (@BatteryTesting).

bluejetty:00184716:ios.name: Suguru
bluejetty:00184716:ios.summary:
Suguru, also known as Tectonics or Number Blocks, was invented in Japan. These puzzles have very simple instructions, but a very wide range of difficulties, from easy to insanely complex.
Suguru is a great logic puzzle with two very simple
bluejetty:00184716:ios.description:
Suguru, also known as Tectonics or Number Blocks, was invented in Japan. These puzzles have very simple instructions, but a very wide range of difficulties, from easy to insanely complex.
Suguru is a great logic puzzle with two very simple rules. The cells in each puzzle grid are divided into groups, and each group contains the numbers from 1 to N, where N is the number of cells in the group. Thus, a group containing 5 cells will contain numbers from 1 to 5. The second rule is that no two adjacent cells, including diagonal, can contain the same number. Despite these two rules, some puzzles can be incredibly difficult to solve.
Don’t be fooled by the size of the grid, and Suguru’s apparent simplicity. This is a puzzle that can, at its most difficult, challenge the most experienced of solvers. Be warned, this is an addictive puzzle like no other, and a uniquely satisfying one.
In our application, we have created 6000 unique levels with varying degrees of difficulty. If you are playing Suguru for the first time, try the level “Novice”. Each difficulty level contains 1000 unique levels. Where level 1 is easiest and 1000 is the most difficult. If you can easily solve the 1000st level of one difficulty level, try the first level of the next level of difficulty.

bluejetty:00164996:ios.description:
Crush Gems & Jewels in your way!
Have fun playing this free jewel-matching game! All you have to do is to switch and match 3 Jewels to solve the puzzles and unlock new levels in the magical sea world.
Join the legendary adventure in the best match-3 epic puzzle game and play with other jewel lovers in this glittering, mobile jewel game loved by countless players around the world!
Start your underwater adventure in the most popular jewel switch and match puzzle saga by crushing 3 magical jewels of the same shape and color. If you match and swap more than 3 shiny jewels in a line or a row you‘ll be able to blast your way through levels even faster! Smart players will be able to take huge advantage of the various boosters and special jewels available to solve our puzzles! Match 5 jewels of the same color to crush the puzzles with the legendary Rainbow Pearl! Round and shiny!
Playing by yourself is fun, but competing with friends is even funnier! Blast your way to victory by helping Jellyfish, riding Manta Rays, feeding cute Jewel Monsters, uncovering Lost Treasures, crushing Sea Shells and more, in more than 900 addicting levels to quench your thirst of glittering and fun puzzle games in 2021.
Crush clinky Jewels and have a blast in this awesome free jewels game created for players that are craving for more.
Try to crush all of them to achieve victory, advance to the next stage and progress to the next level for that precious winning sensation! Use your smarts and achieve the highest score in all the levels to win!
And the best part: this new, shiny and glittering Jewels fun saga is completely free to play!
How to play:
- Swap and match 3 shiny Jewels of the same kind and type to win magical stars. Matching identical gems in a row or column will ensure great rewards!

- Plan your moves to match 5 clinky Jewels to win a Legendary, mega coloring Jewel: the Rainbow Pearl. A super booster that will make you crush a ton of gems, collect a lot of Jewels and start colorful cascades that will take you to a new, magical dimension.
- Enjoy hundreds of match-3 levels and have fun by resolving entertaining puzzles!
Game features: 
- Earn rewards in many different ways 
- Play fun and addictive puzzles to earn glittering rewards 
- Daily rewards and free boosters.
- Countless shiny, clinky challenges 
- Many, many game modes: collect Jewels, save the colorful Jellyfish, crush the Sea Shells, uncover Lost Treasures, collect the Star Fish, feed the Jewel Monster and more! Complete all levels and help Marina while enjoying this new, addicting jewel game saga!
- Play the best match-3 levels: there‘s hundreds of them and each is a challenging puzzle that will guide you through your magical adventure under the sea.
- A variety of levels added for your addicting games craving pleasure.
- Challenge yourself to collect stars and earn the boosters: can you get 3 in all the levels? Boosters can crush rows and rows of Jewels easily!
- This new jewels swapping and matching game is created by match 3 puzzle lovers for all puzzle lovers! Get ready to crush a lot of glittering gems!

bluejetty:00178094:ios.name: Pocket Laser Level
bluejetty:00178094:ios.summary: Laser level (leveling instrument) is an excellent measurement app equipped with: laser pointer, regular 3-mode spirit level / bubble level (libella) and clinometer (inclinometer) for measuring vertical angles and determining the exact horiz
bluejetty:00178094:ios.description:
Laser level (leveling instrument) is an excellent measurement app equipped with: laser pointer, regular 3-mode spirit level / bubble level (libella) and clinometer (inclinometer) for measuring vertical angles and determining the exact horizontal plane. It's perfect, handy and precise bubble level tool for every handyman.
Main modes of this laser level:
- innovative laser leveling / laser pointer - using built-in sensors (gyroscope and accelerometer), camera and extended / augmented reality, helps you to determine the vertical and horizontal levels around you,
- regular spirit level (bubble level, libella) - works like a traditional bubble level tool, place your smartphone or tablet, on the surface or on the object to be measured or set at any angle,
- clinometer, also called an inclinometer, is primarily used to measure vertical angles and to determine the angle of inclination of any object from the vertical determined by the gravitational force.
These modes are equipped in precision digital and analog indicators. Data are presented in degrees and percentages and any different units which you choose.
Additional features, 
you can:
- calibrate level of your device,
- adjust the precision of measurement,
- read data in different units,
- lock the orientation,
- take pictures while measuring and you can send measurement results to anyone,
- this app does not require internet access.
Sample applications:
- you can measure the angle or inclination of any objects (including distant), such as roof, buildings, columns, mountains, trees, etc.
- you can set any angle of inclination of the surface and the level of home installed appliances, devices, such as: install a refrigerator, washing machine or hang a shelf, painting etc.
- suitable for repair and construction work, you can use it as a digital measuring tape or laser measuring tape,
- useful for interior design, exterior works, in house and in garden,
- many others.
You can use this leveling application wherever you are. This level app is accurate, intuitive, easy to use and very functional.
We wish you successful and accurate measurements.

bluejetty:00089181:ios.description:
NOTE: You must have a Walla account issued by your studio to use this app.
Sign in to your Walla account and get total access to your favorite studio on the Walla platform. Featuring a modern design with intuitive browsing, easily discover the exact fitness experiences you want—without any extra distractions. Buy and book classes and plans, filter to find your next workout, track your accomplishments, and stay in touch with studio announcements. 
Instantly Book Classes
Easily filter your studio schedule by preferred location, fitness category, class type, and instructor so you can find your next workout in seconds! Plus, all filter preferences and favorites automatically save, saving you time on future class bookings. 
Discover Class Plans That Work for You
Unlimited membership or a virtual-only pass? Quickly compare studio plans and prices that work for your wallet and wellness goals—and securely make purchases and payments all in one place. 
Track Your Progress and Celebrate Your Milestones
Whether it's your first yoga class or your fifth workout this week, see what you've accomplished, keep track of your progress, and give yourself a virtual high-five! 
Stay In Touch With Studio News and Announcements 
Be in the know without checking your email inbox (or another app). Get access to real-time studio community updates, including events, promotions, donation-based classes, and competitions. 
Download the Walla app and sign in to your account to access your information, from event announcements and class history to next Tuesday's yoga flow.
The Walla app is currently available in the U.S. only.

bluejetty:00126771:ios.description:
Medical Dictionary - Healthcare Definitions and Terminology is a free, iOS medical dictionary app that gives you instant access to more than 180,000 medical terms, over 50,000 audio pronunciations, and 12,000 images, all from authoritative sources, including McGraw-Hill, Houghton Mifflin, Gale, Elsevier, and more.
Whether you’re a practicing physician, nurse, med student or just plain curious, this free medical dictionary app can help you find clear, in-depth definitions of medical terminology right on your iPhone or iPad. Search from across multiple disciplines - Our medical dictionary app compiles more than a dozen medical dictionary and encyclopedia sources, and includes entries on: 
Anatomy
Physiology
Dentistry
Diseases
Drugs
Nursing
Ophthalmology
Pathology
Treatments
Tests and procedures
Medical research topics
Alternative Medicine
+ much more…
FEATURES:
* Search 180,000+ medical terms and definitions.
* Access over 40,000 entries available anytime offline. 
* Browse 1,000s of medical abbreviations and acronyms. 
* Study more than 4,000 over-the-counter and prescription drugs in our medication guide.
* Add unlimited bookmarks. 
* View your recent searches.
* See search suggestions as you type.
* Perform advanced searches, including "Starts with," "Ends with," "Contains," and "Wildcard."
* Listen to 50,000+ audio pronunciations for both American and British speakers in 'online mode.'
* Share definitions via social networks, email, and text (with supported devices). 
User-friendly, Comprehensive, and Authoritative: Medical Dictionary - Healthcare Definitions and Terminology is the perfect free medical app for doctors, nurses, medical education students, and health care consumers. This is NOT a preview or a trial version, and there is no "locked" content. Open the app on your iPhone or iPad and immediately access all content — no subscriptions required!
How do we do it?
TheFreeDictionary.com - Farlex apps have been downloaded tens of millions times across multiple platforms, with top ratings after hundreds of thousands of reviews. We work with the best publishers to bring together trusted content in the most comprehensive, authoritative dictionary apps on the market. Our flagship app is The Free Dictionary (TFD), powered by TheFreeDictionary.com. Find our other apps by searching "Dictionary by Farlex" in the App Store.

bluejetty:00094656:ios.description:
Your Crochet Journey Starts Here
Discover the easiest way to learn crochet and knitting with Yarnbie! Upload a photo, from cozy accessories to adorable plush toys, and let our AI suggest a complete, step-by-step pattern in seconds.
Whether you're picking up a hook for the first time or hunting for fresh inspiration, Yarnbie brings your creative vision to life, one stitch at a time.
And now you're never crafting alone — join a thriving community of makers, share your projects, follow your favorite creators, and discover endless inspiration in your personalized feed.
No confusing patterns. No guesswork. Just clear, guided projects for everyone.
Why You'll Love This App:
Join the Maker Community
Share your finished projects with photos, browse a personalized feed full of inspiration, and connect with crafters around the world. Crafting is better together!
Follow Your Favorite Creators
Build your own profile, showcase your makes, follow other crafters, and grow your following as you share your journey.
Like, Comment & Save
Cheer on fellow makers with likes, leave encouraging comments, and bookmark the projects and patterns you love.
Share & Discover Projects
Share your makes and explore an ever-growing feed from the community.
Photo to Pattern
Upload your inspiration and receive a custom crochet or knitting pattern with clear, step-by-step instructions powered by AI.
Yarn & Fiber Details
Get fiber type, yarn amount, and hook or needle size recommendations tailored to every pattern.
AI-Powered Craft Tutor
Master every technique with our intelligent tutor, backed by an extensive tutorial video library for crochet and knitting.
Step-by-Step Progress Tracking
Check off each instruction as you go and watch your project take shape.
Built-in Row Counter
Never lose your place again! Our integrated counter tracks your stitches and rows effortlessly.
Advanced Stitch Calculator
Determine exact stitch counts and gauge adjustments for flawless results.
Color Palette Generator
Design harmonious color schemes, perfect for vibrant, multi-colored projects.
Yarn Calculator & Unit Converter
Calculate precise yarn requirements and convert measurements seamlessly.
Complete Material List
Know exactly what yarn, hooks, needles, and notions you'll need before you begin.
Extensive Video Library & Glossary
Access a comprehensive tutorial video collection plus detailed term explanations.
Save Your Patterns
Build your personal library and bookmark all your favorite patterns.
Multilingual Support
Learn comfortably in your native language.
For All Skill Levels
From beginner-friendly basics to advanced techniques, we've got you covered!
Transform Your Crafting Experience
Yarnbie is more than just an app. It's your complete digital craft studio and creative community. With AI-powered tutoring, yarn and fiber guidance, precision tracking tools, and a vibrant social feed to share and discover projects, everything you need is right at your fingertips.
Turn inspiration into creation, then share it with a community that gets it! Download now and start crafting today!

bluejetty:00086909:ios.description:
مواقيت فلسطين
البرنامج يشمل المأثورات, من خير الاوراد والاذكار والادعية الجامعة والشاملة من كتاب 
الله وسنة نبيه علية الصلاة والسلام, مع امكانية سماع المأثورات, برنامج مواقيت الصلاة هو أول برنامج يوفر مواقيت الصلاة لبيت المقدس وأكنافه حسب التقويم الدهري الدقيق لفلسطين وفق وزارة الاوقاف. 
البرنامج الوحيد الذي يعرض مواقيت الصلاة بدقة تامة بدون تأخير دقيقة أو تقديمها حسب التقويم المعتمد (اي يعمل مثل موقتة الاوائل في المساجد).
البرنامج لا يعتمد على معادلات تقريبية لحساب أوقات الصلاة وإنما يعتمد على قاعدة بيانات دقيقة كلفت القائمين على البرنامج مجهودًا لجعل تنبيه الآيفون يعمل تمامًا مع الأذان ولن تحتاج للتأكد مرة أخرى من أوقات الصلاة في تقويم المسجد الذي تصلي فيه (فلسطين)
مميزات التطبيق:
•المأثورات واذكار الصلاة 
•مواقيت الصلاة بدقة بدون تأخير دقيقة أو تقديمها (مثل موقتة الاوائل في المساجد) 
•التنبيه في أوقات الصلاة و قبلها و بعدها دون الحاجة لفتح التطبيق
•تحديد إتجاه القبلة بدقة أينما كنت
•يعرض الموقع الحالي ، و اتجاه القبلة على الخريطة 
•تنبيهات خاصة بالصلوات يمكنك ضبطها لكل صلاة على حدة وهي: تنبيه بالأذان ــ تنبيه قبل الأذان ــ تنبيه بإقامة الصلاة 
•امكانية سماع المأثورات
•يحسب البرنامج الثلث الأخير من الليل لمن يتحرى أوقات الإجابة
•خدمة ذكرني بسنن الجمعة 
•التقويم الهجري 
نصائح من أجل استعمال أفضل : حتى يتم تحديث إشعارات الأذان إحرص على فتح التطبيق مرة كل أسبوع على الأقل

bluejetty:00180617:ios.description:
Staying healthy. Saving time. Spending less. The CVS Health® app makes them all easier. Here’s how: 
Checking out. Easier.
• Save with ExtraCare® and pick up prescriptions with a single scan (just tap “In-Store”).
Saving money. Easier.
• Get app-only deals and access all of your offers and rewards when you link your ExtraCare® card. 
• Make sure you never miss a deal by opting in to notifications. Get prescription and order updates too. 
• Plan out your shopping and saving with the weekly ad for your local store.
Getting prescriptions. Easier. 
• Scan your barcode for faster prescription pickup once you attach a payment and signature.
• Pay for your medications and have them delivered.
• Order refills, check their status and see your prescription history.
• Check drug interactions and information. 
Caring for your health. Easier.
• Schedule vaccines for you and your family at a nearby CVS Pharmacy® or MinuteClinic®.
• Video chat with a health care provider 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
• Find a nearby MinuteClinic® for general care and clinical services. 
• View wait times and schedule a clinic visit (restrictions apply). 
• Check available health care services and insurance coverage.
Your benefits. Easier.
• Eligible Caremark members can now access their member ID card, plan spending info and select plan details.
• Eligible Aetna members can access their member ID card.
Printing photos. Easier. 
• Order prints and more from your device and online albums for same-day pickup (select stores and products). 
Privacy Policy: https://www.cvs.com/retail/help/privacy_policy
WA Consumer Health Privacy Policy: https://www.cvs.com/retail/help/WA_consumer_health_privacy_policy

-Variations:

~Sweep
~Other Variations
-Multiplayer:
~2-4 players
~Play Locally over bluetooth or wifi
~Or Online through game center
~Or Turn-Based online through game center
-Game Center:
~Leaderboards
~Achievements
-Statistics
~Tracks wins and losses against each difficulty level

bluejetty:00070662:ios.name: Shadow Knight Ninja Fight Game
bluejetty:00070662:ios.summary:
Challenge your skill with new mode & new boss!!!
Harmonia used to be a bright world of all races, where Human, Orc, Spirit, Dwarf, Beast man and Elf live in peace together. One day, when deep desires arose, the dark forces ascended from he
bluejetty:00070662:ios.description:
Challenge your skill with new mode & new boss!!!
Harmonia used to be a bright world of all races, where Human, Orc, Spirit, Dwarf, Beast man and Elf live in peace together. One day, when deep desires arose, the dark forces ascended from hell, invading the world, that tragedy struck every Harmonia citizen and made everything sink to the depths of despair.
Play the role of Noah - a Shadow Knight, you need to make your way through the hell gate, fight evil enemies, defeat the immortals of Darkness and bring back the light to Harmonia. You will find Ashley and Lucius - your companions on the journey saving Harmonia!
Download and Join the fight now!
GAME FEATURES:
▶ The True Feeling of an Action RPG Game
Experience the action RPG game feeling with hack and slash gameplay in the dark fantasy world setting. There are 10 maps from The Stream City, Shadow Forest to Capitals of The Mortals, and they are still updated. 
▶ Watch out the monsters and bosses!
With the absence of light, evil reveals its true form. 
Monsters in each place have different shapes, skills, and stories behind them. Sometimes you have to take them down even when you're the weaker. Beware of skeletons, elves that can control your body and your mind, be sure to use skills with the right combo, dodge their attack wisely. 
Bosses have their stories as well. They are giant Kings of the dark lands with sturdy physique, robust strength, and particular abilities. Facing them requires more than just powerful stats. 
▶ Fight with multiple choices
Fight the way you want as you can choose your own unique heroes, determine your favorite fighting style among slashing a big sword, shooting slugs, or piercing invisible spears. In each match, you can pick 2 characters to play and they can be readily switched. 
Keep in mind that Each hero can knock the enemy up, knockdown, toss back,...
Dodging smoothly, controlling enemies effectively, and using skills combo calmly is the key to win every battle
▶ Embark on a horrid but fascinating adventure!
Not only you, we also get bored with the limit of horizontal gameplay only mode. 
In Shadow Knight, you will go on a journey with different terrains by running, climbing, jumping, where you will confront more danger, further difficulty, and additionally have chances to get more rewards in return as we put some easter eggs and hidden rewards along the way. 
▶ Interact with others and show the world your skills
You will be immersed in endless dark fantasy shadow battles. Besides towns, forests, dungeons, as an online game, you can interact with others unlimitedly, engage in endless battles with tremendously competitive and merciless battlefields such as Survival, World Boss, PVP Arena,... These features will be available soon!
▶ Gear Up In Style
Collect the best weapon, equipment, rune from hundreds of items, then fully customize your Shadow Knight to stand out from other knights. Join the adventure and create the craziest combats 'cause Your Knight, Your Style! 
▶ Easy In Upgrading
While you're away, your knights are still being trained and collecting resources to upgrade. When you're back, they will be stronger, gain new levels, learn new skills. Grow and train a powerful team and ready for battles!
ACE THE SHADOW!
* Follow us on social media for more information and get support:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ShadowKnight.Official
Email: support@fansipan.hk
* Notice:
Shadow Knight is an online game and requires a stable internet connection.

bluejetty:00186700:ios.summary:
Learn & practice your speaking, reading, listening and Korean writing skills with Lanny – the chatbot tutor. Have a chatbot tutor in your pocket!
---
Looking for a live chatbot app to learn the Korean language? Want 1 Korean learning chat
bluejetty:00186700:ios.description:
Learn & practice your speaking, reading, listening and Korean writing skills with Lanny – the chatbot tutor. Have a chatbot tutor in your pocket!
---
Looking for a live chatbot app to learn the Korean language? Want 1 Korean learning chat app to learn & practice:
.. Korean reading
.. Korean writing
.. Korean vocabulary
.. Korean speaking
Well, you need Eggbun, the Korean language learning chatbot. With 1,000,000+ users worldwide, Eggbun is the most popular way to learn Korean language!
LEARN WITH Lanny – THE CHATBOT TUTOR
It’s a fun chat Korean app that allows you to practice your speaking, reading, listening and Korean writing skills… all by chat. Get started by chatting with your personal chatbot tutor, Lanny, and get access to 550+ Korean lessons, whether it’s Korean for beginners or advanced language learners. With Lanny in your pocket, you can learn Korean online anytime, anywhere!
WHY YOU’LL LOVE EGGBUN
Neatly organized, beautifully designed and fun, the Korean live chat app allows you to…
- Get Korean language basics in one place - Start with learning Hangeul, basic verbs, phrases, and sentences!
- Actually communicate in South Korean language - All the phrases and words for travel in Korea that you need to know, ordering guides and even the occasional K-drama reference. We believe that context is the best way to learn.
- Talk like a native speaker - It's not just text, but audio to help you with pronunciation too! Eggbun Korean language tutorials include audio by native Korean speakers that are sure to help you with your Korean speaking & Korean vocabulary.
- Get a strong understanding of Korean culture - Eggbun has Culture Notes to help you really understand and learn Korean culture! It’s like you have an ability to chat with Korean people and you probably know that learning Korean is much easier when done through chatting.
And all this is designed in the simplest UI you’ll ever see in a Learning Korean app.. we can guarantee that!
EASY PROCESS TO GET STARTED
Download and sign up via the popular email & social media networks with one click. Explore categories like Korean characters, greeting expressions, pronunciations, real-life conversations, common verb endings, business, and more, but don’t forget to especially check the Survival Korean for Travelers series.
Everything is made to be fun, fast and conversational, yet memorable and effective!
All your progress is tied to your account, so you can come back and continue your learning process at any time & anywhere.
Don’t miss the opportunity to finally learn this amazing language.
Learning with Eggbun is like having a Korean language school… on your phone.
Download the ultimate chat Korean bot to:
.. learn to speak Korean
.. learn to write Korean
.. understand Korean
NOTE:
If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us at help@eggbun-edu.com.
Website: https://web.eggbun.net
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eggbun_education
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/eggbun.edu
--------------------

bluejetty:00037386:ios.description:
Welcome to Sink Zone 3D, the ultimate sinkhole adventure! Get ready to experience the thrill of controlling massive sinkholes that consume everything in their path. With dynamic gameplay, exciting challenges, and vivid 3D environments, this game guarantees endless fun.
Dive into the action-packed world of Sink Zone 3D, the ultimate game of growth and domination! Take control of a powerful sinkhole and explore vibrant 3D arenas, where everything in sight can be consumed. Your goal? Absorb objects, grow bigger, and outplay your rivals in a thrilling competition of skill, strategy, and survival!
Explore Dynamic 3D Worlds
From bustling cityscapes to open parks and industrial zones, each level offers unique environments to explore and devour. Watch as your sinkhole grows bigger with every object you absorb, from tiny trash cans to towering skyscrapers!
Control the Sinkhole: Swipe to guide the sinkhole and swallow objects, buildings, and more!
Challenging Levels: Master your skills across unique, progressively harder levels.
Upgrade Your Zone: Earn rewards to expand your sinkhole’s power and range.
Immersive 3D Graphics: Experience stunning visuals and smooth gameplay.
Relaxing Yet Addictive: Perfect for both quick play sessions and long gaming marathons!

bluejetty:00180738:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00180738:ios.description:
Meet Millie, the ordinary lap dog who turns real life into outrageous adventure. 
Welcome to Millie's Puppy School, where Professor Millie teaches dogs how to train their out-of-control humans. In this bath-battling app, “puppies” aged 4+ will laugh out loud as they help Millie STAY STINKY!
HONORS FOR MILLIE
• A Kirkus “Best Book of the Year” Winner
• Editor’s Choice, Children’s Technology Review
• A Washington Post’s “Best Apps to Give and Get”
CRITICS LOVE CUTE LITTLE MILLIE 
“With its universal humor and adorable star, Millie deserves space on any family's iPad.”
– Parent’s Choice 
“Millie offers the kind of humor that appeals to both kids and parents on different levels.” 
– Common Sense Media
“She’s a good dog with a great set of apps. Millie’s misadventures could continue indefinitely with its exuberant storytelling and attention to detail.”
– Kirkus Book Review
“My seven-year-old daughter found [Millie] to be incredibly funny. She ‘oohed’ and ‘ahhed’ over the adorable art.”
– WIRED
“Children’s apps have all begun to look alike but Millie Was Here stands alone as the pick of the litter.” 
– The Horn Book
SMART SCREEN TIME 
Hidden inside that adorable, furry little exterior is an interactive reading experience with some serious educational value. The apps are designed with education experts & child development specialists to engage and support beginning readers. They encourage deep learning activities such as: imagination, exploration, problem-solving, inference, reading comprehension & expanding vocabulary.
Millie Was Here is used in thousands of schools, by everyone from classroom teachers to speech language pathologists, because Millie’s greatest superpower of all is her ability to ENGAGE READERS—even the most reluctant readers.
FEATURES
• Kids can listen to the dramatic narration or read it themselves
• Loaded with surprising interactivity, including a large open play area
• Packed with adorable photos and video of real dog, Millie, and tons of wacky animation
• Find hidden stickers on every page, and collect them in a sticker book
• Card Maker. Use the stickers you’ve collected in this artistic activity
• Read-along text highlights words as they are read aloud
• Professional dramatic narration models proper pronunciation and fluency
• “Bedtime Mode” creates a calmer experience for nighttime reading
• Original, professional artwork, photography, and music composition
FEATURES FOR EDUCATORS
• Educator’s/Learning Guide: 
Because the apps live in the digital world, our accompanying Educator’s Guides focus on real world skills. They feature fun, core-aligned classroom projects covering subjects & skills from English Language Arts to Social Emotional Learning. Lessons are offered in a simple step-by-step format in a printable 44 page PDF found in the app's Educator's section. Activities include:
1) Let’s Make Millie Origami (STEAM)
2) Millie’s Stink Lab (STEM)
3) Dirty Dog or Clean Canine? (ELA) 
4) Doggy Feelings Charades (SEL) 
5) Millie’s Bath Mix-Up (ELA)
• Classroom Mode:
Gives educators persistent controls for classroom use & in special needs settings (designed with developmental experts, teachers, and SLPs) 
1) Trigger the narration in each page to be read at any time 
2) Rewind interactive activities to give each child a turn
3) Freeze the action on command for impromptu discussions
4) Reward good behavior at any time with delightful Gold Millie Coins!
• Record your own narration
Kids can practice the important skill of reading aloud by recording their own narration for the book. A recording studio mix recording your own narration simple.
PRIVACY
Megapops takes children's privacy very seriously. We are COPPA compliant, collect no personal information, have no advertising, and no in-app purchases. For more information, please see our privacy policy: www.megapops.com/privacy-policy
ABOUT MEGAPOPS
We are an independent studio of designers, engineers and artists, founded in 2011.

bluejetty:00120525:ios.description:
1800+ phrase & sentence level reading comprehension tasks with the option of creating your own exercises! 
**Try for FREE as part of Language Therapy Lite or purchase in our 4-in-1 bundle: Language Therapy ** 
This app gives adults with neurological impairment (stroke, brain injury, aphasia) and older children with special needs the practice they need in between reading words and reading stories. It's a digital workbook of semantically organized reading comprehension tasks with the added ability for you to create your own exercises in each mode! 
Goal Areas: Reading Comprehension, Attention, Problem Solving, Visual Processing, Reasoning 
Can be used with: Aphasia, Alexia, Alzheimer's Disease, Dementia, Cognitive-Communication Impairment, Brain Injury, Early Language Learners, Language Learning Disability, Autism, English as a Second Language Learners 
Features: 
*4 modes with over 450 exercises each, for 1,800+ reading comprehension practice items
1)Phrase Matching 
2)Sentence Matching 
3)Phrase Completion 
4)Sentence Completion 
*Hundreds of clear full-color photographs selected by a Speech-Language Pathologist used in both matching modes 
*Carefully-crafted foils on each exercise challenge users to read carefully 
*Clean interface with symbol support allows for independent use 
*Automated scoring allows for easy data-tracking 
*Wrong answers are grayed out once selected 
*Forward and back buttons allow users to skip items and go back to discuss completed items or retry skipped exercises 
*Child-friendly mode removes references to adult themes and disables links to outside sites 
*Users see their answers paired with the stimulus for reinforcement of the correct answer 
*Turn any picture/word on or off 
*Limit answer choices to 2, 3, or 4, or automatically adjust based on performance
*Results can be e-mailed in a report-ready format so clients can keep their therapist informed of their progress and therapists can send results to themselves for charting later, using the copy-and-paste ready format to decrease documentation time

bluejetty:00099556:ios.summary:
Wool Sorting: Unravel Yarn 3D – Untangle, Sort, and Relax in a Cozy Yarn World!
Step into the soft and colorful world of wool, where every puzzle is a chance to unravel tangled threads and sort vibrant colors. In Wool Sorting: Unravel Yarn
bluejetty:00099556:ios.description:
Wool Sorting: Unravel Yarn 3D – Untangle, Sort, and Relax in a Cozy Yarn World!
Step into the soft and colorful world of wool, where every puzzle is a chance to unravel tangled threads and sort vibrant colors. In Wool Sorting: Unravel Yarn 3D, you will explore a relaxing 3D playground full of fluffy yarn balls, charming knots, and satisfying animations. Your mission is simple but addictive: sort the yarn, unravel the tangles, and bring peace to the world of wool!
Imagine a cozy room filled with rainbow yarn balls, soft wool threads, and playful knots waiting for your touch. Every move you make to sort and unravel brings instant satisfaction. Whether you’re winding down after a long day or looking for a chill 3D puzzle to focus your mind, this wool sorting adventure will become your favorite daily escape.
How to Play Wool Sorting: Unravel Yarn 3D
- Tap and drag the colorful yarn balls to sort them by color.
- Unravel tricky wool tangles by using empty slots wisely.
- Complete each stack to clear the level and unlock more challenging 3D puzzles.
- Think ahead—smart moves are the key to becoming a true yarn master!
Key Features
- Relaxing and colorful 3D yarn puzzles that keep your mind at ease
- Hundreds of handcrafted wool sort levels that grow in difficulty
- ASMR-inspired effects for the ultimate unravel satisfaction
- Smooth animations as you sort yarn and watch the wool untangle
- Easy one-hand controls—perfect for short breaks or cozy evenings
As you progress, the wool sort challenges become more thrilling. From simple color stacks to complex yarn knots, each level tests your logic and planning. Every perfect unravel rewards you with visual delight and a sense of mastery in this cozy 3D puzzle world.
If you’re searching for a calm yet addictive experience, Wool Sorting: Unravel Yarn 3D is the ultimate choice. Sort wool, unravel yarn, and let the soothing rhythm of this 3D puzzle relax your mind anytime, anywhere.
Download Wool Sorting: Unravel Yarn 3D now! Untangle knots, sort the colors, and dive into the most satisfying wool puzzle adventure ever!

bluejetty:00128448:ios.description:
► Blend It 3D – Never-Ending Blending
Are you ready to become a smoothie operator and the starriest of baristas? Blend It 3D is a super-fun, super-casual cooking and restaurant-management game that whisks you away to a tropical island and puts you behind a bar on the beach, where you can test your blending skills to serve a colorful array of customers delicious (and sometimes disturbing) drinks with exotic ingredients and beautiful decorations. An intoxicating blend of cooking, design, and restaurant management with a dash of surreal humor, Blend It 3D is a game of exotic, healthy fun for all ages.
► Aren’t you a smoothie?
• Blend it like a pro – just tap on the screen to blend all sorts of delicious food and some more unexpected ingredients. Sounds easy? In this game, every ingredient has a different consistency and blending speed, so you’ll have to time your blend to perfection to ensure you get the proportions of your customer’s order just right.
• Here comes a regular – you’d be amazed who washes up on your tropical beach. Serve a fascinating array of customers including pirates, robots, Einsteins and Frankensteins, all with their own very particular tastes, not all of which can be found among the regular food types. Who do you think prefers rotten fruit smoothies? And who goes for a subtle blend of old sneakers and cellphones? Blend, decorate, and serve their drinks in style, and you’ll be rewarded with heaps of stars for every satisfied customer.
• It’s in the stars – spend your rewards on upgrading your bar to turn it from a simple shack to a luxury tropical paradise. You can also improve your business by collecting new equipment, glassware, decorations, and ingredients, meaning you can keep an even more varied clientele happy in the game and go on blending to your heart’s content.
• Don’t forget the coffee – sometimes your customers demand a break from smoothies, so pick up a coffee machine fast and show off your barista skills to brew the perfect cup and decorate it with beautiful coffee art. 
• Now we’re cooking – bright, beautiful graphics and a funky soundtrack enhance the tropical vacation experience, making Blend It 3D a game you’ll always want to go back to.
• My favorite blend – Blend It 3D combines simple gameplay with a dizzying array of game mechanics and a wide variety of upgradable features, making for a casual but highly addictive playing experience that will keep you coming back for just one more delicious smoothie.
► Everyone loves a happy blending…
Love cooking games? Like the idea of designing a tropical beach bar? Looking for fresh, entertaining mobile fun that’s easy to play but very engaging? Enjoy the smoothiest of casual gaming experiences with Blend It 3D, the tropical restaurant game that gives you plenty to process. Download it now, happy blending guaranteed!

bluejetty:00068501:ios.description:
A word from the developer: Working out consistently has always been a struggle for me until someone introduced me to the 100-Day Burpees challenge. 
For the first time, I managed to work out consistently for 87 days in a row. On day 88, food poisoning put an end to my challenge and I didn't make it to 100 days. 
The good news is that I'm now ready to start again with a great new app to track my progress.
I built this app for different reasons: 
1. It will push me to continue working out because I love challenging myself and keep track of my progress.
2. It will help folks that struggle to get back into shape by offering them easy workouts that can be done at home without any gear or equipment. 
3. If you're a competitor at heart, it's a great tool to gamify your workouts with friends.
Whether your goal is to lose weight, get fitter or build muscle, you can shape your challenge to suit your level and preferences.
Here is how it works: 
1. Pick an exercise: burpees, push-ups, sit-ups, squats, kneeing push-ups, lunges, jumping jacks, mountain climber...
2. Select the length of your challenge: 3, 7, 10, 30, 60, 90 or 100 days.
3. (Optional) Set a number of reps you will add every day (+1 per day is recommended for beginners), but you can also pick 0 to keep the same amount of reps per day throughout your challenge.
4. Select the number of reps you will do on day one. (start small, especially for longer challenges)
That leaves you with a challenge that could look like this: 
- Starting with 5 burpees today, I will do five more burpees every day for the next 10 days.
- Starting with 1 push-up today, I will do one more push-up every day for the next 30 days.
- I will do 7 jumping jacks every day for 7 days.
- ... 
The key is not to smash huge sessions straight away. You need to get your body used to move. And starting with a minuscule amount of efforts is the best way to fight procrastination. 
I remember when I started my 100-day burpee challenge a few months ago... I just decided to start, did 1 burpee and I was done for the day. The next day, I did two burpees and I was done for the day. And with small incremental progress like that... I slowly started gaining strength and felt better in my body.
If you would have told me I would be able to do 87 burpees in a row when I started, I would have never believed it. 
So that's the key... start with dead-easy goals, show up every day and do a little more every day. 
Important rule built in these challenges: If you miss your reps on a specific day, you need to catch up on the next day. So if you had to do 10 push-ups today, and tomorrow you are meant to do 11, but you skip today somehow. You will have to do 21 push-ups tomorrow. This built-in rule is a great way to keep yourself committed and motivated do show up every day. 
I hope you will like what I came up with. All feedback, suggestions can be sent to me on this email: edouard.developer@gmail.com and you can also find me on Instagram at @edouard_iosdev. I occasionally share my burpees session in my Stories so definitely be on the lookout for that. 
Happy workouts people.
Cheers, 
Ed
Privacy policy & Terms of Use: https://www.edouardbarbier.com/apps/one-rep/privacy/

Take charge of your mental health. Overcome anxiety and depression with CBT journaling. Backed by science, enhanced with AI. 81% of people with moderate to severe anxiety see an improvement after just one month of using Unstuck.
By process
bluejetty:00142667:ios.description:
Take charge of your mental health. Overcome anxiety and depression with CBT journaling. Backed by science, enhanced with AI. 81% of people with moderate to severe anxiety see an improvement after just one month of using Unstuck.
By processing your thoughts and experiences with a guided CBT journal, you’ll develop the skills to take control of your mental health. Unstuck is based on cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), the gold standard treatment in psychotherapy. The techniques we use are backed by science, so expect results.
CBT is effective, not just for anxiety and depression, but also for stress, anger, trauma (PTSD), OCD, ADHD, and BPD.
JOURNALING
Unstuck includes multiple journals that work in unison to improve mental health.
Thought Journal: Understand and train your brain to overcome unhelpful thinking patterns. 80% of people with distress see an instant improvement after completing an entry.
Savoring Journal: Find joy and gratitude in daily life. 74% of people with anxiety see an immediate positive impact after completing an entry.
Exposure Journal: Fight your fears by facing them with exposure therapy. This extremely powerful method for overcoming anxiety is out now. Unstuck utilizes inhibitory retrieval, the most effective exposure therapy approach based on the latest research (Craske et al., 2022).
Mood Tracker: Understand the day to day impact of people, places, and activities on your mood with the Check-in journal.
DISCOVER INSIGHTS
Unstuck will deliver personalized insights so you can understand how your thought patterns change over time. Discover which thinking traps you’ve overcome and which you’re still falling into. See how events in your life are tied to changing levels of anxiety and depression. Draw meaningful connections to accelerate your mental health improvement.
AI SECOND OPINION
Not just a chatbot that spoon-feeds responses, your AI partner will strengthen your Thought Journal by conducting an objective analysis, uncovering thinking traps, and offering a fresh perspective.
AI FEAR FINDER
Get AI assistance with exposure therapy. AI Fear Finder helps identify your underlying fears, so they can be effectively targeted with the Exposure Journal.
DARK MODE
Whether you love the soothing vibe of dark hues or want to ease the strain on your eyes during late-night journaling, Unstuck has you covered. Choose from Dark Mode, Light Mode, or sync with your device settings for a seamless experience.
ACCESS ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Get the support you need on the go with our mobile app. Or, if you prefer typing on a keyboard, use our website to access Unstuck from your desktop computer.
KEEP YOUR DATA SAFE
Create an optional account and Unstuck will automatically keep your data backed up and synced. Or, create local backups with the data export feature.
TRY FOR FREE
Try Unstuck with a free trial. After that, we offer monthly and yearly subscriptions.
If you are facing financial hardship, apply for a free plan in the app. We believe Unstuck should be accessible to everyone and do not want to turn anyone away for lack of funds.
Insights provided by Unstuck do not constitute medical advice. Always check with your doctor before making medical decisions.
We always love hearing your feedback — send it to us in the app or by emailing us at feedback@becomeunstuck.app.

bluejetty:00164017:ios.summary: Try Rapido (रैपिडो), India’s first and largest Bike-Taxi Service. Our bike rides help you cut through traffic, reach on time, and save money. We also have autos and cabs for you. With Rapido, you get a low-price, comfortable and quick auto,
bluejetty:00164017:ios.description:
Try Rapido (रैपिडो), India’s first and largest Bike-Taxi Service. Our bike rides help you cut through traffic, reach on time, and save money. We also have autos and cabs for you. With Rapido, you get a low-price, comfortable and quick auto, bike and cab ride every single time. 
With a presence in 500+ cities and over 75+ million customers have done billions of rides on Rapido Bike Taxi, Auto & Cabs,. The app has over 75+ million happy customers who prefer Rapido Autos, Bike and Cab rides for intra-city and last-mile commutes. We have a fleet of over 1 million Captains (Bike-Taxi riders, Auto and Cab drivers), with rides available in Metros, Tier-1, Tier-2, and Tier-3 cities, soon launching in other parts of the country too. Since its inception, Rapido has stood by its promise of giving low-price, comfortable and quick auto, bike and cab rides to all its users.
Whether it’s a hectic Monday morning or a relaxed weekend outing, Rapido offers affordable and quick auto, bike, and cab rides. Even during peak traffic, Rapido’s seamless doorstep pick-ups ensure that you reach your destination quick and easily. Apart from being low-priced, you also get exciting offers on auto, bike, and cab rides on Rapido. So, the next time you’re stepping out, get a quick bike ride with Rapido and leave the traffic behind. If a couple of you are stepping out, book a comfortable and affordable Rapido auto or a Rapido cab.
No more waiting and adjusting to shared rides and crowded buses! Whether you’re going to or from the metro, choose a Rapido auto or bike ride to travel comfortably and quickly. 
Download the Rapido App and get Auto, Bike or Cab ride in 5 min at unbeatable prices.
We prioritise your safety!
Every Rapido auto, bike or cab ride is insured with Acko Insurance without any extra cost. We ensure our captains abide by all traffic rules during an auto, a bike or a cab ride. Our Bike-Taxis also prioritise every pillion rider’s safety by providing a helmet for each bike ride. Rapido offers you an affordable, quick, and comfortable auto, bike or cab ride by taking care of all the safety concerns.
Easy to Use Rapido App
The Rapido app offers a simplified approach to booking an auto, a bike or a cab ride. Now, you don’t have to worry about remembering a different OTP for every single ride. You get a unique PIN that remains the same every time you book an auto, a bike or a cab ride!
Vernacular app – Available in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada.
One-click login – Seamless registration and onboarding.
Favourites – Save frequently visited locations for easier access.
Live tracking – Follow the real-time location of the ride.
Cashless and Safe Payment Methods
Whether you’re taking an auto, a bike ride or a cab ride, Rapido encourages you to go digital. It provides cashless payment options such as PayTM, UPI, and Rapido Wallet.

bluejetty:00126184:ios.description:
This app is like your personal coach, just focus on your workout without having to worry about time, Best Interval Timer will lead you to finish them perfectly.
There is one default routine in this free version, but you can edit it to your own one which include warm-up, high/low intensity, cool down and rest time etc, you can custom as many sets as you wish to do.
Key Features:
⁃ One default routine.
⁃ Big readable counting down time.
⁃ Start, pause or reset routine.
⁃ Warm up, low intensity, high intensity, cool down, rest time.
⁃ Support background, foreground playing and multitasking.
⁃ Music plays.
⁃ Vibrate or not.
⁃ 15 interval switch sounds.
⁃ 12 background interval pictures available. 
⁃ Show number of times you have practiced of one routine.
⁃ Support landscape and portrait.

bluejetty:00145922:ios.description:
Zencastr hands you a podcast studio's worth of tools for Free. 
Zencastr is where people go to create, publish, and monetize their podcasts, whether you're recording a video podcast, an audio-only show, or a remote interview.
Turn a conversation into a fully produced episode, ready to publish in minutes, not weeks. Your personalized Producer does everything from cleaning up audio, to making the edits you want, to cutting clips for socials, to publishing your episode and clips to every major platform.
Plus, on Zencastr, you don't need an audience to start earning, either. Get paid for your progress from day one.
Key Features:
AUDIO & VIDEO RECORDING — Record with up to 6 participants, each on their own separate audio and video track.
- Up to 4K video, 48kHz WAV and MP3 audio
- Unlimited recording time, for Free
- Locally recorded on your device for studio-quality sound and zero dropouts
- Real-time cloud backup + Google Drive & Dropbox sync
AI-ASSISTED EDITING AND PRODUCTION
- From audio cleanup and editing, to chaptering and shownotes, to creating social clips, and more — do it all by chatting with your personalized Producer. 
- Clean up audio and remove long pauses and filler words
- Talk with your Producer in natural language to make the edits you want
- Generate chapters, cover art, and show notes
- Apply visual templates and titles
AI CLIP MAKING — Let your Producer find the moments worth clipping, or tell it exactly what you want.
- Get auto-generated clips, or clip moments you select 
- Caption every clip, accurate and on-brand
- Cut from your original, locally recorded footage 
- Formatted correctly for every platform
- Schedule and publish clips straight to socials
HOSTING & PUBLISHING — Upload, host, and publish without limits.
- Unlimited audio and video uploads and hosting
- Embeddable audio and video player for your site
- Video streaming in 1080p
- Secure, private RSS feed
- Advanced analytics from day one
- Host up to 5 shows
- Publish to all major social and podcast platforms
- Custom links in your post-roll
- Schedule clips and social posts ahead of time
LIVE STREAMING — Go live in high quality, right from Zencastr.
- HD livestreaming to the major live streaming platforms.
GET PAID — Start earning from day one, no audience required.
- Get paid as you hit milestones in your podcast journey
- Unlock brand deals and dynamically inserted ads as your audience grows
- Track it all with ad campaign analytics
STORAGE — Unlimited storage for every track you record
COLLABORATION — Bring your team in on the full podcast production process.
- Role-based permissions
- Up to 4 seats
Terms of service: https://zencastr.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00116798:ios.description:
Blocks Daily Break: Your Ultimate Block Puzzle Game Experience
Welcome to Blocks Daily Break, the ultimate block puzzle game that combines simplicity, relaxation, and brain-training fun. Whether you're looking to unwind, challenge yourself, or pass the time, Blocks Daily Break is the perfect companion. Dive into this engaging and addictive block puzzle game where your skills and strategy will be put to the test! Feel the excitement of block smash as you clear the grid.
Why Blocks Daily Break
Easy to Play: Blocks Daily Break is designed to be intuitive and easy to pick up, making it perfect for players of all ages and skill levels. Simply drag and drop blocks to complete rows or columns in this block puzzle game, and enjoy the satisfying block smash when you clear lines.
Train Your Brain: Sharpen your mind with each move. Blocks Daily Break encourages logical thinking and problem-solving, providing a great mental workout through its block blaster challenges.
Relax and Unwind: The soothing gameplay and lack of time limits make Blocks Daily Break an ideal choice for relaxation. Take your time and enjoy the process of fitting the pieces together in this block puzzle game.
Prove Your Skills: Challenge yourself to reach higher scores and improve your block blaster strategies. The more you play, the better you'll get at block smash moves!
Perfect Time Killer: Whether you're on a short break or have a few minutes to spare, Blocks Daily Break is the perfect way to pass the time with its engaging block puzzle game mechanics.
How to Play Blocks Daily Break:
Drag and Drop: Move the blocks onto the 8x8 grid. Arrange them strategically to complete horizontal or vertical lines in this block puzzle game.
Clear Lines: When you fill a row or column, it clears, making room for new blocks.
Endless Fun: The game continues until there is no more space for new blocks. Keep your grid clear to keep playing!
No Rotations: Blocks cannot be rotated, adding an extra layer of challenge and requiring thoughtful placement in this block puzzle game.
Benefits of Playing Blocks Daily Break:
Boosts Cognitive Skills: Regular play can improve your spatial awareness through this block puzzle game.
Stress Relief: The calming gameplay helps reduce stress.
Keeps Your Mind Sharp: Engaging with Blocks Daily Break regularly can help keep your brain active.

bluejetty:00175479:ios.description:
Puzzles & Chaos is a match-3 fantasy strategy game that tells an ancient legend of a Frozen Land.
A once prosperous continent now lies frozen due to the bizarre magic of the undead.
The humans, dragons, and other magical creatures who once lived here perished, escaped, or were displaced to desolate lands.
As a warrior, you are expected to remove the frozen seal, awaken the dragon, and rebuild your homeland using your innate strategic talents.
Game Features: 
1. Match-3 Battles:
Remember! Matching is the key!
Match magic tiles to release hero skills.
2. Explore the Unknown: 
A huge map for you to explore!
Visit the Seer's Hut before marching for a head start in resource gathering.
3. Make Strategic Deployments: 
To fight against the undead, powerful troops are required!
Recruit heroes and train units to form a powerful squad.
4. Free Construction: 
Customize the layout of your castle as you wish.
Buildings can be placed anywhere you want!
5. Unite With Allies: 
Cooperation enhances the fun!
By creating or joining an alliance, you will be able to rally against foes and share resources with your allies.
6. Raise the Dragon: 
How can there be no dragons in a magical world?
Put the unfathomable power of the dragon at your disposal! Claim your own Dragon's Egg today!
[Subscription Intro]
Puzzles & Chaos provides subscription services. Become a subscriber to enjoy exclusive boosts and rewards!
1. Content: Subscribe to claim heaps of rewards on a daily basis and unlock various remarkable boosts.
2. Subscription duration: 1 month
3. Subscription price: $19.99
4. Payment: Via your iTunes account
5. If you are a subscriber, within 24 hours before your monthly subscription expires, the subscription will be automatically renewed UNLESS you manually cancel it before then.
6. To manage and cancel subscriptions, please head to Settings - iTunes Store & App Store - Check Apple ID - Account Settings - Subscription.
If you need to view our detailed subscription terms before subscribing, please tap the link below and refer to the fifth section of the agreement.
Link: https://gpassport.37games.com/center/ServicePrivacy/service

WHY MILLIONS CHOOSE BRAINBUDDY PREMIUM
REWIRE YOUR BRAIN
Based on 12 years of research, our state-of-the-art rewiring program teaches you how to conquer your impulses, one step at a time. Turn your brain into an ally.
MAKE EVERY DAY A GOOD DAY
Our fun, daily exercises are specifically designed to replace temptation with motivation and a positive outlook. Stop craving, start living.
PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE
Your daily checkup tracks in real-time the positive changes you are making to your relationships, mental clarity, and health. Don’t just feel the change, track it.
GROW YOUR LIFE TREE
Your own personal “Life Tree” grows with you. With every positive choice you make, your tree becomes a little more beautiful. Watch as it grows each day because of you.
THE BEST COMMUNITY
Brainbuddy has one of the most vibrant and friendly self-improvement communities. Stay motivated with stories from others, and work with your team to win healthy accountability challenges.
EXPERIENCE PERSONAL SATISFACTION
From one day to one year, build up your self-control and willpower one challenge at a time. You’ll be amazed at what you are capable of.
TOOLS TO LIVE BETTER
The most powerful content blocker and web filter on the planet. Master impulse control with machine learning. Brainbuddy has everything you need to live a focused, distraction-free life.
LEVEL UP YOUR LIFE
Rebooting your habits has immense psychological and physical benefits. Start now, change forever.
REVIEWS FROM THE BRAINBUDDY COMMUNITY

bluejetty:00077623:ios.summary:
Download Chargeway, the most user friendly EV charging station locator and trip planner! 
Chargeway makes EV charging easy for everyone. Simply choose any electric vehicle (EV) and Chargeway customizes your EV charging experience making it
bluejetty:00077623:ios.description:
Download Chargeway, the most user friendly EV charging station locator and trip planner! 
Chargeway makes EV charging easy for everyone. Simply choose any electric vehicle (EV) and Chargeway customizes your EV charging experience making it easy to see where you can charge, where you can go, and how long charging will take.
Chargeway has a unique and simple way to navigate charging options using colors for plug types and numbers for power levels. Red stations are for Tesla/NACS plugs, green stations are for J1772/CSS plugs, and blue stations are for CHAdeMO plugs. Numbers at each station pin and for each vehicle show the max power level for each can charge. Levels 1 and 2 are for AC charging and levels 3 through 7 are for DC fast charging.
Designed with drivers in mind Chargeway simplifies the EV charging experience for every driver, everywhere. Chargeway’s station map covers all of North America including networks such as Tesla, Electrify America, EVgo, Shell Recharge, Blink, EVConnect, Chargepoint, Flo, Volta, Rivian, 7Charge, Circle K, EVCS, Ivy, OpConnect, Petro Canada, and many more. Chargeway features include:
Station Map:
- Plug specific color-coding so you know which stations match your car (Green, Blue or Red)
- Power levels 1 through 7 show your vehicle and stations max charging speed
- Charge time estimation for every station and charger based on your vehicles battery level
- Real-time availability for chargers (Available, in use and offline status)
- Automatic station location map filtering for the vehicles you choose
- Easy to adjust filters for station power levels and networks you want to use
- View and add reviews and photos at stations you visit
- Report problems directly to network customer service teams 
- See shops and restaurants near a station that you can enjoy while you charge
- One-click directions to help you get to any station location
EV Trip Planner:
- Chargeway plots the fastest route and charging station locations for your trip
- Set the outside temperature and your desired speed for accurate planning
- Add multiple stops between your starting point and destination for custom routes
- Charging times for every stop are estimated to help you plan your trip
- Select "All Stations" on planned trips to view every charging option along your route
- If a certain route doesn’t have enough stations Chargeway will let you know so you can choose another route
Vehicle Info:
- Select your EVs color and choose a name to customize your experience
- Adjust your EVs battery level and desired charge limit to estimate charging times at every station
- Plug type and battery specifications for every vehicle
- Add multiple vehicles to your account at any time
Chargeway works for every EV on the road in North America including Tesla Model 3, Tesla Model Y, Tesla Model S and Tesla Model X; Kia EV6, Hyundai Ioniq 5, Ford Mustang Mach-E, Ford F-150 Lightning, Chevrolet Bolt, VW ID.4, Nissan LEAF, BMW i4, BMW iX, Audi e-tron vehicles, Porsche Taycan, Rivian R1T, Rivian R1S, Polestar, and many more EVs available today.
No matter where you live or your lifestyle Chargeway helps you enjoy EV charging for both every day driving as well as EV road trips. Download Chargeway to discover the simplified EV charging experience!
---
Chargeway Plus
• Live public charging pricing right on the map!
• Pricing available for over 70,000 public stations
• See the total cost to charge your EV at a station
• Easy to see daily station rates help you save on charging 
• Coming Soon: Saved Trips & more!
---
Terms of Service: https://www.chargeway.net/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.chargeway.net/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00091456:ios.description:

This app is built to be straightforward: open it, tap once, and let it clear your speakers.

bluejetty:00169305:ios.name: Skylore Online
bluejetty:00169305:ios.summary:
Join the new action MMORPG! Skylore is an exciting role-playing game packed with magic, adventure, and a welcoming atmosphere!
Skylore offers the ultimate fantasy action MMORPG experience, featuring flexible character and equipment develop
bluejetty:00169305:ios.description:
Join the new action MMORPG! Skylore is an exciting role-playing game packed with magic, adventure, and a welcoming atmosphere!
Skylore offers the ultimate fantasy action MMORPG experience, featuring flexible character and equipment development, exciting storylines and quests, and an immersive open world games. Dive into real-time PvP, PvE, and PvPvE multiplayer battles in the mmorpg online and special modes, battle bosses, chat with players from around the world, enjoy beautiful graphics and artstyle, and so much more.
***
Step into an era of amazing discoveries and epic battles. Become a hero and brave explorer in an exciting journey between the two vast worlds of Arinar and Skylore!
CREATE YOUR HERO YOUR WAY
Try out different classes, level up, and create a unique hero with different talents, abilities and equipment!
• 6 playable races — different appearances to choose from.
• 5 classes with different combat mechanics — Guardian, Shadow, Hunter, Mage, and Alchemist.
• Flexible character development — 150+ talents per class and skill sets to suit different playstyles.
• Upgrade mechanics – forge your own perfect gear set.
• Level up to 34 — with no auto-battle and auto-quests, your progress is in your hands.
FIGHT ONLINE PVP IN THE OPEN WORLD
Show off your skills in mmorpg online combat!
• Dungeons — party PvE against monsters in dynamic environments.
• Gorgor Contracts — fast-paced PvE against waves of monsters in specific locations.
• Arena 3x3 — team PvP in Tower Defense, Knockout, and Bounty Hunt modes with leagues and ratings.
• Battlefield — intense Battle Royale style PvP.
• Adamantine Grotto — unique PvPvE experience with quests and fights against monsters and other players at once.
• Guild Wars — massive GvG events against other players in open-world locations.
TEAM UP FOR VICTORY
Cooperate with your friends and other players for more fun and better experience!
• Join a guild or create your own — complete guild assignments, raid powerful bosses, and compete in Guild Wars.
• Make up a party of 4 to play with allies.
• Try matchmaking modes to fight with random players.
• Chat with players from around the world and expand your friends list.
ENJOY A VIBRANT UNIVERSE
Explore the vast world of Arinar and Skylore, each vibrant and filled with intricate detail mmorpg online!
• Authentic story with 50+ storyline and 140+ additional quests, 200+ daily quests, and 6 dynamic areas.
• Two distinct storylines tied to different races. Complete both for the full story!
• Twelve large areas and 70+ locations.
• Stunning graphics, animations, effects, sounds, and music.
JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
• Discord: https://discord.gg/skylore
• Forum: https://forum.skylore.com
• Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/skylore.mmorpg/
For any technical issues, please contact us at info@skylore.com.
***
Please note: Skylore is free to download and play, but offers optional in-game purchases. You can disable in-app purchases in your device settings if you prefer not to use this feature. To play Skylore, you must be at least 12 years of age as per our End User License Agreement and Privacy Policy.
• EULA: https://skylore.com/en/eula 
• Rules of conduct: https://skylore.com/en/rules_of_conduct

OCA Mobile is developed by OCA (Office of Compliant Administration). The app provides a single access point for participants to manage their consumer empowered healthcare and other tax favored benefit accounts.

OCA Mobile provides the following functionality:

• Benefit Health Account balances and details
• Recent transactions and details
• Ability to fund HSA account from checking/savings account
• View all email alerts
• Contact administrator from mobile application via email or mobile phone
• Same username/password as the online portal (no need to register your mobile device; just download, login, and go!)
• Stronger authentication support (Picture/Passphrase, device identification and challenge questions)
• View Demographic Details
• View Dependents
• View Card Details
• View Card PIN
• Fund HSA account from registered external bank accounts
• Register new users directly from mobile device
