bluejetty:00131943:ios.description:
Yatzy - Dice Go is the classic, free dice-rolling yatzi game where you’ll shake, score and shout! Can you roll the right yatzy combinations to beat the competition? Install and play this online, mobile version of the well known yatzy game designed to be a unique combination of luck and strategy. Every round you roll the 5 dice is an exciting challenge to rack up the highest score!
Incredibly fun, our Yatzy - Dice Go! app was created so that you can enjoy challenging your friends in one of the best multiplayer board games, or simply roll the dice solo when you need to relax. Yatzy - Dice go! will keep your brain active and sharp, since this yatzi game involves so many possibilities to analyze in order to get the best score and win over your opponent!
Dice Go! Is the best online edition of the classic yatzy genre, it is played with 5 dice and each player's turn consists of rolling the dice up to 3 times in hope of making 1 of 13 predefined winning combinations. Each dice combo has to be done once and only once. Be it a small or large straight, a full house, or a super fun Yatzi combo, play them wisely because your objective is to achieve the highest score possible at the end of this board game.
Why choose our Yaty - Dice Go app? Because we’re openly inviting you to enjoy super fun yatzi gameplay alongside amazing features such as:
- Practice mode for beginner yatzi players
- AI Bots if you choose to play yatzy offline
- Super crisp graphics and relaxing sound effects
- The best version of the classic dice game
- Totally free, even no in-app purchases.
Install Dice Go today to enjoy the classic yatzi dice rolling experience, just like in childhood. You can choose to:
Play Solo Game - a one column yatzi game for you to have a fun experience rolling the dice anytime you need a break from reality
Play Triples Game - a longer 3 columns yatzy game for more experienced players 
Play versus Opponent - challenge the AI opponents and prove your mastery of the yatzy gameplay
Local Pass and Play - play a yatzy round locally, with friends.
Add to all these cool game features: the clean and clear Stats you can check out anytime to keep track of your high scores, the wonderfully designed themes for dice and boards that you can choose from and the option to save your game to make sure you continue rolling the lucky dice when you’re ready - and here you are, treating yourself to a one-of-a-kind, complete yatzi playing experience at your fingertips whenever you need to enjoy time off.
Go, install Dice Go today, roll the lucky dice, play some rounds, score high and come back to share your experience with us. Enjoy the game and don’t forget to rate us 5 stars!
Link to the Terms of Use: http://loppipoppi.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00124288:ios.description:
Man the tail gun in this WWII action/arcade shooter! Use your phone's gyroscope or touchscreen to aim your guns, and touch either red button to open fire.
Guns! Rack your twin .50-cals to defend your bomber against the ever-growing waves of Axis fighters.
Planes! Me-109s, FW-190s, Bf-110s, Me-262s; whatever the Axis can throw at you.
Lives! You only get 5. Once 5 enemy fighters make it past your defenses, it's game over for you and your flight crew.
Ammo! As in unlimited, you'll never run out! Just keep an eye on how hot your guns are; if they overheat, the enemy won't wait for them to cool down before swooping in for the kill.
This game is graphically demanding, which means it will gleefully eat your battery. Don't play if you're without a charger and waiting for that call from the hospital to let you know your new kidney has arrived.
If you're aiming using your gyroscope and it drifts out of alignment (or you want to face a different direction), just point your phone at where the "center" should be and hit the Align button at bottom left.

Play the BEST Spades card game on your iOS device, made by MobilityWare -- the #1 card and parlor game developer!
Spades has a fresh new look on the Apple Arcade, featuring brand new goals for you to reach! We’ve also included clear tuto
bluejetty:00178440:ios.description:
Play the BEST Spades card game on your iOS device, made by MobilityWare -- the #1 card and parlor game developer!
Spades has a fresh new look on the Apple Arcade, featuring brand new goals for you to reach! We’ve also included clear tutorials to help you learn the game of spades at your own pace! Relax and train your brain as you compete in the game of Spades!
Spades adds a new element of strategy & puzzles to the classic card game space. Plan and strategize each move as you compete with a partner to try and out-bid and out-play your opponents. Win the most books and be the first to 250 points to win! Be careful though, spades can't be played until they are broken! Precision, strategy and quick thinking are needed to master the game!
Play the fun and relaxing version of Spades
- Hop into the classic spades gameplay you know and love, available when you want it
- learn the game of spades in a low pressure, easy to learn, simple environment!
- Drop in drop out gameplay means spades is ready to play whenever you are!
- Use expressive emojis to let your opponent know you are winning big!
- Play offline – bots are available to play whenever and wherever
- Need help? Use the unlimited hints and undo to find a path through the challenging competitive card game!
The classic Spades game, for beginners and Pros alike
- Over 300 titles to earn and collect!
- Track your high scores across several games
- Push for a new personal best with each hand of classic cards you play!
- Improve your play with deep statistics. Watch as you improve your strategy through each game!
Play Spades how you want to
- Choose the difficulty of the AI and the rules of the game!
- Choose either portrait or landscape to play
- Never lose a game with save states, even when the app closes!
- Add in sandbags or jump into hard mode for even more challenge!
Train your brain with classic competitive gameplay and challenges
– For beginners and pros alike! Learn to master the game of spades or master your high-level strategy with each game!
- Instructions are included in the app. Use them to build the basis of your Spades strategy!
- Sharpen your skills with offline play! Track your stats in the app and watch as your game improves!
New feature: Leagues!
- Take on several groups of players as you work your way through the ranks!
- Learn advanced gameplay techniques as opponent’s skill increase alongside yours
- Perfect your game and earn new rewards as you go!
LIKE US on Facebook
http://www.facebook.com/mobilitywaresolitaire
For Spades support:
http://www.mobilityware.com/support.php

Get ready for a fun and challenging 3D car puzzle game that will test your brain and keep you hooked!
Solve traffic jams on busy streets by cleverly moving cars out of the way. The gameplay is simple but packed with fun, and each level brings new challenges to keep you on your toes!
With its refreshing, toy-like art style, enjoy a unique visual experience while sharpening your mind and relaxing at the same time. Perfect for unwinding and having a little fun!
[Super Easy to Play, Endless Fun]
Just tap a car, and it’ll move in the direction indicated by the arrows, clearing traffic jams as you go. Easy to learn, but each level will test your brainpower and puzzle-solving skills!
[Unique, Toy-Inspired Art Style]
Delight in the quirky, toy-like graphics that make every level feel fresh and exciting. It's not just a game—it’s a visual treat!
[A Variety of Fun Challenges]
- School Bus: Watch out for the school bus! Be kind and let it pass—safety first!
- Armored Truck: Help the armored truck roll through smoothly and deliver tons of cash!
- Fuel Tanker: Watch out for the fuel tanker! Colliding with it is dangerous—keep your distance!
And that's just the start—unlock even more exciting features as you play!
[Unlock Cool Cars, Customize Your Roads]
As you progress, unlock awesome new vehicles and create your own ultimate road network!
[Handy Power-ups to Help You Along the Way]
Stuck? No worries!
- Helicopter Power-up: When you’re really stuck, use the helicopter to help clear a car and unblock the road.
- Hint Power-up: Need a little help? Use the hint to get clever suggestions and breeze through tricky levels.
Download now and dive into an adventure full of fun, challenges, and plenty of "aha!" moments! Every time you clear a jam, you’ll feel the thrill of success and that perfect rush of accomplishment.
Ready to test your brain and enjoy some relaxing fun? Let’s go!

- See pictures and detailed descriptions of each campground.
Plan and Monitor your Stay:
- Find the closest available campground to popular destinations.
- See alerts posted directly from parks concerning your trip.
- Find last minute stays in the most beautiful parks.

bluejetty:00040973:ios.summary:
Sudoku with no ads at all. No banners, no pop-ups, no video ads, for free and paying players alike. Unlimited puzzles at every level, each level graded by the solving techniques it takes, and every mode works offline.
NO ADS, EVER
There is
bluejetty:00040973:ios.description:
Sudoku with no ads at all. No banners, no pop-ups, no video ads, for free and paying players alike. Unlimited puzzles at every level, each level graded by the solving techniques it takes, and every mode works offline.
NO ADS, EVER
There is no advertising in the app and no ad network inside it. Nothing interrupts a puzzle, and nothing asks you to watch a video to keep playing. The puzzles ship with the app, so it works the same on a plane, on the subway or with Wi-Fi off.
Private by design: no account, no ads, nothing sold. The app collects only the minimum needed to make the game better.
SMART HINTS THAT TEACH
When you are stuck, a hint does more than fill in a number. It names the solving technique that applies, such as a Hidden Single, a Pointing Pair or an X-Wing, highlights the cells it uses and explains why it works, step by step, before you tap Apply to place the number. If a wrong number of yours blocks the step, the hint shows you that first.
WHO IT IS FOR
- New to Sudoku: an interactive tutorial walks you through your first game on a real board, from filling a row to using a hint.
- Getting better: a library of 36 solving techniques, from the Last Remaining Cell to chains and the Almost Locked Set, each with step-by-step lessons and a puzzle to try it on.
- Experienced players: Expert, Master and Extreme bring in patterns such as the X-Wing, Skyscraper, XY-Chain and ALS-XZ. After standard games and Daily Challenges, the Coach's Report shows the moments worth reviewing.
- Relaxed play: Zen mode has no timer, mistakes never end the game, and nothing counts toward your stats.
- A daily habit: a new Daily Challenge every day, and a streak that grows with each day you win a standard game or a Daily Challenge.
UNLIMITED PUZZLES, GRADED BY TECHNIQUE
Each of the six levels has unlimited puzzles, and each puzzle is graded by the hardest technique the app's hint engine needs to solve it, not by how many numbers it starts with: Easy needs only singles, and Expert and above call for patterns like the Skyscraper and XY-Chain.
QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK
Does it work without internet? Yes. Every mode works offline.
Will I run out of puzzles? No. Puzzles are unlimited, free or with Pro.
Is it free? It is free to download and play. Pro is an optional subscription, also sold as a one-time purchase. It raises the hints per game from 1 to 3, 5 or unlimited, removes the mistake limit, opens the whole Daily Challenge archive (today and the previous 7 days are always free), auto-fills notes, and unlocks the premium themes and your own custom theme.
Which devices? iPhone, iPad, and Mac computers with Apple silicon, with layouts made for the big screen, Split View, Stage Manager and hardware keyboard support.
Which languages? You can play in any of 47 languages.
ALSO IN THE APP
- Made for iPad and iPhone Duo: on iPad the whole app is scaled up evenly, landscape layouts put the board beside the lessons and replays, and iPhone Duo is supported on both screens.
- Notes, Auto-Complete, undo and redo, and Show mistakes instantly, which you can switch off.
- Corner + Center notes, a second layer of notes for experienced solvers, and Tap to Pick Up for Number First Mode.
- Color Marks: paint cells and notes in nine colors to follow chains and patterns.
- Sudoku Terms: a glossary of 31 Sudoku terms, each explained in plain language with a quick example.
- Optional game sounds in three packs, each with one free instrument and three more with Pro. Game sounds stay off until you turn them on, and your own music keeps playing.
- Replay a game you have just finished, move by move, with your notes.
- Statistics, achievements and auto-save, so a puzzle waits exactly where you left it.
- 4 free color themes and 63 more with Pro, all with light and dark modes, six number pad layouts and an adjustable board font size.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

With Calorie AI - Food Cal Counter, start a new path to weight loss and enhance your overall health with scientifically-backed and effective methods.

-Customized Fitness Plan: Select your plan, set your goals, and effortlessly monitor your progress. With just one tap, you can begin or conclude your journey. Our intuitive, user-friendly interface makes it easy to track and navigate your path. Receive personalized daily calorie recommendations tailored to your body and weight goals. Adopting a healthier lifestyle has never been easier—and more satisfying!
-Nutritional Insights: Effortlessly track your daily intake of macronutrients and calories with our AI Calorie Counter. Stay on top of your diet and fitness goals with detailed insights into protein, carbs, and fats, helping you lead a balanced, healthy lifestyle.
-Manual Input with AI Assistance: For greater accuracy, manually enter your meal details, and let the AI provide accurate caloric estimates based on portion sizes. Tracking calories has never been easier—whether it’s with a quick photo or a few simple words.
-Daily Calorie Tracker: Monitor your daily caloric intake with our simple, visual tracker that helps you stay within your calorie targets.
-Personalized Nutrition Dashboard: Customize your tracking experience with a personalized dashboard, offering a clear view of your caloric and nutritional progress over time.
-Weight Tracking: Keep tabs on your progress with a dynamic graph that visualizes changes in your weight, helping you stay motivated and on track to achieve your fitness goals. Our AI will gently remind you to track your weight daily!
Note: Achieving healthy weight loss requires a balanced diet combined with physical activity. Solely relying on dietary restrictions without exercise is unlikely to lead to the desired weight management results.

-Personalized weight loss plans

-A balanced weight management method combining nutritious meals and moderate exercise
-Friendly reminders to help you stay on track
-A clear, step-by-step guide to building healthy habits

Here's how it works:
-Answer tailored fitness questions to create your personalized weight management plan
-Track your meals easily by snapping quick photos of your dishes throughout the day
-Receive an instant breakdown of calories and macros for each meal with our AI-driven Calorie Counter
-Lose weight or build muscle effectively

bluejetty:00159813:ios.description:
An Interactive Accounting Textbook with an Accounting Software Simulator.
Over 4 hours of FREE bookkeeping lessons and practice problems.
A revolutionary course that uses a new method of teaching bookkeeping and accounting that can be easily learned by anyone! No previous bookkeeping or accounting knowledge is needed. It is becoming known as the perfect college accounting prep course as it properly prepares students at all levels for advanced accounting using a built in accounting software simulator.
Lessons are divided into sections which take on average 2 to 5 mins to complete.
No ads and no personal data collected.
SIMPLIFIED EXPLAINATIONS
The perfect companion course for all accounting students and business owners.
A COURSE FOR ALL COUNTRIES
Whether you live in the USA, Europe, Canada, Africa, Asia, or the Middle East, our Addictive Accounting course is for you! In a world of diverse interests, one thing remains standard, the double-entry bookkeeping system. As the saying goes, money runs the world and the world has agreed to measure its money using the double-entry bookkeeping system. Once you learn the fundamentals of the double-entry bookkeeping system, learning how your particular country measures its finances will be exceptionally straightforward.
A COURSE FOR ALL ACCOUNTING SOFTWARE
Imagine trying to learn multiplication and division without having first learned how to add and subtract! It makes no sense to try and learn how to do multiplication and division without having first mastered addition and subtraction. The same concept is true for accounting software. If you learn the double-entry bookkeeping system, knowing how to efficiently use ANY professional accounting software will be so much easier!
PLENTY OF PRACTICE
The only way to really learn bookkeeping and accounting is by actually doing it, which is why the Addictive Accounting app contains a proprietary interactive accounting simulator. The simulator will teach you how to create and interpret all the journal entries required to run a business using the journal, general ledger, chart of accounts and financial statements.
UPON COMPLETION, YOU WILL UNDERSTAND:
. The journal, general ledger and chart of accounts
. The relationship between property and ownership
. Assets, Liabilities, Capital and Profit
. The true meanings of debit and credit
. How to make journal entries
. How to record purchases and sales
. How to record sales tax
. Accounts receivable and payable
. Commonly used bookkeeping accounts
. How to reconcile
. Profit margin and gross and net profit
. Normal and contra balances
. The difference between cash, modified cash and accrual profit
. Depreciation and how to calculate and record it
. Cash statement
. Profit statement
. Equity statement
. Balance sheet
. How to record paying contractors
. How to record paying employees
. The payroll registry
. Deductions and withholdings
. Income taxes
. And more

The perfect companion course for all accounting students and business owners.

A COURSE FOR ALL COUNTRIES
Whether you live in the USA, Europe, Canada, Africa, Asia, or the Middle East, our Addictive Accounting course is for you! In a world of diverse interests, one thing remains standard, the double-entry bookkeeping system. As the saying goes, money runs the world and the world has agreed to measure its money using the double-entry bookkeeping system. Once you learn the fundamentals of the double-entry bookkeeping system, learning how your particular country measures its finances will be exceptionally straightforward.

A COURSE FOR ALL ACCOUNTING SOFTWARE
Imagine trying to learn multiplication and division without having first learned how to add and subtract! It makes no sense to try and learn how to do multiplication and division without having first mastered addition and subtraction. The same concept is true for accounting software. If you learn the double-entry bookkeeping system, knowing how to efficiently use ANY professional accounting software will be so much easier!

PLENTY OF PRACTICE
The only way to really learn bookkeeping and accounting is by actually doing it, which is why the Addictive Accounting app contains a proprietary interactive accounting simulator. The simulator will teach you how to create and interpret all the journal entries required to run a business using the journal, general ledger, chart of accounts and financial statements.

UPON COMPLETION, YOU WILL UNDERSTAND:
. The journal, general ledger and chart of accounts
. The relationship between property and ownership
. Assets, Liabilities, Capital and Profit
. The true meanings of debit and credit
. How to make journal entries
. How to record purchases and sales
. How to record sales tax
. Accounts receivable and payable
. Commonly used bookkeeping accounts
. How to reconcile
. Profit margin and gross and net profit
. Normal and contra balances
. The difference between cash, modified cash and accrual profit
. Depreciation and how to calculate and record it
. Cash statement
. Profit statement
. Equity statement
. Balance sheet
. How to record paying contractors
. How to record paying employees
. The payroll registry
. Deductions and withholdings
. Income taxes
. And more

bluejetty:00152877:ios.description:
ISEKAI ZERO is an AI story game where you get transported into living anime worlds. Chat with AI characters who remember you, make choices that change the story, and watch your adventure unfold with art and music, like a visual novel that writes itself around you.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Talk to anime AI characters with real personality and memory. They react, scheme, fall for you, and hold grudges.
• Live an isekai. Get reborn into fantasy realms, magic academies, cyberpunk cities, and slice-of-life towns. Every storyline is a world you can enter.
• Generate your own story. Describe any scenario and the story engine builds it into a playable adventure, scene by scene.
• Your choices matter. This is an interactive story with consequences. The world remembers what you did in chapter one.
• Romance, comedy, action. From slow-burn romance stories to chaotic comedy runs and epic battles, you set the tone.
CREATE AND EARN
Build your own AI characters and storylines with the creator tools. Publish them, and earn a 25% profit share whenever other players play your worlds.
MORE THAN A CHATBOT
Most AI chat apps give you a blank text box. ISEKAI ZERO gives every conversation a world: scenes with art, a soundtrack that follows the mood, characters with goals of their own, and stories with actual endings. It is an AI story game, not just an AI chatbot.
SAFE BY DESIGN
Every published story and character is reviewed before it goes live. Report anything from inside the app, block any creator, and expect action within 24 hours.
PLAY IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Fully playable in 18 languages, including English, 日本語, 한국어, 中文, Español, Português, Deutsch and Français.
Free to start. New storylines and characters added every week. Your next life is waiting. Which world will you wake up in?

bluejetty:00023431:ios.name: Slash of Sword 2 - Action RPG
bluejetty:00023431:ios.summary: You were accused of a crime you did not commit and were sent to fight in the arena as punishment. Bloody and tactical fights for survival of varying complexity with many rivals await you. Try to learn skills to become more proficient, as we
bluejetty:00023431:ios.description:
You were accused of a crime you did not commit and were sent to fight in the arena as punishment. Bloody and tactical fights for survival of varying complexity with many rivals await you. Try to learn skills to become more proficient, as well as explore locations and interact with characters to achieve justice!
Will you try to make decisions about whether to help a wounded man who was recently a bandit and robbed ordinary travelers? Whether to tell the owner about the treasure you found? Or maybe whether to let the girl go with the robber who kidnapped her, or deal with him and return the girl to her father? You decide…
▣ Immerse yourself in the story with many options for how events will turn out.
▣ Make decisions that will affect the storyline and the characters' attitudes toward you later on.
▣ Familiarize yourself with the tactical combat system, in which you need to choose the moment to attack, as well as to block or dodge in time.
▣ Sign up to take part in fist fights in the tavern.
▣ Explore locations by visiting various cities, settlements, forests, and caves.
▶ The story - Investigate a tangle of events with your brother Richard. Go from being an ordinary traveler to being a legendary warrior and find out who framed you and why. Meet interesting characters with their own stories and help them, or fight unique opponents and win special bonuses for defeating them.
▶ Customization - You have access to a large number of different weapons, one-handed or two-handed swords, as well as shields and armor. You can go to the barber to change the appearance of your character. Grow a beard or a ponytail. Wear a hood when it rains or wrap yourself in a cape to add depth to your character.
▶ Power leveling - Become a more experienced warrior fighting in the arena or against bandits while traveling the game world. Become a master of the sword or shield, or level up all your skills gradually. Learn how to wear down your opponent with counterattacks or how to win with lightning-fast series of high-speed blows.

bluejetty:00123344:ios.description:
EatOkra connects foodies to chefs, culinary creators and restaurants to reimagine your dining experience.
EatOkra features:
YOUR FAVORITE Black-owned food and beverage experiences
∙ Over 22,500 Black-owned restaurants, food trucks, coffee shops, bars, brunch spots and more at your fingertips. 
DISCOVERABILITY
∙ Discover new and treasured Black-owned eateries in your neighborhood and beyond.
∙ Filter search results by distance, ratings, delivery, category, address, phone number, and website.
∙ Bookmark restaurants to explore later. 
FLAVORS OF THE DIASPORA
∙ Featuring local flavors and international flair, EatOkra reflects the African diaspora and includes soul food, vegan food, BBQ, African, Caribbean, seafood, Cajun/Creole and more cuisines near you!
∙ Find restaurants in New York City, Los Angeles, the Bay Area, St. Louis, Chicago, Miami, New Orleans, Philadelphia, DC, Atlanta, Houston, Dallas, Portland, Detroit, Minneapolis, Jacksonville, Newark, Austin, Memphis, Seattle, and much more!
∙ Now available in the London & Toronto
COMMUNITY
∙ Read about the history of restaurants and foods directly from our restaurant partners.
∙ Find experiences, like Black Food festivals, virtual events, brunch parties, and their participants in your area with our Event Spotlight.
∙ Share your experience with other foodies by rating and reviewing restaurants within the app.
∙Add to our family by recommending a business to feature on EatOkra.
At the intersection of food, culture and community, EatOkra amplifies awareness and creates equal opportunities for Black-owned businesses, future hospitality trailblazers, and voices in the food and beverage industry. 
Visit EatOkra.com to learn more!

bluejetty:00122471:ios.description:
CHECKING & SAVINGS ACCOUNT
• Sign up to start spending, saving, and investing with a conscience
• Fund the planting of a tree with every purchase you make (1)
• Feel good knowing your deposits will not fund fossil fuel exploration or production (6)
• Unlimited withdrawals at over 55,000+ Allpoint ATMs
• Earn up to 3.25% APY. Terms & Conditions apply (5)
• Get paid up to 2 days early (4)
DISCLAIMERS
The GreenFi Checking & Savings accounts are checking and savings accounts offered through Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC. FDIC insurance only covers the failure of an FDIC-insured bank. FDIC insurance is available through pass-through insurance at Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC, if certain conditions have been met. Approved deposit accounts are FDIC insured up to $250,000 per depositor. For balances greater than $250,000, Coastal will Sweep the excess funds to one or more FDIC-insured depository institutions in their Sweep network (each a “Bank”) up to $250,000 per Bank. With four Banks available through the Coastal Community Bank Insured Bank Deposit Program (greenfi.com/2024-deposit-account-agreement#page=45), Deposits are FDIC-insured up to $1.00 million per depositor. This amount is subject to change at any time. Visit fdic.gov. 
GreenFi Debit Cards are issued by Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC, pursuant to a license by Mastercard® International Incorporated. GreenFi is under separate ownership from any other named entity. GreenFi is not a bank.
An affiliate, GreenFi Fund Adviser, LLC is an SEC registered investment adviser.
1. When opting into GreenFi’s Plant Your Change Service, we round up GreenFi Debit Card transactions to the next whole dollar amount and transfer the excess to your Plant Your Change Service Account. For details, visit www.greenfi.com/plant-your-change-FAQ
2. Mission Financial Partners, LLC and its affiliates are committed to "All Extra Services Provided at Cost," meaning that we'll only charge you what it costs us to provide the extra service (such as a wire transfer), and not a penny more. Besides these at-cost service charges, customers may make an optional contribution via the Pay What Is Fair (PWIF) program. Proceeds from the PWIF program are recorded monthly in aggregate and donations are made to nonprofit partners selected by GreenFi within 12 months.
3. GreenFi’s Cash Back program is subject to change at any time and without notice, including reversal of rewards for abuse, fraud, and other illicit activity. Cash Back rewards are generally credited on the first day of each calendar month. For details, visit greenfi.com/cash-back-faq
4. GreenFi’s early direct deposit of funds service is not guaranteed, is subject to payor’s support and the timing of payor’s payment instruction, and is based on a comparison of our policy (www.greenfi.com/funds-availability-policy) of making funds available upon our receipt of payment instruction with the typical banking practice of posting funds at settlement.
5. The GreenFi Savings Account’s up to 3.25% Annual Percentage Yield (APY) is variable and accurate as of January 2026. Rates are subject to change. To earn 1.00% APY (3.25% APY if customer is enrolled in GreenFi Plus) on GreenFi Savings Account balances up to and including $25,000.00 in any calendar month, customer must have settled debit card transactions of $500.00 or more, monthly, on their GreenFi debit card, OR get paid via a qualifying Direct Deposit that month. Additional terms apply. Visit our Terms (www.greenfi.com/policies) & APY FAQ (www.greenfi.com/faq-interest-rates) for details.
6. GreenFi’s Program Banks have formally committed that customer deposits will not be used for lending to oil and gas exploration, production or transportation, or coal mining.
Visit greenfi.com/policies for additional terms and conditions of services.
© Copyright 2026 Mission Financial Partners, LLC

bluejetty:00037188:ios.description:
HackMotion Golf app is used together with the HackMotion Golf wearable wrist sensor. HackMotion Golf wrist sensor uses motion-tracking technology to capture wrist movements during the golf swing. HackMotion Golf app allows you to visualize HackMotion Golf sensor data and provide real-time audio biofeedback. 
Main features include:
• Wrist flexion/extension
• Wrist radial/ulnar deviation
• Real-time 3D hand model
• Automatic swing detection
• Automatic swing phase detection (address, top, impact)
• User-adjustable audio biofeedback
• Wrist data graphs
• Session & swing data storage & database
Put on the wrist sensor and power up. Open the HackMotion Golf app, choose training mode, start a new session and calibrate your sensor. The system automatically detects golf swings and stores the information related to the wrist motion. HackMotion wrist sensor is intended for golf coaches and advanced golf players.
Note: You need to connect to the HackMotion Golf wrist sensor to use the main features of the app. More info: www.hackmotion.com

bluejetty:00080989:ios.description:
Measure nearby magnetic changes and keep the evidence. Metal&Gold Detector: Scanner brings a live magnetometer, compass and private field journal together.
UNDERSTAND THE READING
See total magnetic field and X/Y/Z readings. Set a stable baseline, choose your units, and adjust sound and haptic alerts. A compatible magnetic sensor is required. A phone cannot identify gold, silver, copper, depth, value or safety.
KEEP A USEFUL RECORD
Record up to 30 minutes, pause and resume, mark changes, and review raw traces and statistics. Compare two sessions or share CSV, JSON and readable reports. Build measured 3×3 or 5×5 surveys; unmeasured points stay empty.
YOUR FIELD JOURNAL
Save photos, notes, categories, favorites and optional locations. Search your records and recover unfinished work after a restart. The scanner, journal and practical guides work offline.
OPTIONAL AI OBSERVATIONS
Send only a selected photo or session summary, with your consent, to explore visible clues and possible explanations. Saved locations are excluded. AI requires internet and can be wrong; it does not identify material or certify safety. Limits: up to 3 requests per UTC day and 10 per month. Started requests may count if they fail.
ACCESS AND PRIVACY
Scanning, compass, guides and up to 10 finds are free. A weekly or yearly subscription unlocks recordings, surveys, comparisons, sharing and more finds. See the current price and any eligible offer before purchasing. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through your store account; deleting the app does not cancel a subscription. Restore access in Settings.
Optional diagnostics are off by default. Delete journal data on your device and manage your AI account in Settings. The app interface is in English.

Beam Drive Crashes Original 3D offers an exhilarating experience where you can dive into the world of realistic car crashes and intense racing games! If you love car demolition, crash tests, and destruction physics, this game is perfect for you!

Intense Racing and Driving: Compete in exciting crash racing and extreme car driving challenges. Enjoy driving games that push your skills to the limit with realistic driving mechanics.
Beam Drive Crashes Original 3D is designed to offer endless fun with car crash games and car destruction. Drive and crash your way through epic crash scenarios and enjoy the thrill of car accidents in a realistic car crash environment.

bluejetty:00080666:ios.description:
Easy-to-use Parental Controls 
The Amazon Kids Parent Dashboard app is specifically designed to help parents and guardians build safe, healthy digital behaviors with their family across Amazon devices and the Amazon Kids+ subscription. Manage and customize your kids’ experiences with easy-to-use parental controls for up to 4 child profiles. Configure age-appropriate settings, set time limits, keep track of child activity, manage content, and more. The Amazon Kids+ Parent Dashboard App works with Fire tablets, Amazon Echo speakers, Kindle e-readers, Fire TV, and other mobile devices. An Amazon Kids+ subscription is not required to use the free parental tools. 
Easily adjust whenever & wherever
• Adjust parental controls from the convenience of your phone without interrupting your child’s experience.
• Pause/resume your kids' access to their device even if your kids aren’t near you.
Featured parental controls 
• Time limits: set time limits for a child’s total screen time for the day or the use of certain types of content. Or, set a time when your child's devices turn off at night and how long they stay off. 
• Learn first: prioritize books and learning apps before kids focus on entertainment content.
• Child activity: review your child’s use of particular types of content, or see specific titles to learn more about what each child is enjoying. 
• Manage your child's content: block specific Amazon Kids+ titles, add content from your Amazon library, or adjust the age filter based on your child's maturity, tastes, and sensitivities. 
Tips from family safety experts 
• The Family Trust team within Amazon Kids partners with leaders in children’s safety, privacy, and development to ensure Amazon Kids is helping families build safe, healthy digital behaviors.
Customize each child profile 
• A child profile allows kids to explore content and other experiences on Amazon in a safe digital environment. A child profile is needed to set parental controls with Amazon Kids Parent Dashboard. 
• Provides kids with a customized, age-appropriate experience specifically designed for kids. 
• Create up to 4 child profiles per Amazon Household.
Amazon Kids+ 
Amazon Kids+ is a digital subscription designed for kids ages 3-12 that can be accessed across compatible Amazon and mobile devices. With Amazon Kids+, kids can enjoy ad-free apps, videos, games, books, and kid-friendly Alexa experiences in a safe and trusted digital environment equipped with easy to use parental controls. Try 1-month for free today. 
For customers located within the European Union, United Kingdom, Brazil, or Turkey: By using this app, you agree to Amazon’s Conditions of Use applicable for your country. Please also see the applicable Privacy Notice, Cookies Notice and Interest-Based Ads Notice for your country. Links to these terms and notices can be found in the footer of your local Amazon homepage.
For all other customers: By using this app, you agree to the applicable Amazon Conditions of Use (e.g. www.amazon.com/conditionsofuse) and Privacy Notice (e.g. www.amazon.com/privacy) for your country.

2024 Apple Design Award Finalist!
Welcome to Finity: a thoughtful, handcrafted matching game.
A few rules lead to endless strategy, flow, and exciting close calls.
1. Tiles wrap around.
2. Slide rows or columns to match 3.
3. Moves are limited, so think carefully!
Climb the leaderboards as you level up your skills to unlock challenging special tiles, power ups, and new themes to suit your mood in Classic Mode. 
Or swipe over to Tempo Mode and get lost in music while you make swift matches and find your flow.
Finity will continue to expand and evolve over time, so look out for updates soon.
I'm so excited to finally share Finity with you. I tried to reimagine different elements from my favorite puzzle games to make Finity and I hope you find it just as fun and engaging as I have.
- Sebastian

The FUTÁR application by BKK Centre for Budapest Transport has been renewed under the name BudapestGO, which, in addition to real-time route planning, has been extended with new functions: you can buy digital single tickets, daily and weekly travelcards or passes in the application and you can also be informed immediately about the current transport service changes. You can use the route planner with a cleaner and clearer interface, facilitated by a number of new features.
New features in the app:
- Ticket and pass purchase, journey planning in a single app
- Digital single ticket now also available
- Automatic pass renewal
- Traffic information (BKK Info application integrated)
- Personalised transport updates via push message
- Trip planning for trains and suburban railways available with a BKK-pass

THE ULTIMATE BASEBALL GM EXPERIENCE
Manage every aspect of your team, from coaching and scouting to drafting and trading. Negotiate contracts and develop players to lead your team to victory.
OFFLINE BASEBALL MANAGER
Play anytime, anywhere - no internet connection required! HLM24 lets you enjoy the excitement of managing your baseball team whenever you want.

Follow the evolution of the entire league, witnessing teams rise from declining contenders to rising superstars. Track league records, draft classes, player transactions, and more!

bluejetty:00088308:ios.description:
Solve your Rubik's cube in a few taps, 100% offline, then learn to solve it yourself.
The solver runs right on your phone. No internet, no waiting for a server: scan the cube on a plane, on the subway or anywhere without signal and get the moves in seconds.
For big cubes there is also the Pro solver: it asks our online solver too, tuned for 4x4, 5x5 and 6x6, and keeps whichever solution is shorter.
SOLVER
• Fully offline: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5 and 6x6 are all solved on your phone
• A 3x3 is solved in about 20 moves, as short as our online solver or shorter
• Pro solver for 4x4, 5x5 and 6x6: offline and online together, the shorter solution wins (a 5x5 drops from about 100 moves to about 80)
• Scan each face with your camera, or paint the colors by hand
• Every move is shown on a 3D cube with arrows, one move at a time
• Play it at your own speed, or step back when you get lost
LEARN
• Beginner method in 7 steps: no notation or long algorithms needed
• CFOP method: cross, F2L, OLL and PLL
• Guides for the 2x2, 4x4, 5x5 and bigger cubes
• Finger tricks shown by 3D hands, finger by finger
• Cube notation made simple: read moves like R U R'
• Pictures you can try in 3D in every lesson
PRACTICE
• Virtual cube from 2x2 up to 20x20
• A coach that shows your next move, by the beginner method or CFOP
• Timer for your real cube, with scrambles, best time and averages of 5 and 12
• 214 patterns to make, from the Superflip to the Checkerboard, 3x3 up to 7x7
• Theme editor to give your cube your own colors
In 18 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Turkish, Indonesian, Hindi, Bengali, Punjabi, Vietnamese, Thai, Japanese, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
Happy solving!

Leave the flat matching games behind and experience the true 3D matching challenge. Discover matching items on rotating shelves, bringing more tests and fun to entertain your brain. Goods Triple Match 3D is a captivating and immersive free matching game that will keep players of all ages entertained for hours.
Engage your mind and sharpen your cognitive skills as you search for and match 3D items within a limited time. Prepare to explore a vast array of delightful and diverse 3D combinations that await you.

Your task is to identify and match three identical 3D elements from a chaotic assortment of goods. Eliminate them strategically to earn points and unlock exciting power-ups.

- **Compete Globally:** Rise through the ranks and compete with top players worldwide to claim the title of the ultimate Goods Triple Match Master.
Goods Triple Match 3D offers an addictive and rewarding gaming experience! Get ready to put your matching skills to the test and immerse yourself in the world of 3D delights. Play now and become the reigning Goods Triple Match 3D Master!

bluejetty:00023243:ios.name: Runestrike CCG
bluejetty:00023243:ios.summary: Enter the world of Runestrike, where mortal Champions battle to master powerful runes and overthrow ancient gods. Runestrike is an online turn-based strategy game that offers brisk play and deep strategy built on straight-forward mechanics.
bluejetty:00023243:ios.description:
Enter the world of Runestrike, where mortal Champions battle to master powerful runes and overthrow ancient gods. Runestrike is an online turn-based strategy game that offers brisk play and deep strategy built on straight-forward mechanics. Download today to build decks, level your Champions, and enjoy both challenging single-player content and pvp.
BEAUTIFUL ART
Build your collection with beautifully drawn runes, whether it’s a common Hammerfist Giant or the legendary Jupiter himself. Stunning Champions and a gorgeous world map make Runestrike a visual treat you can indulge in.
COMPELLING STORY
As ancient gods engage in a titanic clash, the veil separating mortal from immortal tears open, and runes rain from the heavens. The world is infused with magic, wild beasts become fantastic monstrosities, and powerful Champions arise among mortals. Ascend your Champions to godhood as they learn to harness the runes once held by the gods.
ENGAGING PVE CONTENT
Explore the world of Runestrike in rewarding single-player campaigns. Overcome Jupiter in the Trials of Olympus. Survive the perils of ancient Egypt in the Eye of Ra.
VERSUS ARENA
Battle other players for the top spot in the Versus Arena, compete in Ranked Leaderboards and earn fantastic rewards whatever your rank. The higher the Rank before Season resets, the better the rewards.
UNIQUE CHAMPIONS
Collect unique Champions who engage in every battle, attacking their foes through direct combat and with powerful divine abilities. Ascend your Champion to unlock new powers and earn rewards.
With over a dozen Champions and hundreds of runes, players will find countless strategies. Download Runestrike today and enter a living world where new content is regularly released, player feedback is welcomed, and the battles never stop.
-Visit www.runestrike.com to learn more.
-Join the Runestrike community on Discord. https://discord.gg/runestrike
-Visit our Facebook page. https://www.facebook.com/RunestrikeGame/
-Meet other players on the Runestrike forum. http://forum.makingfun.com/forum/runestrike/
- Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/runestrike

bluejetty:00121362:ios.summary: Join us now and play the best free-to-play card game of all, with the newly improved CardParty app! Play against your friends, family, or strangers from all over the world. Join friends who are already playing or make new ones. Win a round
bluejetty:00121362:ios.description:
Join us now and play the best free-to-play card game of all, with the newly improved CardParty app! Play against your friends, family, or strangers from all over the world. Join friends who are already playing or make new ones. Win a round and gain coins, experience points, and other achievements. CardParty is a game of skill, and strategy. Outsmart your opponent, discard all your cards, and win the game!
Looking for a traditional fun card games with a fresh modern look? Then stop looking and download CardParty!
The best features of CardParty include:
Play and have fun with people from all over the world
Play together in team mode!
Free bonus Coins every few hours!
Easy to learn, hard to master
Real time matches
Seamless cross-platform experience
Chat, connect, and find friends!
Start a game with your own custom rules
Gain higher combo's and unlock achievements
The objective of CardParty is to be the first one to play all the cards in your stock pile. This is achieved by playing the cards in numerical order, 1 through 12. The game also features Joker cards, which can be used as any number! The first player to discard all cards, wins the game. Forcing your opponent to pickup more cards than yourself will also lead to a win for you!
Want to play together with your friends, family members, or a random player as a team? Then Team Mode is for you! This fan favorite mode works just like the regular mode, except for the fact that you can play from your own stock and discard pile or your partners. The first team to finish one of the stock piles, wins.
You can choose which Coin stake to play with. The higher the bet, the higher the reward, if you win of course. Play smart and you'll be the winner! Don't forget, we offer free Coins every few hours in CardParty, so don't forget to claim them! More Coins means more games.
Use different perks to increase the fun and improve your games, but make sure to activate them in the beginning of the game.
The perks you can choose from include:
Move Helper: Highlights the cards in your hands, stock pile, or discard piles that can be placed on the shared piles.
Stack viewer: By activating this perk all cards in the 4 discard piles can be viewed.
Download CardParty for free on your phone or tablet, so you can have endless amounts of fun anywhere, anytime. GamePoint CardParty is the perfect fun game for:
Timeless classic fun and relaxation.
For family game nights
Challenging and playing against your friends
Playing on your own when you're bored, on the subway, or just up for an exciting game
Meeting new people!
Already have an existing GamePoint account? Then log in with your existing account and come back online to play with your own friends and Coin balance! Our game provides modern graphics, smooth gameplay, and a simple-to-use user interface to make sure you get the best playing experience possible!

Finding parking should not feel like a mission. With JPass, you can search, access, and pay for parking in seconds - right from your mobile phone.
Say goodbye to paper tickets, pay-on-foot machines, and access cards - your parking pass is your phone.
KEY FEATURES
• Find Parking Effortlessly
Search for parking near your destination, compare options, and view real-time information such as rates, availability, hours, and amenities. All right at your fingertips!
• Smart, Ticketless Entry & Exit 
Subscribers and monthly parkers can enter and exit using license plates or mobile credentials. Digital parking that works.
• Fast, Secure Mobile Payments 
Pay for your parking sessions in just seconds with your preferred method. No lines, no machines, no stress.
• Manage Parking Subscriptions 
Easily manage your monthly parking plan, update vehicle details, change license plates, renew, or cancel with just a few taps. Perfect for commuters and frequent parkers.
• Parking History & Receipts 
Track past visits and charges right inside the app, all neatly organized for easy expense and business travel management. Stay in control wherever you go. We are always improving JPass to bring you the most seamless mobility experience. Stay tuned for new features, loyalty perks, enhancements, and more.
Want to learn more or connect with us? Visit http://www.j-pass.com or reach out at info@j-pass.com. Your seamless mobility journey is our top priority.

Say goodbye to paper tickets, pay-on-foot machines, and access cards - your parking pass is your phone.

KEY FEATURES

• Find Parking Effortlessly
Search for parking near your destination, compare options, and view real-time information such as rates, availability, hours, and amenities. All right at your fingertips!

• Smart, Ticketless Entry & Exit 
Subscribers and monthly parkers can enter and exit using license plates or mobile credentials. Digital parking that works.

• Fast, Secure Mobile Payments 
Pay for your parking sessions in just seconds with your preferred method. No lines, no machines, no stress.

• Manage Parking Subscriptions 
Easily manage your monthly parking plan, update vehicle details, change license plates, renew, or cancel with just a few taps. Perfect for commuters and frequent parkers.

• Parking History & Receipts 
Track past visits and charges right inside the app, all neatly organized for easy expense and business travel management. Stay in control wherever you go. We are always improving JPass to bring you the most seamless mobility experience. Stay tuned for new features, loyalty perks, enhancements, and more.

Want to learn more or connect with us? Visit http://www.j-pass.com or reach out at info@j-pass.com. Your seamless mobility journey is our top priority.

bluejetty:00148905:ios.description:
Vidmor Create AI images instantly. Generate AI videos in seconds.All-in-one AI creativity app for social media and beyond.
Vidmor is a next-generation AI-powered tool designed to help anyone create stunning content without professional editing skills. From text-to-image to text-to-video, Vidmor brings your ideas to life in seconds. With powerful AI engines and viral-ready video templates, your content will stand out, spread faster, and engage more people across platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
Core Features
AI Text-to-Image
Describe what you want and let AI instantly generate unique, high-quality pictures. Perfect for digital art, memes, posters, or creative projects.
Image Style Transfer
Transform your photos with 100+ filters, effects, and creative styles. Easily switch aesthetics from cartoon to oil painting, cyberpunk to anime, and much more.
AI Text-to-Video
Turn your written prompts into animated video clips. Bring stories, marketing slogans, or creative ideas to life without needing a camera or editing software.
Image-to-Video
Animate static images into moving content. Make your selfies blink, photos smile, or snapshots transform into dynamic, shareable clips.
Image Fusion Video
Blend multiple images into one cinematic video. Create smooth transitions, morph characters, or combine memories into a unique video story.
Video Templates
Access a growing library of trendy, ready-to-use templates tailored for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and more. Save time while creating content designed to go viral.
Why Choose Vidmor?
Easy to Use: No technical skills required. Just type, tap, and generate.
Fast Creation: AI-powered engines deliver results in seconds.
High-Quality Output: Generate crisp images and videos up to 720p resolution.
Viral Potential: Templates and AI effects are optimized for social media sharing.
Perfect For
Content Creators & Influencers: Create viral short videos and eye-catching visuals to grow your audience.
Students & Educators: Visualize ideas, projects, and presentations with AI-powered creativity.
Designers & Artists: Explore new styles, generate inspiration, and speed up creative workflows.
Everyday Users: Have fun with AI-generated art, animated selfies, or unique video stories.
Why Vidmor is Different
Unlike basic AI apps, Vidmor combines multiple tools into one platform. It’s not just about generating pictures or videos – it’s about helping you create content that is ready to perform on social media. With a user-friendly design, rich template library, and advanced AI models, Vidmor makes creativity accessible to everyone.
Easy-to-use Credit System
- You need a subscription to create AI videos.
- Subscription Prices: $9.99 per week (300 credits for image and video creation); $39.99 per year (2800 credits); A Pro+ membership is also available for $79.99 per year (8000 credits).
- Bonus Credits: If you run out of credits before renewal, you can purchase additional credits separately during your subscription period.
- Features and Content: Unlimited access to all features and content offered by AI Video.
- Billing: Subscription fees are charged weekly or annually, depending on your chosen subscription plan.
- Payment: Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase.
- Auto-Renewal: Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Renewal Fee: Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period, depending on your chosen plan.
- Management: Users can manage their subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in their account settings after purchase.
Contact Us:
If you have any questions, comments or need help, please feel free to contact us at vidmor.support@hkappinnovators.com.
Privacy Policy: https://ghost-generation.web.app/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://ghost-generation.web.app/terms.html

bluejetty:00152945:ios.description:
Dê vida nova às suas lembranças com o Reviva – o app ideal para restaurar fotos antigas e transformá-las em imagens nítidas e de alta qualidade.
Com inteligência artificial, o Reviva aprimora fotos antigas, desbotadas ou danificadas com precisão impressionante. Quer melhorar a qualidade da foto, clarear fotos escuras ou aumentar a qualidade da foto borrada? O Reviva é o app para melhorar a qualidade da foto que você procurava.
Principais Recursos:
– Restaurar Fotos Antigas: Recupere fotos danificadas ou desbotadas. O Reviva remove sinais do tempo com inteligência, trazendo de volta a nitidez e as cores das suas memórias mais queridas.
– Colorir Fotos em Preto e Branco: Transforme momentos antigos em lembranças vibrantes. Com apenas um toque, o Reviva aplica cores naturais e realistas às suas imagens em preto e branco.
– Remover Riscos: Elimine arranhões, manchas e poeira da imagem sem perder o charme original. Ideal para arrumar fotos antigas com danos visíveis.
– Melhorar Qualidade da Foto: Fotos borradas ou em baixa resolução? Reviva melhora imagem, realça detalhes do rosto e aumenta a qualidade da foto, deixando tudo mais nítido e claro.
– Clarear e Corrigir: Fotos escuras ou sem vida? O app ajusta brilho, contraste e sombras automaticamente para clarear fotos e deixá-las com aparência profissional.
– Recriar Imagem: Preencha áreas danificadas ou faltando com precisão impressionante. O Reviva recria partes ausentes da foto com realismo e cuidado nos detalhes.
Baixe o Reviva agora e transforme suas fotos antigas em verdadeiros tesouros eternos!
Assinaturas e Compras no App:
A versão gratuita oferece acesso limitado. Para desbloquear todos os recursos, remover limites de uso e exportar em qualidade HD, é necessário assinar o plano Pro.
Política de Privacidade: https://sites.google.com/view/reviva-app/pol%C3%ADtica-de-privacidade/
Termos e Condições: https://sites.google.com/view/reviva-app/termos-e-condi%C3%A7%C3%B5es/
Contato ou Suporte: https://sites.google.com/view/reviva-app/apoiar/

bluejetty:00186169:ios.name: Staventabs: Compose & Notate
bluejetty:00186169:ios.summary: A simple notation and tab editor, Staventabs could become your indispensable helper in music creation. Use smart and convenient tools of Staventabs for composing and improving scores on your iPad or iPhone. Get inspired by viewing majestic
bluejetty:00186169:ios.description:
A simple notation and tab editor, Staventabs could become your indispensable helper in music creation. Use smart and convenient tools of Staventabs for composing and improving scores on your iPad or iPhone. Get inspired by viewing majestic classics scores or practicing good old jazz. Easily edit sheet music and tablature with user friendly interface like never before. Share musical inspiration with your band using Staventabs files.
Create music
• Start your new score from the scratch or with one of the two dozen templates²
• Enter notes with intuitive instrument-independent interface or virtual Piano Keyboard
• Explore and edit your score with sophisticated Piano Roll and Drums Editor
• Choose from 22 groups of the instruments (keyboards, guitars, strings, drums, percussions, etc.)² listening their preview fragments
• Use context-sensitive selection for bars, chords and tracks
• Modify notes with dots, tuplets and ties
• Make your music alive with lyrics
• Customize clefs, key signatures and time signatures for bars
• Change dynamics
• Switch between enharmonic equivalents of the notes
• Use customizable voices
• Setup tunings with the large value of presets
• Navigate around the score with Tracks board
• Easily copy, paste and remove selected areas
• Switch fast between tablature and stave inputs
• Edit tabs with easy-to-use numeric keypad or virtual Fingerboard
• Input notes by Staff Positions
• Set the visibility for instrument parts in the score
• Edit title and information about creators
• Select and customize horizontal, vertical or page layout for your score
• Use Scientific or Helmholtz pitch notation when entering notes
• Add repeat signs and volta brackets
• Don’t worry about losing data thanks to auto-saving
• Connect your MIDI devices to Staventabs
Practice your songs
• Play the whole composition or selected fragment
• Customize metronome clicking and countdown
• Change track’s audio properties on-the-fly
• Loop the playback of the desired part
Improve compositions
• Mark non-playable objects with "Highlight issues"
• Use the "Starred scales" AI to determine the chromatic scales most similar to the selected area
• Adjust the semitones of the selected area notes to the chromatic scale
• Customize the chromatic scale for adjustment³
• Diminish, augment and subdivide note values
• Transpose pitches by semitones
Manage projects
• Browse your projects with convenient file manager
• Store your compositions in iCloud Drive and keep them up-to-date across all your iOS devices
• Create new projects and duplicate existing (up to three editable projects in free version)¹
• Listen to preview fragments of the scores directly from the files menu
• Open SNT, MIDI, MusicXML, Compressed MusicXML (MXL), Guitar Pro (GPX, GP5, GP4, GP3) and Karaoke (KAR) files
• Edit MIDI, MusicXML, MXL, Guitar Pro and Karaoke files¹
• Organize your files from a desktop computer using iTunes or iCloud Drive
• Open files from Mail and other applications (Dropbox, Box, etc.)
• Convert files between supported formats¹
Share your brand-new hits with friends
• Email your scores and tabs right from Staventabs
• Print your score¹
• Export to PDF and MPEG-4 AAC¹
Features marked with superscript numbers are available via the corresponding in-app purchases:
¹ Unlimited Projects
² Additional Instruments
³ Advanced Composing

bluejetty:00158522:ios.description:
Gérez facilement votre ligne Orange Mali 
● Gérez votre compte et consultez toutes les informations essentielles sur celui-ci, vos offres, ainsi que vos lignes téléphoniques.

● Rechargez votre ligne en achetant du crédit

bluejetty:00084944:ios.summary:
Ever wondered what it feels like to live the life of an ant?
Step into the world of the tiniest warriors in Ant Simulator – a survival adventure where every action shapes the future of your ant colony. Build, fight, gather, and survive in
bluejetty:00084944:ios.description:
Ever wondered what it feels like to live the life of an ant?
Step into the world of the tiniest warriors in Ant Simulator – a survival adventure where every action shapes the future of your ant colony. Build, fight, gather, and survive in a living ecosystem full of predators and rival legions.
► GAME FEATURES:
MASTER THE CONTROLS – Smooth, intuitive, and realistic movement mechanics designed to make you truly feel like an insect. These controls took about 6 months of refinement to deliver one of the most satisfying ant survival experiences ever made.
SURVIVE THE WILD – Face deadly predators like spiders, scorpions, and rival insect swarms.
DEFEND THE QUEEN – Her survival means the survival of the entire colony.
BUILD & GATHER – Hunt for food, collect sugary fruits, and protect valuable resources.
UNIQUE BURIAL MECHANIC – After brutal colony wars, bury your fallen ants in dedicated chambers, just as real ant species do.
CLIMB & EXPLORE – Scale trees and navigate the world vertically while searching for food or safety.
REALISTIC INSECT LIFE – Experience the harsh, fascinating world of ants in their natural habitat.
► GAME LOCALISATIONS:
The game is available in the following languages
1) English
2) Chinese (Simplified)
3) Spanish
4) Japanese
5) Russian
6) French
7) German
8) Arabic
9) Turkish
10) Vietnamese
This is not just another insect survival game—it’s one of the most immersive ant games ever, designed to capture the true struggle of an ant colony in nature.
Can you protect your queen, grow your colony, and lead your legion to survive in the wild?

bluejetty:00174596:ios.name: Dashcam - Car Crash Recorder
bluejetty:00174596:ios.summary: Dash Cam - Car Video Camcorder turns your iPhone or iPad into a reliable driving recorder. It continuously captures your drive in a loop and automatically saves footage when it detects sudden acceleration or braking. Whether it is an accide
bluejetty:00174596:ios.description:
Dash Cam - Car Video Camcorder turns your iPhone or iPad into a reliable driving recorder. It continuously captures your drive in a loop and automatically saves footage when it detects sudden acceleration or braking. Whether it is an accident or a near miss, the app preserves the crucial moment. All key telemetry data such as speed, location, heading, pitch, distance, date, and time can be overlaid directly onto your video, making manipulation nearly impossible. Every instrument can be resized and positioned freely to create the perfect heads-up display.
Configuration
You can adjust the video loop length and the incident saving delay to ensure that moments after an event are also recorded. The sensitivity of the acceleration trigger is configurable as well. Depending on your vehicle and driving style, you may fine-tune this threshold for best results.
Available instruments for Dash Cam - Car Video Camcorder
• Speed: Graphical instrument showing current speed
• Map: Displays current position on a map (satellite or standard)
• Heading: Magnetic compass heading relative to true north
• Course: Movement course vector relative to north
• Roll/Pitch: Shows camera roll and pitch
• G-Force: Displays horizontal and vertical G-forces
• Date: Current date
• Time: Current time
• Speed: Current speed as text
• DateTime: Date and time shown in one or two lines
• GPS Position: GPS coordinates shown in one or two lines
• Course: Movement course angle relative to true north
• Heading: Compass view angle of the camera relative to north
• Altitude: GPS altitude
• Distance: Distance traveled since start, resettable in Settings
• Duration: Duration since start, resettable in Settings
Further infos for Dash Cam - Car Video Camcorder
• Video recording format: MPEG-4
• Supports landscape and portrait video recording
• Instruments are fully movable and scalable
• Real-time telemetry via GPS and gyroscope
• Supports metric, imperial, and nautical units
• Works on iPhone and iPad
• Supports audio recording (disable audio recording at launch to listen to music from other apps)
• Heavy battery usage due to simultaneous use of GPS, gyroscope, camera, video encoding, and graphics
► Important Notes Concerning Subscriptions
All above AI Transcribe & Dictate subscriptions renew within 24 hours before the current period ends, and you will be charged through your iTunes account. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Manage or cancel your subscription from iTunes Account settings. See our Terms & Conditions (https://ibn-software.com/app-terms-conditions) and Privacy Policy (https://ibn-software.com/app-privacy-policy).

bluejetty:00046122:ios.description:
Golph is a golf GPS built around one idea: get out of your way.
Most golf apps treat the course like a dashboard. Feeds, badges, leaderboards, stats — a whole phone screen competing for your attention before you've even hit a shot. Golph does the opposite. One number. A quiet map. Then nothing.
WHAT GOLPH DOES
– GPS yardages to wherever you need them
– Calmed satellite view that keeps the course as the focus
– Tap-to-aim with a soft beam showing your line and carry distance
– Simple scorecard that stays out of your way
– Beat yourself: your shot history builds a ghost over time, so every round you're racing the best version of you at this course
– 31,000+ courses worldwide
THE GHOST
Every landing position is logged silently as you play. After a few rounds, Golph shows you a heatmap of past-you — warm where you score, cool where trouble lives. It's not about stats. It's about knowing your own game well enough to beat it.
THE PHILOSOPHY
No social feed. No badges. No leaderboard of strangers. You paid for this app, so it works for you — not the other way around.
The best round of your life happened when you forgot your phone. Golph tries to make that easier.
Battery life notice: continued background GPS use may affect battery life.

Privacy: golphmedia.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00043949:ios.summary:
Turn USDT, Bitcoin and other crypto into naira, then withdraw to any Nigerian bank in 5 to 10 minutes. Swapto is the new name for Dtunes, serving Nigerian crypto users since 2021. Your account and balance carry over.
SELL 7 COINS FOR NAIRA
bluejetty:00043949:ios.description:
Turn USDT, Bitcoin and other crypto into naira, then withdraw to any Nigerian bank in 5 to 10 minutes. Swapto is the new name for Dtunes, serving Nigerian crypto users since 2021. Your account and balance carry over.
SELL 7 COINS FOR NAIRA
• Tether (USDT) on TRC-20, ERC-20 or BEP-20
• Bitcoin (BTC)
• Ethereum (ETH)
• Tron (TRX)
• USD Coin (USDC)
• BNB
• Litecoin (LTC)
HOW TO SELL CRYPTO ON SWAPTO
1. Download Swapto and verify your identity with your BVN.
2. Choose your coin and network in the app, then copy your deposit address.
3. Send crypto from your wallet or exchange on that same network.
4. Sell. With auto-sell on, it converts the moment it lands. Otherwise, sell when you're ready and check the naira amount before you confirm.
5. Withdraw to your Nigerian bank account. Naira arrives in 5 to 10 minutes.
AUTO-SELL OR HOLD: YOUR CHOICE
With auto-sell on, Swapto converts your crypto at the live rate the moment your deposit is credited. With it off, your crypto stays in your Swapto wallet until you decide to sell.
WHAT TO EXPECT
• Bank payouts take 5 to 10 minutes after you sell.
• Deposit time depends on the network. Tron confirms in seconds. Bitcoin can take tens of minutes.
• Always send on the network shown in the app. USDT addresses on ERC-20 and BEP-20 both start with 0x, so check the network before you send.
• Network fees charged by your sending wallet are separate from Swapto's rate.
PAY BILLS FROM YOUR NAIRA BALANCE
Sell crypto to naira, then buy airtime and data, electricity tokens and cable TV in the same app. Bills are paid from your naira balance, not directly from your crypto.
BUILT FOR
• Freelancers and remote workers paid in USDT or Bitcoin by clients abroad.
• Families with relatives abroad. They send USDT to your Swapto wallet, then you sell it and withdraw to your bank.
• Anyone who holds crypto and wants naira in a Nigerian bank account.
SAFETY
• Swapto operates within Nigeria's regulatory framework through a licensed partner.
• We will never ask for your PIN, password, OTP or recovery phrase. Only trust the contacts listed below.
SUPPORT, 9AM TO 9PM WAT, EVERY DAY
WhatsApp: +234 811 337 2579
Email: support@useswapto.com
Website: useswapto.com

This Kerala bus ambulance mod could be an interesting choice for those looking for a different experience when playing Bussid.

bluejetty:00079599:android.description: Players take control of a bouncing circle that goes forward on its own across floating levels in the fast-paced game Circle Hops. bluejetty:00077364:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00077364:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
Welcome to an exciting game for school-going children interested in fashion design. Use your imagination and creativity to create fashionable outfits, and train your mathematical skills in between!
Key features of the game:
- Play fun dress up game
- Style your doll and become a fashion pro
- Dress your doll in princess dresses, gowns, casual wear, and many fashion outfits!
- Create a collection of cool outfits and save it!
- Complete daily tasks and get rewarded with new pieces of clothing
- Practice math: learn to count, add, subtract, multiply, divide, and more fun learning!
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00047025:ios.description:
Learn Korean language with animation and K-drama. App learning content is available free of charge. You can use the learning contents of the app while watching advertisements. If you pay for the in-app to remove ads, you can learn without ads.
1. 650 sentences, 1200 words, all related to daily life and can be learned easily by anyone.
2. Unique and exciting videos.
Every video portrays the sentence with flair and accuracy. The user will be able to understand what kind of sentence is being taught just by watching it and this naturally remains in the users head.
3. A fun learning experience with a story and characters.
There are 5 characters within the 650 sentences that share stories of everyday life. These characters create relationships of friendship and love between each other. These characters will foster your desire to keep on learning Korean.
4. Easy to learn, associative remembering techniques that allows you to rememeber for a long time.
It was designed by using an incredibly effective memory association technique for easy memorization. The sentence is expressed via videos and the words via images, therefore, the user can easily learn these sentences and words that remain in their head for a long time.
5. Grammar that does not have to be seperately studied.
There are 151 forms of grammar in the 650 sentences. By studying the sentences you will be able to learn the grammar as well.
6. Professionalism and know-hows that only SEEMILE has.
SEEMILE.COM has produced Korean language lecture videos and has been providing its services to the world. Over the past 8 years, more than 1,000 videos have been made which garnered a staggering 100 million views. SEEMILE, the creators of the world's most beloved Korean learning contents, have stored all its professional expertise and know-hows into [SEEMILE Mastering].
[Key Features]
- You can learn Korean consonants and vowels via the drag and drop method.
- You can learn to read Korean numbers easily just by touching.
- You can practice writing Korean with your finger.
You can listen to all 650 sentences in a row.
- A image association test is provided in order to help you remember what you've learned.
- Can be used without an internet connection.
- High quality native pronunciation is provided by Korean voice actors.
- Provide Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish, Thai, and Vietnamese translations.
- We provide sounds that help you read out the sentences and words.
- We recommend apps that help learn Korean easily and quickly.

✔ Clear reward point system with defined limits
✔ Daily challenges and bonus opportunities
⚠️ Important Disclaimer

Download Puzzle Master and challenge your memory skills while collecting rewards!

bluejetty:00146545:android.description:
WELCOME TO SWEET WORDS
Help bring back the memories in the diary by connecting the letters and forming complete words.
A GAME OF CONCENTRATION
Pay close attention to the letters you connect to correctly assemble all the words in the diary!
HOW TO PLAY
Connect the letters to complete the diary with all the words. Check out the step by step:
🔹 1st Check out the word tip at the top of the screen;
🔹 Then realize that there are spaces to fit the words, they will be your guides to discover the words more quickly;
🔹 Playing is simple. Always in horizontal and vertical lines, connect letters to form words. But pay attention to one detail: connect the letters in the correct order.
🔹 Watch ads and get some benefits to help you.
PLAY AND WIN REAL MONEY
Choose how you want to withdraw: playing or indicating! Check out the secrets to getting lots of points in Sweet Words:
1️⃣ Play and complete levels to collect points
2️⃣ Register (+35 points);
3️⃣ Use a referral code from a friend (+40 points);
4️⃣ Participate in sponsor promotions and offers (+2 to +30 points).
You can also receive for every 10 valid referrals you bring to the game with your code. For an indication to be valid it must:
1️⃣ Use your code correctly;
2️⃣ Register;
3️⃣ Play up to level 10.
The more coins you accumulate, the more money you can withdraw via Pix! Every withdrawal request takes up to 20 days to be approved, as it goes through an analysis process to understand whether the score was acquired without violating any terms or conditions of the game.
SUPPORT
Sweet cares about your experience in Sweet Words, so it would be great if you evaluated our game with feedback or report, your opinion helps us to improve even more.
If you have more specific questions, contact our support email: contato@sweetpanels.com.
Our team will certainly find the best solution for what you are looking for!
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
By downloading Sweet Words you will be agreeing to our Privacy Policies and the app's Terms of Use, available at:
https://sweetbonus.com.br/games/privacy-policy
https://sweetbonus.com.br/games/terms-conditions
OUR SOCIAL MEDIA
Stay up to date with all our releases! 👍 Follow @sweetmediaoficial on Instagram, Facebook, You Tube, Tik Tok and Kwai. 
Thanks for playing Sweet Words!
