bluejetty:00022970:ios.name: Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight
bluejetty:00022970:ios.summary: Grab the control yoke of a warplane and jump into the battlefields of World War 2 in this thrilling combat flight action game. In each of the campaigns for USA, Great Britain, USSR, Germany and Japan you will assume the role of a pilot and
bluejetty:00022970:ios.description:
Grab the control yoke of a warplane and jump into the battlefields of World War 2 in this thrilling combat flight action game. In each of the campaigns for USA, Great Britain, USSR, Germany and Japan you will assume the role of a pilot and squadron leader of an elite air force unit, established for the most dangerous and strategic missions that can turn the tide of war.
In Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight you take control of over 50 historical airplanes – from classic fighters to light and heavy bombers. Spitfire, P-51, Hurricane, Lancaster, Il-2 “Shturmovik”, La-5FN, Ju-87 “Stuka”, Fw 200 “Condor” and B-17 “Flying Fortress” are only a few of the beautiful machines that you can fly, repaint, customize and upgrade.
Gather a squadron of the best pilots and train them to assist you in the most risky missions. If you need an additional adrenaline rush, you can go on a mission by yourself and rule the sky.
Build your base – construct additional hangars and structures for your pilots and crew. Ensure its safety by building anti-aircraft artillery and barrage balloons. Develop your management skills to cut costs and manage your unit more efficiently, and become the ultimate squadron leader.
Play through varied missions in each of the available campaigns – experience deadly encounters with enemy fighters, protect ground structures from bombers, fight over the sea and weaken the enemy’s navy, pilot bombers and destroy targets of strategic value. These are only a few examples of multiple mission types that you will experience in the beautiful landscapes of Europe, Africa and Asia. Pick the best planes and pilots for the job and fly over the cold Russian tundra or sunny deserts of Egypt. Fight over the Pacific Ocean and experience the war from the perspective of American and Japanese pilots.
EXPERIENCE WW2 FLIGHT COMBAT ON MOBILE LIKE NEVER BEFORE
● The best WW2 air combat game on mobile devices with intuitive controls and user-friendly flight mechanics.
● Over 50 historical planes from RAF, Luftwaffe, American, Japanese and Soviet Air Forces, with various customization, paint and upgrade options.
● As squadron leader, you are tasked with more than piloting your plane – you also manage the base. Buy planes, recruit and train pilots, and keep building additional structures.
● Detailed 3D graphics with awesome special effects.
● Radio chatter in American English, British English, Russian, German and Japanese to give you the full experience of a World War II dogfight.
IGRS rating: 15+

Grab the control yoke of a warplane and jump into the battlefields of World War 2 in this thrilling combat flight action game. In each of the campaigns for USA, Great Britain, USSR, Germany and Japan you will assume the role of a pilot and squadron leader of an elite air force unit, established for the most dangerous and strategic missions that can turn the tide of war.
In Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight you take control of over 50 historical airplanes – from classic fighters to light and heavy bombers. Spitfire, P-51, Hurricane, Lancaster, Il-2 “Shturmovik”, La-5FN, Ju-87 “Stuka”, Fw 200 “Condor” and B-17 “Flying Fortress” are only a few of the beautiful machines that you can fly, repaint, customize and upgrade.
Gather a squadron of the best pilots and train them to assist you in the most risky missions. If you need an additional adrenaline rush, you can go on a mission by yourself and rule the sky.
Build your base – construct additional hangars and structures for your pilots and crew. Ensure its safety by building anti-aircraft artillery and barrage balloons. Develop your management skills to cut costs and manage your unit more efficiently, and become the ultimate squadron leader.
Play through varied missions in each of the available campaigns – experience deadly encounters with enemy fighters, protect ground structures from bombers, fight over the sea and weaken the enemy’s navy, pilot bombers and destroy targets of strategic value. These are only a few examples of multiple mission types that you will experience in the beautiful landscapes of Europe, Africa and Asia. Pick the best planes and pilots for the job and fly over the cold Russian tundra or sunny deserts of Egypt. Fight over the Pacific Ocean and experience the war from the perspective of American and Japanese pilots.

EXPERIENCE WW2 FLIGHT COMBAT ON MOBILE LIKE NEVER BEFORE
● The best WW2 air combat game on mobile devices with intuitive controls and user-friendly flight mechanics.
● Over 50 historical planes from RAF, Luftwaffe, American, Japanese and  Soviet Air Forces, with various customization, paint and upgrade options.
● As squadron leader, you are tasked with more than piloting your plane – you also manage the base. Buy planes, recruit and train pilots, and keep building additional structures.
● Detailed 3D graphics with awesome special effects.
● Radio chatter in American English, British English, Russian, German and Japanese to give you the full experience of a World War II dogfight.


IGRS rating: 15+

bluejetty:00174866:ios.name: Living Earth - Clock & Weather
bluejetty:00174866:ios.summary:
Weather on a planetary scale: live clouds, storms and weather maps across a 3D Earth, with forecasts and a world clock for the cities you care about.
“In a sea of more complicated and ambitious apps, Living Earth is beautifully simple.” -
bluejetty:00174866:ios.description:
Weather on a planetary scale: live clouds, storms and weather maps across a 3D Earth, with forecasts and a world clock for the cities you care about.
“In a sea of more complicated and ambitious apps, Living Earth is beautifully simple.” - The New York Times
“Living Earth is proof that a world clock and weather app can be beautiful.” - Apple, App Store
“A stunning app that shows the Earth in real time, based on global weather reports.” - WIRED Insider, Must Have Apps
FEATURES
• Watch live clouds from near-real-time satellite data, updated every hour: global cloud patterns, hurricanes and tropical storms.
• Pinch in from orbit for a closer look at clouds, mountains and coastlines.
• Explore live and forecast weather maps of temperature, humidity and wind.
• Check hourly and 10-day forecasts for any city on Earth.
• Get notified as new tropical storms form and change strength.
• See the Moon in its current phase, with the stars and the Milky Way all around.
• Follow eclipses as they happen: the Moon's shadow sweeping across Earth, or the Moon turning deep red. Get notified when a total eclipse begins.
• Wake up to the Earth with the Wake Alarm and its choice of gentle tones.
• Keep your cities in sync through iCloud on iPhone and iPad, and in Living Earth for Mac.
Private by design: no accounts, no ads, no tracking, and we never sell your data.
Weather data from CustomWeather. Earth imagery from NASA, and cloud imagery from NOAA and the Japan Meteorological Agency.
EMAIL US: support@radiantlabs.io
FOLLOW US: x.com/livingearthapp

bluejetty:00105082:ios:1.description:
The race is on! Welcome to Talking Tom Hero Dash – the ultimate endless runner adventure where the fun never stops!
The Rakoonz are on the loose! They've captured Talking Angela, Ben, Hank, and Ginger, and it's up to you to be the hero, save Tom's friends, and clean up the city! Are you ready to join them on this thrilling quest?
- Epic Runs: Feel the adrenaline rush as you dash, jump, slide, and avoid obstacles in stunning environments. 
- Battle the Rakoonz: The Rakoonz are back, wreaking havoc and causing chaos. Unleash your inner superhero, show off your skills, and save your friends from their clutches!
- Collect Awesome Rewards: Gather gold coins, treasure chests, power-ups, gadgets, suits, and diamonds as you blaze through the city.
- Unlock and Upgrade Heroes: Rescue and play as your favorite characters from the My Talking Tom and Friends universe. Unlock unique superhero outfits and power them up for even more fun!
- Restore the City: Defeat the Rakoonz and complete heroic missions to clean up and rebuild the city. 
- Exciting Power-Ups: Use incredible power-ups to boost your run and gain an edge over the Rakoonz. 
Embark on a Supercharged Adventure: Dive into a world of endless excitement and high-speed action with Talking Tom Hero Dash! Dash through vibrant cities, ancient temples, scorching deserts, and icy mountains. Leap over obstacles, dodge buses, and collect gold coins and tokens to help restore peace and order.
From Outfit7, creators of My Talking Tom, My Talking Tom Friends, My Talking Angela, and Talking Tom Gold Run.
This app is certified by PRIVO, an FTC Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Safe Harbor.

- Promotion of Outfit7's products and advertising;
- Links that direct customers to Outfit7’s websites and other apps;
- Personalization of content to encourage users to play the app again;
- The option to make in-app purchases;
- Items to purchase (available in different prices) using virtual currency, depending on the player’s progress; and
- Alternative options to access all functionalities of the app without making any in-app purchases using real money.
Please note, we do not process all the data disclosed on the label for users under the age of digital consent. For more information, please check our Privacy Policy.

bluejetty:00176583:ios.description:
Introducing the PARAPHRASE TOOL and REWORD
Paraphrase Tool and Reword is a complete writing assistant designed to enhance, refine, and optimize your content. With advanced AI-driven features, multi-language support, and professional rewriting tools, this application helps students, bloggers, professionals, and creators produce high-quality writing effortlessly.
Whether you need to paraphrase text, humanize AI content, detect plagiarism, summarize articles, or correct grammar, this app provides everything in one place.
--- PARAPHRASING MODES --- 
Paraphrase Tool includes four powerful rewriting modes tailored to different writing needs:
--- GENERAL MODE ---
Rewrites text naturally while maintaining the intended meaning. Ideal for daily writing tasks.
--- FLUENCY MODE ---
Improves clarity, readability, and sentence structure for smoother, professional content.
--- BLOG MODE ---
Optimized for content creators, producing engaging, SEO-friendly text for blogs and digital content.
--- FORMAL MODE ---
Suitable for academic and professional writing, ensuring a precise and formal tone.
+ PLAGIARISM REMOVER AND CHECKER +
+ PLAGIARISM REMOVER
Transforms existing content into fresh, original text while preserving meaning.
+ PLAGIARISM CHECK
Quickly identifies duplicated material to ensure your writing is authentic and unique.
---- AI DETECTOR ----
Analyze any text to determine whether it was created by a human or an AI model. Ideal for educators, reviewers, and editors.
---- HUMANIZER TOOL ----
Convert AI-generated text into natural, human-like writing that reads authentically and is less detectable by AI classifiers.
ARTICLE AND PARAGRAPH REWRITER
Rewrite full articles, essays, and paragraphs with a single click. Perfect for students, researchers, and content creators who need refreshed or alternative versions of their work.
SUMMARIZER TOOL
Condense lengthy articles, documents, or research papers into clear, concise summaries while keeping all essential information.
GRAMMAR CHECKER
Detect and correct grammar, punctuation, and sentence structure issues instantly to improve clarity and professionalism.
MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT
Paraphrase Tool supports 19 languages, enabling users globally to rewrite, summarize, and improve content regardless of their writing language.
USER-FRIENDLY INTERFACE
The application features a clean, intuitive interface for effortless navigation. All tools are easily accessible for both beginners and advanced users.
WHY CHOOSE THE PARAPHRASE TOOL AND REWRITE

bluejetty:00033288:ios.description:
Are you having trouble falling asleep at night? 
Does it hard to get a good night's rest? 
Meet Sleepo, the ultimate sleep sounds, and white noise app to help you get a better night's rest. With its wide selection of sleep sounds and white noise options, you'll be able to find the perfect combination to help you relax and fall asleep. So download Sleepo today and start getting the rest you deserve!
With a wide selection of calming sounds to choose from, you'll be able to find the perfect noise to help you relax and drift off to sleep. From the soothing sounds of rain and thunder to the gentle hum of a fan, Sleepo has something for everyone.
In addition to our wide selection of sleep sounds, Sleepo also offers white noise options for those who prefer a more neutral, consistent noise to help them sleep. Whether you choose a traditional white noise sound or one of our unique options, like the sound of a coffee shop or the ocean, you'll be able to find the perfect sound to help you sleep.
FEATURES:
• Sleep sounds: Soothing sounds and healing music for relaxation, focus, and sleep
• Brainwaves: Isochronic Tones, Solfeggio Frequencies and Binaural Beats
• White noises: Ocean Waves, Campfire, Heavy Rain, Thunderstorm, Waterfall, and much more
• Noise Machine: Mix and match different sounds to create your own perfect ambiance
• Sleep, Focus & Nap Timers: Stop the app after a set amount of time
• Favorites: Save your favorite mixes to play them later
• Mix multiple sounds
• Play on launch to immediately start playing your favorite sound
• Today Widget with the most recently played sounds
• Plays in the background
• Offline mode
• AirPlay 
MORE THAN 300 SLEEP SOUNDS & MUSIC:
• Nature sounds
• Rain sounds
• Fan noise
• Baby sounds
• ASMR sounds
• White noise
• Water sounds
• Brainwaves
• Isochronic tones (4hz, 5hz, 10hz, 20hz)
• Binaural beats (4hz, 5hz, 10hz, 20hz)
• Solfeggio frequencies (396hz, 417hz, 528hz, 741hz, 852hz)
And much more…

bluejetty:00026013:ios.description:
Bible Trivia: Jesus Quiz Games makes learning Scripture fun, challenging, and meaningful.
Test your Bible knowledge with daily trivia, Jesus quizzes, Christian word puzzles, Bible questions and answers, and inspiring Scripture challenges. Whether you are new to the Bible or have studied God's Word for years, there is always something new to discover.
PLAY DAILY BIBLE TRIVIA
Take on fresh Bible quiz challenges every day. Answer questions, build your knowledge, and make Scripture part of your daily routine.
TEST YOUR BIBLE KNOWLEDGE
Explore thousands of questions inspired by the Old and New Testaments. Learn more about Jesus, the apostles, prophets, parables, miracles, biblical characters, and important events throughout Scripture.
EXPLORE 100+ BIBLE CATEGORIES
Discover quizzes and challenges covering:
• Jesus and the Gospels
• Women of the Bible
• Psalms and Proverbs
• Genesis and Revelation
• Prophets and Apostles
• Miracles and Parables
• Stories of Faith
• Old and New Testament topics
5,000+ BIBLE QUESTIONS & ANSWERS
Challenge yourself with a growing collection of Bible trivia:
• 3,000+ Old Testament questions
• 2,000+ New Testament questions
• Questions about Adam, Noah, Abraham, Moses, David, Solomon, Jesus, Peter, Paul, Mary, and many more
CHRISTIAN QUIZ CHALLENGES
Put your knowledge to the test through exciting multiple-choice Bible quizzes. Use helpful guidance when a difficult question has you stuck and keep progressing through your faith-filled trivia journey.
BIBLE WORD SEARCH & PUZZLE GAMES
Enjoy relaxing Christian word puzzles and Bible word search games that exercise your mind while helping you recognize names, places, themes, and words from Scripture.
DAILY BIBLE VERSES
Begin your day with encouraging Bible verses about faith, hope, love, peace, healing, strength, and God's grace.
COMPETE ON THE GLOBAL LEADERBOARD
See how your Bible knowledge compares with other players. Keep learning, improve your score, and work your way up the leaderboard.
SEASONAL CHRISTIAN THEMES
Celebrate meaningful seasons throughout the year with Bible content inspired by:
• Christmas
• Advent
• Lent
• Easter
• Ordinary Time
MADE FOR BIBLE LOVERS
Bible Trivia: Jesus Quiz Games is designed for:
• Christians who enjoy Bible trivia and Bible quiz games
• Adults who want to test and grow their Bible knowledge
• Families who enjoy learning Scripture together
• Bible study groups and church communities
• Sunday school and faith-based learning
• Anyone looking for a fun way to spend more time with God's Word
LEARN, PLAY & GROW IN FAITH
Bible Trivia is more than a quiz game. Every challenge gives you another opportunity to remember Scripture, discover biblical stories, and strengthen your knowledge of God's Word.
How well do you know the Bible?
Start your daily Bible trivia challenge today, explore Scripture from Genesis to Revelation, and see how far your Bible knowledge can take you.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Unlock full access with one of the following subscription options:
• Weekly Plan: $2.99/week
• Monthly Plan: $7.99/month
Prices apply to U.S. customers.
Terms of Use:
http://www.biblestudios.net/terms
Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00178282:ios.description:
Across is a calendar you can start using right away, then customize as much as you like. With a wide range of views and deep customization, it becomes more your own every day.
Across doesn't lock you in. Your events stay safely in Apple and Google, while Across helps you view and manage them the way you want. Our goal is simple: not to keep you locked in, but to be the calendar you'll want to keep using.
Across works seamlessly with Apple Calendar, Reminders, and Google Calendar, and stays in sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. No ads. Any data we collect is never linked to your identity.
What Across offers:
* 12+ calendar views
* Monthly view with up to two lines per event and adjustable spacing
* Weekly and multi-day views with continuous day-by-day scrolling
* Deep customization of tabs, views, fonts, colors, and themes
* Routine and recurring event management
* Event templates, natural language event creation, and more
* Anniversary and D-day countdowns
* Widgets that show your upcoming events at a glance
* Events and tasks managed in one place
For those who love to plan, a precise planning tool. For those who don't, a simple way to stay on top of your days.
Contact: support@daymore.com
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00185601:ios.description:
30 GAMES IN 1 APP! 
This is the ultimate app for girls who love fashion and make up. There are hundreds of hairstyles, makeup and clothes for you to try out! You can do makeup & dress up for models, princesses, mermaids, ballerinas, gymnasts, hero girls, weddings, pop stars, and much more! Download now and play the best makeover games for girls! :)
FEATURES OF EACH GAME
• 3 girls of different skin colors to choose from!
• 3 levels: Spa*, Makeup and Dress Up!
• At the spa apply face masks and shape her eyebrows!
• The makeup salon will have the best hairstyles, makeup and jewelry! Some of the games also have face painting in the makeup salon!
• Dress up will have lots of fashionable clothing, shoes and accessories to dress up the girls! 
• Save your makeovers to the photo gallery on your iPhone or iPad, and show them to your friends!
MAKEOVER GAMES INSIDE THIS APP
1. Super Model
2. Ice Queen
3. Ice Mermaid
4. Tropical Princess
5. Magic Princess
6. Ballerina
7. Gymnastics
8. Hero Girl
9. Fashion Girl
10. Snow Queen Wedding
11. Fantasy Princess
12. Magic Mermaid
13. Pop Star
14. Halloween 
15. Surfer Girl
16. Skater Girl
17. Spy Girl
18. High School Princess
19. Cheerleader
20. Figure Skater
21. Ice Prom Queen
22. Monster Girl Prom
23. Cinderella
24. Super Princess
25. Space Girl
26. Snow Queen*
27. Halloween Wedding
28. Movie Star
29. Fairy
30. Unicorn Fashion Girl
*Snow Queen is the only game that does not have spa. It just has makeup and dressup. The rest of the games all have spa, makeup and dress up!
HOW TO PLAY
Choose the game you want to play. Then select a girl by tapping on her name. Apply spa treatments using face masks, tweeze her eyebrows to give them a neat shape and use the face humidifier to soften her skin. 
To go to the makeup salon, tap on the arrow at the top right of your screen. Choose a hairstyle and eye color for her, and apply eye shadow, eyeliner, mascara, blush and lipstick! You’ll have a lot of nice make up colors to choose from! Then select her earrings and necklace, and depending on the game, either sunglasses, or a headpiece such as a tiara, a crown or a headband! 
Then go to dress up! Mix and match to create your own personal style! Depending on the game you’re playing, you can choose from dresses, skirts, pants, tops, shoes, purses, coats, and so much more! After you dress up the girl, you can choose your favorite of 3 backgrounds and take a photo of her to save to your iPhone or iPad!
CONTACT US
Do you have questions or suggestions? We’d love to hear from you! :)
Write to us: peachygamesllc@gmail.com

All of the games inside this app are free to download and play, and you may use some of the makeup and dress up items for free. For more information, please read our Privacy Policy: http://www.peachygamesllc.com/privacy.htm. By downloading or using the app you consent (in your personal capacity and for other users of your device) to this collection and use of an identifier on your device and to our Terms of Use: http://www.peachygamesllc.com/terms.htm.

bluejetty:00160662:ios.description:
Shimeji Friends is your digital pet companion, always close at hand.
Choose an adorable little animal, give it a name, and begin your own story together. Feed, play with, bathe, clean up after, and tuck in your pet as you care for it day by day.
Inspired by retro digital pet toys of the 1980s, Shimeji Friends brings the joy of raising a tiny companion to your iPhone. Your pet does not have to stay inside the app—it can join you on Dynamic Island, the Lock Screen, and your Home Screen widgets.
► LET YOUR PET LIVE ON YOUR SCREEN
Meet your pet in a collection of delightful widgets that fit naturally into your everyday iPhone experience:
- Clock widget: welcome every moment with your pet
- Weather widget: check the forecast and receive a cozy reminder from your companion
- Calendar widget: see today’s date, to-dos, and your pet’s latest updates
- Daily message widget: enjoy a sweet little greeting from your pet
- Photo widget: pair treasured memories with an adorable companion
All widgets support transparent backgrounds, so your digital pet can blend naturally into your Home Screen and feel like it is right by your side.
► CHOOSE YOUR PET FRIEND
Start with the animal you love and give it a one-of-a-kind name. Meet companions with different looks and personalities, including cats, dogs, ducks, turtles, sheep, owls, and deer—plus more mysterious little spirits waiting to be unlocked.
Every pet deserves thoughtful care and gentle companionship. Learn what they like, play together, explore together, and enjoy the little moments of each day.
► BUILD YOUR BOND THROUGH PLAY
Caring for your pet is only the beginning:
- Feed, play with, bathe, and clean up after your pet while keeping an eye on its mood and fullness
- Discover cute gesture interactions—shake your phone to help your little friend drift off to sleep
- Care for different pets and unlock mysterious spirits along the way
- Explore each pet’s favorite foods, games, and activities
- Travel together through imaginative worlds, from undersea adventures to a futuristic world
- Happy pets may even attract new friends for you to discover
Download Shimeji Friends now—let cuteness brighten every day, and let companionship always be close.
Subscription Options:
Digital Pets offers unlimited access and unlocks all features with a weekly subscription for $1.99, an annual subscription for $14.99, or a one-time lifetime purchase for $17.99.
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Weekly and annual subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, at the price shown for your selected plan.
You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase. The current subscription cannot be cancelled during an active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. The lifetime purchase is a one-time payment and does not renew.
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/digital-pet/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/digital-pet/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00091325:ios.description:
An ad free workout tracking app to optimize your training for progression. Intensity is focused on getting you better than you were yesterday.
Intensity has an interface that makes tracking easy. Plan an entire workout in advance, or log it as you go. Designed for progression, it has everything you need right at your finger tips. This includes in-depth stats to identify trends in your training, custom goals to push you to progress, and the ability to easily view your personal records.
Intensity includes popular powerlifting programs such as 5/3/1, Starting Strength, Stronglifts 5x5, The Texas Method, Smolov, Scheiko, The Juggernaut Method, GZCL, Candito programs, Kizen programs, and practically every other popular powerlifting program you can think of. If you can't find what you are looking for, you can build your own programs, customize existing programs, import programs, or use AI to generate a program.
With your workouts stored securely in the cloud, access your data whenever you need it. You can access your data on all major platforms.
Apple Watch app to access your workouts with or without your iPhone
You can import data from popular apps such as Strong, Hevy, FitNotes, and Stronglifts 5x5. You can also export all your workouts for further analysis.
Intensity includes social features where you can add your friends, share workouts, and compete on the leaderboard.
Other features include:
• Sync your workouts with Apple Health
• Timer & stopwatch
• Interval timer
• Bodyweight tracker
• 1RM calculator
• Plate calculator with custom plate settings
• IPF-GL, Wilks, and DOTS calculator
• Warmup calculator with the ability to add custom warmup methods
• Light/dark mode
• Supports multiple languages
Use Intensity as the ultimate tracking tool that will last you your entire lifting lifetime.
Intensity is free to download and use. Should you choose to upgrade to Intensity Premium, we offer an auto-renewing subscription option for $2.99USD/month, an auto-renewing subscription option for $17.99USD/year, and one singular payment option for $34.99USD:
Payment will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. 
There is no increase in price when renewing.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Read our full Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy at https://www.intensityapp.com/terms-conditions and https://www.intensityapp.com/privacy-policy.

bluejetty:00098415:ios.description:
*Make sure to check if your device is supported before playing Subnautica!*
Subnautica is an underwater adventure game set on an alien ocean planet. A massive, open world full of wonder and peril awaits you!
Descend into the depths, craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive. Unravel the mystery of this world teeming with creatures, both friendly and hostile, scattered with clues from a previous time.
Play in Survival mode to experience the original challenge, or switch to Freedom or Creative mode to discover this oceanic planet without the pressures of thirst, hunger, or oxygen. 
FEATURES
• SURVIVE - After crash landing on a vast underwater planet, the clock is ticking to find water, food, and to develop the equipment you need to explore.
• EXPLORE - Manage your hunger, thirst, and oxygen supply as you dive into towering kelp forests, sunlit plateaus, bio-luminescent reefs, and winding cave systems.
• SCAVENGE - Collect resources from the ocean around you. Venture deeper and further to find rarer resources, allowing you to craft more advanced items.
• CRAFT - Build bases to shelter in, vehicles to pilot, tools for survival to aid you in navigating and adapting to this subaquatic landscape. 
• DISCOVER - What happened to this planet? What caused you to crash? Can you find a way to make it off the planet alive?
• CUSTOMIZE - Play in Survival mode to experience the original challenge, or switch to Freedom or Creative mode to discover this oceanic planet without the pressures of thirst, hunger, or oxygen. 
CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
• Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
• Game Center achievements
• Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
• Compatible with MFi controllers
• iPhone 16 Optimization (including Pro Max)
-----
*DEVICES NOT SUPPORTED (THE GAME WON'T WORK)*: 
- iPhone Xr, iPhone SE Gen 2 (2020)
- iPad Mini Gen 5, iPad Air Gen 3, iPad Gen 8, iPad Gen 9
*SUPPORTED DEVICES ON LOW RESOLUTION ONLY*: 
- iPhone Xs, iPhone Xs Max, iPhone 11, iPhone 11 Pro, iPhone 11 Pro Max, iPhone 12, iPhone 12 Mini, iPhone 13, iPhone 13 Mini, iPhone SE Gen 3 (2022) 
- iPad Pro 10.5", iPad Mini Gen 6, iPad Air Gen 4, iPad Gen 10, iPad Pro 11" Gen 1, iPad Pro 12.9" Gen 3
*SUPPORTED DEVICES* : 
- iPhone 12 Pro, iPhone 12 Pro Max, iPhone 13 Pro, iPhone 13 Pro Max, iPhone 14 AND ABOVE 
- iPad Pro 11" Gen 2, iPad Pro 12.9" Gen 4, iPad Air Gen 5, iPad Pro 11" Gen 3, iPad Pro 11" Gen 4, iPad Pro 12.9" Gen 5, iPad Pro 12.9" Gen 6 AND ABOVE

bluejetty:00047034:ios.summary:
"… the definitive source for puzzles for iOS…" -- the New York Times
Download and play crossword puzzles right on your iPad, iPhone or iPod touch. Each day many newspapers provide their crossword puzzles online; with one tap you can downlo
bluejetty:00047034:ios.description:
"… the definitive source for puzzles for iOS…" -- the New York Times
Download and play crossword puzzles right on your iPad, iPhone or iPod touch. Each day many newspapers provide their crossword puzzles online; with one tap you can download and solve them, get hints, view clues, and track how quickly you're improving!
The #1 Crossword Player on iPad, iPhone and iPod touch just got even better!
• New: Sync your puzzles with Crosswords for Mac; Start a puzzle on your Mac, then finish it on your iPhone or iPad. 
• Get new puzzles every day
• Touch and hold a square to view hints on iPad
• Enter Numbers and other special characters by holding down keys
• One tap downloads all of today's puzzles
• Nearly unlimited puzzles from many different sites
• US and UK Cryptic puzzles available
• Hints, Websites, and Clue lookups
• Enter answers in 'ink' or 'pencil'
• Quickly see your recently played, or sort by date or provider
• Detailed info on each puzzle
• Post your solve times online and compare with other solvers
• Grab older puzzles with a tap
• Tap the clue list with two fingers to adjust the font size (iPad only)
Included Puzzle Sources:
• Brendan Emmett Quigley's Weekly Puzzle
• Jonesin'
• King Features Crosswords (Joseph, Sheffer, and Premier)
• Newsday
• Andy Kravis, Cruciverbist at Law
• Glutton for Pun
• MacNamara’s Band
• Murchie’s Monday Fills
• Neville Fogarty
• Puzzle Express
• The Stickler Weekly
• World of Crosswords
Premium Crosswords subscription required:
• Matt Gaffney’s Crossword Contest
• American Values Crossword
• Crooked Crosswords
• Additional puzzles downloadable via the Puzzle Browser; browse the web and download more!
Providers list subject to change. Some providers may no longer be publishing, but may still have older puzzles available in Archive form, accessible via the "Download Older Puzzles" option. 
• For support, please visit our website at http://www.standalone.com •
Tips:
• You can tap on the clue text at the bottom of the screen to toggle across & down
• Rotate the screen to see both the puzzle and clues
• Touch for a moment then drag to precisely select a square.
• Touch the Plus to download older puzzles
Please note that Crosswords requires an internet connection to download puzzles. Syncing puzzles to your Mac requires the purchase of Crosswords from the Mac App Store. Multiplayer requires iOS 6.0 or later.
Privacy Policy: https://www.standalone.com/legal/
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

In Zombie IDLE Defense, you will go to a post-apocalyptic world where most of the world's population has turned into ferocious zombies. bluejetty:00131852:ios.description:
SkewTLogPro gives you one-touch access to powerful skew-t log-p charts. View charts using your current GPS location, airport ID code or lat/lon. Each skew-t log-p chart provides a visual indication of temperature, dew point, winds aloft, and wind speed at various altitudes, as well as Current Radar, Airmets, Sigmets, and SkewT data charted, filtered by altitude.
FEATURES:
• NEW! View all Sigmet/Airmet on a map and filter by altitude
• NEW! View SkewT data charted on a map with altitude filtering, shows potential warnings of Icing, Wind, and Visibility
• Ability to view the lifted parcel line
• Support for International Airport ICAO codes
• View charts along your route using 'View Route' 
• Support for GFS for all locations outside the continental United States (Option in Settings)
• View many values such as CAPE, LI, LCL, and many other options through settings 
• Save charts for offline use
• View Skew T Log soundings by touching a location on a map
• View skew-t log(p) charts using your current GPS location, airport identifier or latitude and longitude.
• Scroll forward and backward to view past and forecast charts.
• History list allows easy access to previously viewed locations.
• Select how many previous and forecast hours are charted
• Drag on the graph to view each point value
• Double-tap to zoom in for more detail on the soundings.
• Great for aviators, glider pilots and weather enthusiasts.
An annual subscription is required to access these graphs and to use SkewTLogPro for $12.99 per year. Cancel anytime. Please view the End User License Agreement here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00184706:ios.description:
Superimpose is a complete creative studio for photo editing, image compositing, video editing, and AI-powered visual creation.
Build complex edits by hand with layers, masks, blend modes, brushes, effects, adjustments, shadows, text, blur, warp and perspective tools. Cut out people and objects, combine several images, paint masks, adjust colours, add depth and shadows, and refine every detail. When you want faster results, use AI to generate images from text, edit and repair photos, replace backgrounds, expand a picture beyond its edges, enhance details, relight a scene, create headshots, swap faces, turn a sketch into finished art, or animate a still photo into a short video.
And it is not only about photos any more. A true multi-track video editor is built in, so one project can carry you from a single image to a finished video without ever leaving the app.
PHOTO EDITING AND COMPOSITING
• Layer-based editing with up to 24 layers
• Advanced masking, including Magic Wand, Magic Lasso, brush masks and shape masks
• 18 blend modes and 16 adjustment layers
• Non-destructive layer blur and adjustments
• 63 photo effects, plus clarity, colour, tone and detail controls
• Text and curved text tools
• Motion Blur, Zoom Blur, Spin Blur, Lens Blur, Selective Blur and Gradient tools
• Warp, perspective transform and distortion tools
• Paint, smudge, clone stamp and effect brushes
• Built-in shadow and Light Wrap tools
• Camera fill with real-time masks and blend modes
• Masking Library for reusable cutouts and stickers
• Session Library that saves your projects automatically
• PSD export with layers
• More than a million royalty-free stock photos
VIDEO EDITING
• Multi-track timeline for video, images, audio and text
• Split, trim, rotate and freeze clips with ease
• Speed control, including speed ramps
• Keyframe animation with adjustable curves
• Transitions between clips
• Stack effects and animations on any track for unique results
• Use masks for precise editing, including green screen and more
• Audio from your device, voiceovers and royalty-free music
• Stickers and animated GIFs
• Royalty-free stock video and photos
• Export in the format and resolution you choose
AI TOOLS
• AI people masking
• AI image generation from text
• AI image editing and inpainting
• AI background creation and replacement
• AI outpainting and image expansion
• AI image enhancement
• AI relighting
• AI sketch-to-image creation
• AI headshot generation
• AI face swap
• AI image-to-image transformation
• AI image-to-video generation
Whether you are making social posts, thumbnails, designs, artwork, product images, profile photos, memes, edits or professional composites, Superimpose X gives you manual precision and AI speed in one app. Start with an idea, a photo, a sketch, a video or a blank canvas.
Superimpose gives you the freedom to create by hand, the speed of AI when you need it, and the control to make every result your own.

Embark on a bone-chilling journey in "Taco Loco: Scary Adventure," where each step could be your last in the eerie silence of a taco empire shrouded in darkness. An insidious taco chef harbors a dark secret, his evil delights masking a terrifying truth. As evil stirs in the shadows, the very essence of terror is wrapped in tortillas and served with a side of dread.
Your quest is clear: delve into the heart of this culinary horror story, uncover the malevolent mysteries, and save your town from a fate worse than spoiled salsa. apple-macos:6780675251.name: AvClock: Global Airport Times
apple-macos:6780675251.description:
AvClock is the world clock and airport database built for aviation and avgeeks alike — track local time, UTC/Zulu, and live conditions for any airport on Earth, beautifully and at a glance.
Build your own list of airports and pin LOCAL and Zulu/UTC rows right alongside them. Every row shows the live local time and dawn/dusk; tap any airport for the full picture — map, sunrise & sunset, ICAO/IATA codes, city, country, coordinates, and time zone. Browse the whole world on the interactive Airport Map, with quick filters by continent and drill-downs to any U.S. state or city.
FREE — a complete airport world clock
• Airport Globe and Map view
• Live local time for any airport worldwide
• Pinned LOCAL and Zulu / UTC rows
• Add unlimited airports and drag to reorder
• Search by airport code, city, or state
• Interactive world map with continent, U.S. state, and city filters
• Nearby airports using your location (it never leaves your device)
• Tap-through detail: map, sunrise & sunset, ICAO & IATA, city, country, coordinates, time zone
• Local Weather — a simple, plain-English conditions snapshot for every airport
• Airport Amenities — terminals, TSA PreCheck/CLEAR/Global Entry, and lounges (including Centurion Lounge & Priority Pass) for major hubs, plus U.S. Preclearance status abroad
• Know Before You Go — local currency, plug type & voltage, driving side, emergency number, and rental-car license guidance for every country
• Quick links to an airport's official website and Wikipedia page
• Home Screen & Lock Screen widgets (Favorites + Nearby)
• Show it your way: 12- or 24-hour, optional seconds, ICAO or IATA codes, and date / GMT-offset / time-zone / weather-category subtitles
• Dawn & dusk indicators on every row
• Rename airports with your own nicknames
• Find nearby FBOs
• Airport database kept current — new airports added automatically over time, plus one-tap manual update
• Portrait and landscape
• No ads. No tracking. No account. No data collection.
• Now on Apple Watch as a companion app!
AvClock Premium — one simple, one-time unlock (no subscription, ever)
• Live aviation weather: METAR & TAF, with color-coded VFR / MVFR / IFR / LIFR flight categories
• Color-coded VFR/IFR badges across your entire list at a glance
• Live FAA airport status — ground stops, delays, and closures — plus quick links to check TSA wait times, view an airport diagram, and check NOTAMs
• Weather Alerts and Delay Alerts — get notified the moment conditions or status change for your saved airports
• Weather widget — airport conditions right on your Home Screen
• Airport Status widget — live FAA status for your top airports, right on your Home Screen
• Live Activities — keep an airport live on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Time Converter — shift every clock together to plan across time zones
• Customize Airport View — show, hide, and reorder every section of an airport's detail screen exactly how you want it
• Heliports & hospital helipads — search, save, and view them just like airports
• Aviation color themes and glass backdrops
• Custom app icons
• Fahrenheit option for temperatures
• Universal Purchase — buy once, and it unlocks on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
No subscriptions. No ads. No accounts. Unlock Premium once and it's yours.
REFERENCE ONLY
AvClock is an informational tool and is NOT for navigation, pilotage, or flight planning. Airport data, weather, and status information may be inaccurate, incomplete, or delayed; always confirm with official sources (FAA, NOTAMs, charts, ATC). Some links (TSA wait times, airport diagrams) open independent third-party websites that are not affiliated with AvClock, the TSA, or the FAA. Locations are approximate and based on public data.
Airport data from public domains. Aviation weather from the U.S. NOAA Aviation Weather Center (public domain). Local weather from Apple Weather. AvClock does not collect or transmit your personal data.

apple-macos:6787800273.name: Zetfeed - News & RSS Reader
apple-macos:6787800273.description:
Skip the influencers and algorithms. Your news, without the ads or the tracking. Zetfeed brings the news sites, blogs, podcasts and YouTube channels you follow into one clean feed. You choose every source, no surprises.
Paste a link to almost anything and Zetfeed finds its feed; including blogs, YouTube and Bluesky accounts, podcasts, RSS feeds, and published newsletters. Switching from another RSS reader? Import your OPML file and everything comes with you.
YOUR FEED - NOT INFLUENCED BY ANYONE
Organize sources into folders. Mute the ones you want to keep but not see today. Hide what you have already read. Members can also block keywords you never want to see again, filter out sponsored posts, and collapse a story into one card when several of your sources run it.
NO SPOILERS
Put a show, a film or a team on your watchlist and Zetfeed masks the headlines that would give it away until you choose to look. Finale recaps, ending explainers and last night's score stay hidden while you catch up. Spoiler blocking is a Member feature.
MORE THAN HEADLINES
Your day has more in it than news, so your feed can too. Insert cards for weather, your favorite shows, stocks, sports scores, concerts near you, the lottery, top stories and the daily games. You choose which cards appear, how often, and which teams, tickers and shows to follow. Inserts are a Member feature.
THREE WAYS TO READ
List for speed and density. Magazine for big images and room to browse. Card for one story per screen, at your pace. Switch between them easily at any time.
MAKE IT YOURS
Typography presets, and control over size, spacing and width. Choose between light or dark mode, with customizable accent colors, a warmth slider and a high-contrast option. Members can also select from custom fonts and accent colors.
LOCAL NEWS AND WEATHER
Local coverage for your area, weather, and events and nearby concerts. Severe weather and earthquake alerts arrive as notifications.
FIVE GAMES, FRESH EVERY DAY
On Words, Rank Up, Misquote, First! and Nonsense. Test your puzzle solving abilities and trivia knowledge. Each game takes only a few minutes. You can keep a streak and share your results. Daily games are free while members have access to the full games archive.
BUILT FOR APPLE
Real native apps for iPhone, iPad and Mac, not a website in a container. Home Screen widgets for the latest stories and the day's games. An Apple Watch app for headlines and summaries on your wrist. Keyboard shortcuts and proper menu bar support on the Mac.
WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL
Articles are cached as they arrive, so a tunnel or a plane does not stop you. Read, save and mark things read offline, and everything syncs when you are back online.
LISTEN INSTEAD
Any article can be read aloud, on your device.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No ads. No third-party analytics. No trackers. No advertising identifier. We do not sell your data, and there is no ad business here to sell it to. Location is only ever a city or ZIP you type in, because Zetfeed never asks for your device location and cannot read it.
FREE, AND FREE TO STAY
The free tier is real value, not a demo: a generous number of feeds, all three reading modes, local news and weather, all five daily games, and no ads anywhere.
Every download starts with 30 days of Member, free and without a card. When it ends nothing is deleted. Extra feeds pause, and come straight back if you upgrade.
ZETFEED MEMBER, $9.99/month or $89.99/year
Unlimited feeds. Insert cards. Keyword and sponsored filtering. Spoiler protection. Duplicate detection. Custom typography and reading surfaces. Save to Instapaper, Pinboard, Raindrop.io and Readwise. Email digests. The full games archive. Multiple saved locations. Priority fetching. And much more!
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings.
Privacy Policy: https://zetfeed.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://zetfeed.com/terms

apple-itunes:6802207226.name: Tile Travel - Classic Puzzle
apple-itunes:6802207226.description:
Game Introduction
*Tile Travel - Classic Puzzle* returns to the essence of match-3 games, offering you a pure, stress-relieving, and strategic journey right at your fingertips.
Here, there are no complicated extra rules—only layers of stacked tiles waiting for you to organize. Your objective is simple: find three identical tiles from the stack and tap them into the collection slots above to clear them, all before the limited slots become full.
The crisp sound of every successful match, and the sense of mental clarity that comes from clearing the entire board, form the core of this game's enjoyable experience. It serves as both a test of your powers of observation and a mental workout that allows you to calm your mind and fully immerse yourself in the challenge.
---
How to Play
- **Collect Tiles:** Tap a tile to move it into the collection slots located at the top of the screen. You must tap three tiles with identical patterns in succession to complete a match and clear them.
- **Manage Slots:** The collection slots can hold a maximum of 7 tiles at any one time. If the 7th tile is placed into the slots and there are still no three identical tiles available to match, the game ends. Therefore, carefully planning the order in which you tap is the key to victory.
- **Observe the Stack:** Tiles on lower layers may be hidden beneath those on upper layers. You must tap the upper tiles first to reveal the ones underneath. Consequently, identifying the optimal moves from the currently available tiles is the game's central challenge.
- **Patience is Key:** There is no time limit in this game. If you find yourself stuck, take a moment to carefully observe the board or use the Hint feature. Patience is often far more important than speed.
- **Use Boosters:** When you encounter a difficult situation, you can use boosters such as "Shuffle" or "Undo" to help break the deadlock.
---
Game Features
**Massive Levels, Progressive Difficulty**
The game features a vast number of levels with a difficulty curve designed to ease you in gradually. From relaxing, beginner-friendly layouts to complex, overlapping, and highly challenging stacks in the later stages, you will always find a level that suits your current mood and skill level. Whether you want to relax for a few minutes during your commute or tackle brain-teasing puzzles in your leisure time, this game has something for everyone. A Relaxing and Stress-Free Audiovisual Atmosphere
- Visual Style: The interface features soft, crisp colors and intuitive patterns that are easy to distinguish, ensuring that even extended gameplay won't cause visual fatigue. The game board is clean and uncluttered, free from any distracting elements.
No Internet Required—Play Anytime, Anywhere
The game offers a complete offline experience. Once downloaded, you can play through all unlocked levels without needing an internet connection. Whether you're on the subway, on a plane, or in an area with poor signal coverage, the joy of puzzle-solving is always at your fingertips.
---
Key Highlights
"Tap to trigger, match three to clear. The simplest way to awaken the pure joy of strategic thinking."
*Tile Travel - Classic Puzzle* is a match-3 puzzle game that returns to the classics while eschewing unnecessary bloat. It strips away all non-essential content, retaining only the most engaging tile-matching and strategic planning gameplay. With a vast array of levels, a gentle difficulty curve, and a soothing audiovisual presentation, it serves as the ideal companion for exercising your brain and unwinding during your spare moments.
Open the game, tap that first tile, and embark on your puzzle-solving journey! 
Finally, we hope you enjoy this game. If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.
